After hurriedly leaving to another section of the temple, Skywalker began to realize that the entire place was made up of illusions after almost falling into a pit of spikes. He suggested that things felt wrong and they should leave, but Aphra held a gun to his head to stop him and revealed that she was trying to make Skywalker more powerful because Vader had become more powerful, and she wanted Skywalker to protect her from the Sith Lord. Skywalker agreed and convinced her to put her blaster down, the two using Skywalker's ability to sense the bell with the Force and Aphra's ability to take down the traps, obstacles, and guardians in their way to eventually locate the bell. =====Starweird===== {{Quote|If you die, this whole trip was ''useless!'' If you fall, I'm ''keeping'' your laser sword. That's my blaster!''"
"''If ''you'' die, I'm keeping it!|Aphra and Skywalker, while fighting the Starweird|[[Doctor Aphra (2020) 34|''Doctor Aphra'' (2020) 34]]}} Realizing the bell was to big to transport, and having no Force-ritual to use with it, Aphra removed a piece inside of the bell by standing on Skywalker's shoulders and grabbing it. However, this caused the entire bell to collapse and be destroyed, which Skywalker realized made the echo of the note he could hear stop resonating throughout the Temple. Just then, the creature they had seen earlier burst through the wall, and Aphra realized that Sason Temple was really a Jedi prison. Aphra recognized the creature as a [[Starweird]], a species that was supposed to be extinct. The Starweird threw them onto the wall telekinetically, but Skywalker recognized that it was not using the Force. When Aphra accidentally activated the piece of the bell they had retrieved and thus Forced the creature to be frozen, she realized it was an emitter releasing a frequency that affected the Starweird. However, the emitter deactivated and the Starweird flew toward Aphra, so Skywalker used the Force to impale it with a bunch of crystals before he and Aphra ran away. Skywalker admitted that he had not been trying to impale it, just hold it still as he led Aphra through the temple. After Skywalker, decided to hide in a room full of mirrors, Aphra called him brilliant. [[File:Starweird-2020DoctorAphra33.png|thumb|right|250px|Skywalker and Aphra face a Starweird.]] As Skywalker used the Force to manipulate the reflections of the crystals to lure the Starweird toward them, Aphra used her electro-tattoos to activate the holograms of Masters Ti and Secura. Skywalker, Aphra, and R2-D2 were able to flee the creature and its scream while it was distracted. However, the creature found them, knocking Skywalker to the edge of the temple and leaving him barely hanging on. While proclaiming her desperation to protect Skywalker, she fought the Starweird using his lightsaber. Skywalker eventually pulled himself up and shot at the creature, saying he would keep it if she died right before Aphra sliced the creature's hand off, which Skywalker commented did not feel good. Escaping into the ''Ark Angel IV'', but with the Starweird still on their tail, Skywalker directed Aphra to lead them into the magnetic storm and used the Force to activate the emitter, knocking the creature into the storm and eviscerating it, and leaving him surprised at his ability. Later, back on Numidian Prime, Skywalker told Aphra she did not need to trick or bribe him into protecting her from Vader, insisting he would help because it was the the Jedi way. Aphra warned against his kindness, but Skywalker declared he preferred to take the chance than close himself off from people in need and leave himself all alone. Aphra told him to call her the next time he needed to get into a Jedi tomb, but Skywalker said he would not and took off in his X-wing, having taken the emitter with him before Aphra could realize. ====Christophsis==== {{Quote|Every time I think I have a handle on being a Jedi, something happens to kick me back. The ground under my feet just disappears… I'm going to have to face Vader again, and I am not ready. I don't even have a lightsaber I can rely on.|Skywalker to Organa|[[Star Wars (2020) 34|''Star Wars'' (2020) 34]]}} While studying his Jedi text and the yellow kyber crystal from his lightsaber on the ''Home One'', Skywalker realized that he did not know a lot about kyber crystals except them being in every lightsaber as their power source. He explained to R2-D2 that the text only contained details about the philosophy and spirituality of kyber crystals and an old rite of passage for younglings to find a crystal to make their first lightsaber on the planet Ilum, referring to another manual by Professor [[Huyang]] for building instructions. He figured that Yoda and Kenobi had never taught him anything about them because he had already had one, but lamented that his had never had a connection with him like they were supposed to due to the almost living nature of the crystals. He ignited his lightsaber and said that now that the crystal was cracked it no longer was a useful tool and was unstable. Due to the saber's unsteadiness, R2 made a concerned beep and Skywalker shut it off and apologized. Realizing that he needed a new crystal, Skywalker decided that he and R2 should visit other worlds the text mentioned to find them since Ilum was locked down by the Empire. Just then, Organa walked in. After he told he was going somewhere, she expressed her concern for him especially due to the strangeness of the Force as well as her desire for him to stay and help the Alliance. Skywalker insisted he was fine, saying he was just troubled by not knowing why the Force was strange or how to fix his lightsaber and felt like he could never truly get a handle on being a Jedi. He also admitted that he needed a lightsaber for his confrontation with Vader, and that he felt like he needed to go on this mission in order to take control and take action.[[Star Wars (2020) 34|''Star Wars'' (2020) 34]] [[File:Christophsis.jpg|thumb|left|200px|Christophsis]] Skywalker chose to go to Christophsis, due to the fact that there was not much of a permanent Imperial presence there despite it being an Imperial world and because the text said kyber crystals could regularly be found there. He flew his X-Wing there with R2 and landed outside of a small mining town where prospectors sell their finds so he would not get noticed, though did not want to have to walk the way there. R2 indicated to him that he wanted to know the plan, so Skywalker admitted that he did not have one. He explained that Calrissian had told him there was a black market for crystals on Christophsis because prospectors try to sell them since there was not enough for the Empire to set up a full-scale mining operation. He told R2 that he just planned to put the word out and pose as a buyer to see who would speak with him. He admitted that it was not much of a plan but gave R2 his lightsaber to hold onto while he looked around, not wanting to make it obvious he was a Jedi. He assured R2 he would be fine and told the droid that he could save him if he got into trouble. He then started in to a nearby cantina. [[File:Gretta-2020StarWars34.jpg|thumb|right|200px|Gretta]] In the cantina, Skywalker got food and water and implied to an [[Unidentified Iktotchi bartender|Iktotchi bartender]] that he was a wealthy buyer looking for kyber. Just as the Iktotchi was offering to point Skywalker to his quarry, a human with green hair shot and killed him and everyone else in the cantina except for Skywalker, leaving him shocked. She taunted him and called him by name, so Skywalker used the Force to pull his lightsaber to him from R2, who had just rolled in and ordered her to explain herself. She introduced herself as [[Gretta]] and claimed that she saved his life, pointing out a blaster behind the counter. She explained that the whole place was ploy to trap people looking for kyber and sell them to the Empire, and that she saved him from it because he was a Jedi. She claimed that she still believed and recognized him from the dark channels, having posted out there in case any Jedi came through. She told him that there was kyber near and told him that she had to kill the people there because she knew he would not. Skywalker was still upset that she killed everyone there, insisting they died for nothing and urging her to live a better life before leaving. Skywalker went off to look for crystals on the planet, sensing she had told the truth about there being some there, but she called after him and told him he was going the wrong direction. He saw she had a speeder with her and urged him to let her help him, explaining that she was from Jedha and that her people were the [[Fallanassi]]. She revealed that they were killed by the Death Star, and that when Skywalker had destroyed it he had avenged them, and thus she wanted to return the favor. Skywalker told R2 to go back to the ship and tell the others where he was if he did not come back in a day, assuring the droid he would be okay and that he needed to do this while getting in Gretta's speeder. On the way, Skywalker asked Gretta about the Fallanassi. She explained that they did not use kyber crystals and had not been Force-sensitive for many years, only understanding it, not using it. When he asked, she also revealed that they were going to meet a man named [[Cuata]] who had hid there to escape the eye of the Empire and continue his studies, having been sought out by the Imperials to help design the weapon. Skywalker was confused about how she knew this information, and she explained that she has been working for him. Suddenly, a massive creature emerged from the gournd and knocked Skywalker and Gretta off of the speeder. Skywalker ignited his lightsaber and told Gretta to run, but she was delirious and urged him to fight the creature. Noticing the instability of his lightsaber, he decided just to run as the creature crushed their speeder with its mouth. The creature pursued them closely, so Skywalker just told Gretta to run, intending to use the Force to calm the creature. However, when he tried to he found himself unable to touch the Force. The creature nearly reached him until a massive explosion rocked him and Cuata emerged from the smoke and dust, instantly asking Skywalker if he could have his lightsaber. ====The kyber crystals==== =====Red===== {{Quote|You came here to heal me—but what if do not ''want'' to be healed? I am not ''sick'', young master. Your ministrations would to me, be a form of ''violence''. ''You'' have experienced violence, I think. ''You'' have experienced pain. We can use it…''together''.|Gol, the Sith in the crystal, to Skywalker|}} [[File:StarWars2020-35-NotoVariant-cropped.jpg|thumb|250px|Luke Skywalker shows his lightsaber to Cuata.]] Realizing he came on too strong, Cuata explained that the kyber crystals he wore around his neck told him that Skywalker needed help. Gretta introduced Skywalker to Cuata, and though he was initially concerned that the doctor thought the crystals were talking to him, apologized and asked for his help with his broken lightsaber after Gretta assured Skywalker he could trust Cuata. He immediately took the lightsaber and started tinkering with it, quickly discovering that the crystal was cracked and assured him he could fix it if Skywalker did something for him first. Cuata also revealed Skywalker's crystal told him that he was having trouble with the Force, and then started to lead him to his workshop. At Cuata's workshop, Skywalker explained that he had found his lightsaber and that he and his R2 unit had worked on it. Cuata, concerned at Skywalker's lack of knowledge, explained the components and inner workings of a lightsaber and told Skywalker that a lightsaber's wielder should have a strong connection with its crystal, something Skywalker admitted he had never felt, not even with his father's lightsaber. While Cuata worked on fixing the lightsaber, he gave Skywalker a red kyber crystal and asked him to pull the dark side out of it. Gretta, whose people had a history with healing crystals, explained how crystals were turned red by [[bleeding]] them with the Dark side, but could be healed afterward, though the process of doing so could change people and forced them to connect with whoever bled it. [[File:GolsCourt-2020StarWars35.png|thumb|250px|Skywalker has a vision of a Sith lord in a Sith hall|left]] Skywalker agreed to try, and when he reached out to the crystal with the Force, suddenly found himself in a massive Sith hall in front of the Sith Lord [[Gol (Sith)|Gol]], sitting on a throne. The Sith greeted him and Skywalker explained his intentions of healing the crystal, but Gol said they did not want to be healed so attempting to do so would be violence toward them. Gol grabbed and twisted Skywalker's hand and said that together they could use the violence and the pain he had experienced. After a flash of light from his hand, the vision changed, putting Skywalker in a spirit-like version of his body facing his father's [[Fortress Vader]] on Mustafar. Vader then appeared on it and Skywalker ignited the red lightsaber in his hand, but a wave of red light washed over him and the vision ended. =====Green===== {{Quote|All Jedi walk their own path. All Jedi ''must'' walk their own path. Know this, you do—or returned to me, you would have. You did not wish to speak to me, Luke. And so you did not. A great decision lies before you. It has nothing to do with the Force or being a Jedi. About ''yourself'', this decision will be. Until you make it, a Jedi you cannot be.|Yoda to Skywalker|[[Star Wars (2020) 35|''Star Wars'' (2020) 35]]}} [[File:Yoda-2020StarWars35.png|thumb|right|250px|Yoda appears to Skywalker inside the raw kyber crystal.]] A terrified Skywalker stared at the still-red crystal and told Cuata that he had seen his father. Cuata then asked Skywalker to connect with a clear and raw kyber crystal, assuring him that he would pull him out if his crystals told him the Force was receding. After reaching out to the crystal, Skywalker found himself standing in front of Yoda. He believed it was not real, but still asked Yoda why he never answered when he reached out to him with the Force especially since he was hurt and trying to learn. Yoda insisted that all Jedi need to walk their own Path and that he would have returned to him otherwise. Yoda warned that Skywalker would need to make a decision about himself soon. Skywalker decided that he was not getting anything from speaking to Yoda and that he would be better off just learning from his Jedi text. He tried to leave the vision but could not, realizing that the Force had pulled back from him as it had been recently. Yoda told Skywalker that it was not really gone even when it was out of sight, waved his hand, and sent Skywalker out of the vision, wishing him goodbye. Yoda, who had been really speaking to Skywalker the whole time, asked the spirit of Kenobi what he thought. They both agreed that he was still not ready, but Yoda pointed out that he had learned much and would be ready when the time came. When Skywalker exited the vision, he discovered that the clear kyber crystal had turned green. Cuata gave him his saber back, having temporarily fixed it, but Gretta revealed that the scientist had been willing to let Skywalker stay trapped in the crystal and even die, advising him not to tell Cuata anything. Skywalker thanked Cuata for fixing his lightsaber and told him that he would take the green crystal for when he needed to build his own saber, also taking the red one in case one day he could heal it. Back at his X-Wing, Skywalker thanked Gretta for helping him and said he had learned despite things not going the way he had thought. He said he would go back to the Alliance eventually as his biggest battles still lay ahead, but revealed that he was going to spend time thinking first while holding up both the red and green crystal with the Force. While he was away, Organa used the intel Skywalker gave her that the Emperor and Vader were distracted by a Force anomaly to launch an [[Assault on Coruscant|aerial assault on Coruscant]], successfully destroying a statue of Palpatine in the hopes of inspiring rebellion across the galaxy.[[Star Wars (2020) 36|''Star Wars'' (2020) 36]] ====Dark droids==== {{Quote|I will be…''"
"…''the new Force''.|Skywalker and the Scourge, as the latter controlled the former's body|[[Star Wars (2020) 41|''Star Wars'' (2020) 41]]}} [[File:SacredJediText-DarkDroids1.png|thumb|left|300px|Skywalker studies his Jedi text with R2-D2.]] When studying Jedi text, Skywalker found a reference to a Jedi outpost in the [[Tammuz sector]]. After seeing nothing on a map R2-D2 pulled up for him, however, he decided that there was probably nothing there but that they could swing by if they got the chance. Later, as the [[Scourge crisis|Scourge of the droids]] began across the galaxy, Skywalker was in a meeting with Rebellion higher-ups concerning how to handle the new Death Star. Commodore Grek suggested they just threw Skywalker at it again, but Skywalker suspected it might take more than him in an X-wing to take down the new station.[[Dark Droids 1|''Dark Droids'' 1]] Later, while Skywalker was meditating and practicing telekinesis, he was approached by C-3PO, who had been infected by the malevolent droid entity called the [[Scourge]] that was behind the scourge of the droids. The Scourge, as C-3PO questioned Skywalker on the nature of the Force and if droids could use it. Skywalker explained that he had never heard of that happening but thought it could potentially be possible. When the Scourge then asked if Skywalker's cybernetic arm felt connected to the Force, he explained that his whole being felt connected, but that he was not a true cyborg like Darth Vader. Skywalker expressed his concern that something was wrong with C-3PO, leading to the Scourge briefly considering killing him. Instead, the droid just apologised and agreed to get a diagnostic, before agreeing to Skywalker's request to send R2-D2 his way.[[Dark Droids 2|''Dark Droids'' 2]] As the scourge of the droids continued, Calrissian recruited Skywalker and Organa for a mission to the planet [[Epikonia]] to rescue Lobot, who had been infected by the Scourge. When they arrived in the ''Millennium Falcon'', Skywalker was unsure what made the world special until Organa explained that it was a communications hub. Calrissian then refused to allow Skywalker to access transpoder signals and turned off the ''Falcon''{{'s}} navigation systems to prevent the infection from reaching the ship's [[L3-37|droid core]]. Skywalker and Organa were concerned, but Calrissian managed to land them safely on a satelite dish. The Scourge soon learned that Skywalker was on the planet and became obsessed with the idea of infecting him so that it could use the Force.[[Star Wars (2020) 40|''Star Wars'' (2020) 40]] [[File:StarWars-Vol-7-Solicit-Cover.jpg|thumb|right|250px|Skywalker, Organa, Calrissian, and Chewbacca fight the Scourge on Epikonia.]] As the group traversed through the planet's main city where the Scourge was headquartered, Skywalker noticed that there were no people around. They were then [[Battle on Epikonia|attacked]] by a horde of violent Scourge-infected droids, Skywalker using his yellow lightsaber to begin taking them down alongside his friends. Skywalker sliced through the ever-growing mob of droids while urging himself to stay calm, focused, and concentrated on the Force. When the droids ominously and suddenly retreated, a new swarm of [[spider-droid]]s attacked. Skywalker tried to fight them off, but was quickly infected with the Scourge by one. As the Scourge was controlling Skywalker's body and declared itself the 'new Force' it was defeated by Ajax Sigma, freeing Skywalker from its control. Though unsure what happened, Skywalker went with the others to find Lobot. Once they did, Calrissian and Chewbacca started to take him back to the ship while Skywalker and Organa assisted people who had been experimented on by the Scourge. Skywalker and Organa returned to the ship very quickly, as they found themselves unable to assist a great amount. They discovered Calrissian with the [[Autonomous Translator Module, Mark II|Talky droid]] that contained much of the Alliance's secrets. As Organa and Calrissian threatened each other, Skywalker urged them to focus on healing Lobot. Calrissian then explained the circumstances that had led him to sell the droid, and thus the Alliance's secrets, to Jabba the Hutt, leaving Skywalker and Organa shocked– Organa arresting Calrissian for these crimes. ====The Sith and the Skywalker==== {{Quote|Being healed doesn't mean you're weak. Here... I'll show you.|Skywalker, to Gol|}} In order to learn more about his enemy, the Sith, Skywalker tracked down Gretta in the Outer Rim with the help of R2-D2 and enlisted her help in once again attempting to purify the Sith Lord Gol's corrupted kyber crystal. The two were also assisted by [[Feez]], Gretta's aunt. Feez told Skywalker that to heal the crystal, he would need to journey into the memories of its corrupter and understand their pain in order to succeed. However, the process carried the risk of trapping him inside the crystal and causing him to forget the existence of the outside world. As Gretta and Feez began the ritual, Skywalker's mind entered the crystal. He found himself falling from the sky into Gol's castle hall. Like before, Gol stated that Skywalker was not welcome and would be removed. Skywalker refused and ignited his lightsaber. In response, the entire court ignited their Sith lightsabers. Skywalker knocked down a large number of Sith courtiers with the Force. However, with a single twitch of his finger, Gol Force-lifted Skywalker into the air and slammed him onto the ground, knocking him out cold. Gol ordered his soldiers to bring Skywalker into the dungeon. As Skywalker awoke, Gol stated that while Skywalker was a Jedi, he was unusual: he was clean, not wearing rags, and had a lightsaber. He told Skywalker about the last Jedi he had in the court, the [[Jester Jedi]], who eventually committed suicide to escape his torment, and stated that he intended to do the same to Skywalker. When Skywalker asked when was the vision taking place, Gol simply stated that it was now. When Skywalker offered to heal Gol's pain once again, Gol ordered his soldiers to beat him, stating that the Jedi was confused by "strange fantasies" and needed to see the reality: the Jedi could save no one in this time, not even themselves, and all they could do was suffer. [[File:Gol-2020StarWars42cover.png|thumb|left|250px|Gol, the Sith that Skywalker found inside the red crystal.]] After the beating was finished, Gol told Skywalker that no one could leave behind their pain, and that it was pain that defined him since his earliest days, looking to an infant crying in a crib in the cell next to Skywalker's. Skywalker once again offered to help, asking if Gol wanted the pain to stop. Gol replied that pain never stops as it is people's history, he pointed out that Skywalker's hand was severed and would always be severed, causing his cybernetic hand to spontaneously disappear. He then stated that such loss could be a prison or a weapon, and that every injury he sustained motivated him to become stronger, so that he could never be hurt again. At this point, he asked for Skywalker's name, when Skywalker replied, Gol made the same offer to Skywalker as when they first met: to combine Skywalker's pain with his, creating a better version of the vision. He stated that all Skywalker needed to see things his way was more pain. After Gol left, Skywalker destroyed his prison door with the Force. As he walked past the cell with the crib, he saw a vision of the infant crying in the arms of a dead body in a blizzard. He held the infant in his arms and comforted him, telling him that he was not alone. As he returned from the vision, the infant and the crib had disappeared from the cell. Realizing that the infant was a past version of Gol, Skywalker closed his eyes and began walking through the dungeon. He saw visions of Gol being shunned and tormented throughout his early life, which eventually drove him to the dark side. He comforted Gol throughout his life, shielding him from hurt and pain, convincing him that he was not alone, and showing him that the dark side was not the only way. Eventually, the adult Gol reappeared and attacked Skywalker with lightsaber drawn, demanding Skywalker to stop making him weak. Skywalker stated that being healed does not make him weak and ignited his lightsaber, but was surprised to see that its blade had turned from yellow to green. As the two duelled, Gol asked Skywalker who did he think he was. Skywalker stated that he was a Jedi, and Gol stated that he was a fool, like all who followed that path. Skywalker then disarmed Gol of his lightsaber and stated that all paths lead in both directions. Though Gol was defeated, he stated that this place was built from pain, and to heal it, Skywalker would need to face his own pain. He then transformed into Darth Vader, and the dungeon transformed into the reactor shaft on Cloud City. Instead of fighting Vader, Skywalker flipped over him and ran deeper into Cloud City. As he ran, the [[viewscreen]]s on the wall displayed all the pain and loss he had suffered: the deaths of Owen and Beru Lars, the death of Obi-Wan Kenobi, the loss of friends like Biggs Darklighter and Han Solo, being attacked by a Wampa on Hoth, and the death of his birth mother, Padmé Amidala. At this point, Vader appeared before him, saying there was no escape. [[File:SuccessfulPurification-2020StarWars43.png|thumb|right|240px|Skywalker purifies the kyber crystal.]] Skywalker agreed that there was no escape from their fated confrontation. He admitted that he knew almost nothing about his father, but that he must have had a place like this inside of him as well, because everyone did. He stated that his father did not begin as Darth Vader, and that he was once someone else, causing Vader to morph into a shining silhouette of Anakin Skywalker as a Jedi. Luke stated that no one is beyond help and touched Anakin's chest. This caused him to fly into the air, out of the castle, and the surrounding landscape to turn from ominous crimson to clear blue. As Skywalker awoke from his vision, Gol's crystal was successfully healed, turning pure white. He then gave the crystal to Feez, saying he no longer needed it. When Gretta asked Skywalker what he learned about the Sith, Skywalker stated that the Sith he saw were from a long time ago and different from the ones today. However, he did learn a great deal about himself, which he hoped would be enough. ====Trials and tribulations==== {{Quote|I'd like to say something. I'm ''Luke Skywalker''. I'm a...I'm studying the Force, and what advocate Georgio is saying is ''impossible''.|Luke Skywalker, during the trial of Lando Calrissian|[[Star Wars (2020) 44|''Star Wars'' (2020) 44]]}} After being arrested for selling Rebel secrets, Lando Calrissian called in the help of [[lawyer]] [[Salli Georgio]] for his trial on ''Home One'', and Luke Skywalker sat in the chamber during the trial, viewing witness questioning and testimonies. At one point during the trial, Georgio implied that Lando, in committing his crimes, may have been under the influence of a Jedi mind trick, as he was a known associate to Skywalker, a Jedi. Skywalker stood up and denied the possibility of this happening, citing his education on the Force and its inner workings. [[File:LandoTrial-2020StarWars44.png|thumb|left|270px|Luke Skywalker was present for the trial of Lando Calrissian aboard ''Home One''.]] As the trial reached a conclusion, Skywalker and the rest witnessed Mon Mothma's hologram react to what was happening in the remote location she was broadcasting from. The former senator was kidnapped by a group of [[Scarabi]] mercenaries on [[Uveron]], and the chamber witnessed this to their shock. In response to this, Rebel command issued [[Tactical Plan Eighteen]], dividing the fleet, while Skywalker continued to watch the trial, which then called Leia to the stand. Leia explained her knowledge of Calrissian's character, including his preparing the trap for Luke at Cloud City.[[Star Wars (2020) 45|''Star Wars'' (2020) 45]] Soon after, Skywalker attended a meeting in ''Home One''{{'s}} amphitheater where he, along with Organa, Ackbar, and [[Crix Madine]] viewed a ransom hologram of Mon Mothma. Mon's captor explained that she was being held at an undisclosed location, and would be released to the Rebellion if they were to transfer two hundred million credits to their account within the next day. If they didn't, the captor said that the Empire surely would. Ackbar said that this amount would cripple the Rebellion, and Skywalker added that, conversely, Mothma being turned over to the Empire would also destroy the Rebellion due to ISB interrogation revealing all she knew. But it turned out that Calrissian recognized the voice of Mothma's captor as [[Hachi]], a mercenary he once knew, leading to his participation in a rescue mission, and eventually the clearing of his name, all of which Luke Skywalker witnessed.[[Star Wars (2020) 46|''Star Wars'' (2020) 46]][[Star Wars (2020) 47|''Star Wars'' (2020) 47]] ====Closing loose ends==== {{Quote|You can't know that. Even the ''Force'' can't predict the future. It's always shifting, changing.|Luke Skywalker comforting his sister on ''Home One''|[[Star Wars (2020) 48|''Star Wars'' (2020) 48]]}} [[File:LukeComfortsLeia-2020StarWars48.jpg|thumb|right|230px|Luke Skywalker comforts a crying Leia Organa as she was overwhelmed with her Rebel duties.]] Later, still on ''Home One'', Skywalker was called to Organa's chamber at the princess's request, after she'd had a nightmare about Alderaan once again. Organa was on the verge of giving up on everything except for rescuing Solo. Skywalker reassured her about her dedication to the cause, and Organa then explained her dreams, and how they express the guilt she still holds over Alderaan's destruction at the hands of Tarkin. Skywalker reminded her that she was in an impossible position and was not responsible, but Organa shifted the conversation to the next Death Star, blaming her dreams on that looming threat. Organa then broke into tears over the stress and turmoil of balancing it all, and Skywalker comforted her, relating to the feeling. Leia told Luke that he was one of the few people she could be a real person around, and thanked him. But then, Skywalker and Organa looked to the Rebel leader's comm unit as the voice of Evaan Verlaine came through: she had news about Alderaan and needed Leia in the hangar. The two met the pilot in the ship's hangar, and Verlaine remarked that she hoped to fly with Skywalker again soon, with which he agreed. Evaan then told the two that the Alderaanian [[Alderaan Flotilla|survivor fleet]], a flotilla of refugees from Alderaan, had missed their last three check-ins. She was asking for permission to go investigate, which Organa approved– until Skywalker insisted that she herself go. Organa refused, but was eventually convinced that it was a military matter as the flotilla was technically considered Alliance reserves. Skywalker agreed to go as well, and the three set off, Organa and Skywalker in a [[Taylander shuttle]] and Verlaine in her X-wing. [[File:LukeVsRaiders-2020StarWars48.jpg|thumb|left|200px|Luke Skywalker fights off the raiders on the ''Thranta'' to defend Leia Organa.]] Deep in space, the group traveled as Verlaine explained that the Alderaanian survivor fleet could be taken out in a single strike, which Skywalker remarked was a tough way to live. They then came upon the [[Thranta (starship)|''Thranta'']], an Alderaanian vessel that was unresponsive to comms and giving the life sign of only one or two people. Skywalker and Organa docked with the vessel while Verlaine remained outside to watch their backs. The inside of the ''Thranta'' was dark, only lit by emergency lights, which Skywalker surmised was because the ship ran out of fuel and was abandoned. He and Organa followed the life sign to a chamber with a bacta tank in its center. Organa immediately recognized the woman as [[Jora Astane]], a preserver of Alderaanian culture who was part of the flotilla. Skywalker, however, sensed that Astane was dead, making the presence of a life sign extra confusing. Luke then discovered that the machinery Astane was hooked up to was keeping her blood pumping enough for her neural activity to register on life sign scans, something Leia realized made her bait. Just then, Organa's comms buzzed again with the voice of Verlaine announcing that raiders had dropped out of hyperspace and were firing on her and the ''Thranta''. Skywalker and Organa ran to their shuttle, but the smaller, docked ship was fired upon by the raiders, destroying their only escape route. This blasted Organa into a wall, leading to Skywalker having to fight off the now boarding raiders with his lightsaber. Using both his blade and the Force , Luke fought off the raiders and blocked their entrance, using the bought time to carry Leia to an escape pod. He then placed her inside and launched the pod from a panel on the wall, saving Organa's life as the ''Thranta'' completely detonated. Organa watched on in horror, as Skywalker escaped in another pod unbeknownst to Leia,[[Star Wars (2020) 49|''Star Wars'' (2020) 49]] who'd been captured by the raiders– led by the long-thought-dead and now-cyborg Ellian Zahra. [[File:LukeVsZahra-2020StarWars49.jpg|thumb|right|240px|Luke Skywalker duels Ellian Zahra.]] On her [[Raider-class corvette]], Zahra commanded her crew to use a grappling claw to grab Skywalker's escape pod, bringing him just close enough to their ship's hangar to be visible, but not bringing him onboard. Zahra had planned to kill Skywalker in front of Organa, but the Jedi ignited his lightsaber inside the pod, slashing it from multiple angles, and exposing him to the vacuum of space. But using his Force-abilites, Skywalker pulled himself inside the hangar. There, he faced the masses of Zahra's crew, deflecting blaster bolts and causing chaos to buy time for reinforcements to arrive with Verlaine. Furious, Zahra wanted to kill Skywalker herself and drew her blade to do so before getting slammed in the back by Organa. Zahra stabbed Organa in the shoulder in response, and her droid informed her that the ship was too damaged to escape– causing her crew to run and abandon ship in their individual vessels, leaving Luke without an opponent. In a rage, Zahra lunged at Skywalker, but the Jedi easily dodged or blocked her strikes, eventually slicing her blade in half, just as ''Home One'' and a squad of X-wings arrived outside. Zahra called Skywalker "scum", and ran to her [[F3-Vara snubfighter|Cumulus-class fighter]] to escape. Skywalker checked on Organa, and told her that he let Zahra go in case she learned from this. ''Home One'' contacted Organa asking if they had her authorization to fire on Zahra. Organa said not unless she fired at them, and Zahra subsequently turned around, aiming her vessel at Skywalker and Organa. The princess then gave the order to fire, killing Zahra, as Skywalker told her that Zahra chose her own fate. ====Zastiga==== {{Quote|Weapons and war don't make you a Jedi. I know that now.|Luke Skywalker|''[[Moving Target: A Princess Leia Adventure]]''}} After the command of Red Squadron was transferred to Antilles following his promotion to squadron leader, which pleased Skywalker, he declined to rejoin the squadron and chose to be stationed onboard the ''Redemption''. When he went to [[Zastiga]], he and R2-D2 were the ones to greet Organa on her arrival to the planet after she and C-3PO left the ''[[Mellcrawler]]'', piloted by its owner [[Nien Nunb]] and Lieutenant [[Caluan Ematt]]. When the time came for Organa to attend the top clearance meeting with the Rebel leadership, Skywalker and Nunb met with Antilles for a discussion of "reconnaissance tactics" about Antilles' refusal to pay the [[Sullustan]] a drink. He would later return to escort Organa to her quarters before going to his, and two days later, he saw her off, before catching his own shuttle back to the ''Redemption''. Soon afterwards, he would go to [[Kothlis]], where he would learn of Solo's location—still frozen in carbonite and kept in Jabba the Hutt's palace—, and where he would keep himself up-to-date with the status of the Alliance Fleet's assembly. He had already devised a plan to rescue Solo when Organa contacted him following the successful [[Operation Yellow Moon]], and showed eagerness to join him on his attempts to [[Rescue of Han Solo|rescue]] the Corellian smuggler. ====Imperial Refining Platform M36==== {{Quote|We just took an ''Imperial refinery'' without a ''scratch''-- all thanks to ''Skywalker''. I heard the stories. But I never saw anyone swing a ''lightsaber'' up close like that.|a Pau'an Rebel Major about Luke Skywalker|[[Age of Rebellion - Luke Skywalker 1|''Age of Rebellion - Luke Skywalker'' 1]]}} [[File:RaidAtImperialRefiningPlatformM36-AORLuke1.jpg|thumb|left|200px|Luke Skywalker during the raid at Imperial Refining Platform M36.]] Sometime before the rescue of Solo, Skywalker took part in a [[Raid at Imperial Refining Platform M36|raid]] on [[Imperial Refining Platform M36]]. During the raid, Skywalker used [[Luke Skywalker's green lightsaber|his new lightsaber]], along with his Force abilities, to clear a path for Rebel forces to acquire copious Imperial fuel stores. His Rebel companions became awed at his use, although one of them, the [[Unidentified Rebel major (Pau'an)|major]] in charge of the operation, held reservations about its power as he had only previously seen such power being wielded by the Sith. Unknown to Skywalker, the Emperor had begun to probe his mental defenses from afar, which caused Skywalker to briefly open his saber in alarm. As Skywalker and the strike team flew away from the platform, they were ambushed by an Imperial Star Destroyer, which launched several TIE Fighters in pursuit. As the battle began to rage, Skywalker's mind was penetrated by a vision from the Emperor. The vision saw Luke follow a possible series of events wherein he would begrudgingly leave the Rebel strike team to its fate and crash-land on an unknown planet, losing his X-wing in the process. As he journeyed from the wreckage together with R2-D2, Luke would leave his lightsaber and helmet on the ground, symbolizing his complete retreat from the concerns of the war. Having later broken free of the Emperor's vision, Skywalker proceeded to aid the Rebels in escaping the Imperial ambush, using his lightsaber to prevent the major's shuttle from leaving, giving him time to pilot the shuttle and draw the Imperials away from the rest of the Rebels. ===The last of the Jedi=== ====Solo's rescue==== {{Quote|I am taking Captain Solo and his friends. You can either profit by this or be destroyed. It's your choice, but I warn you not to underestimate my powers.|Luke Skywalker, to Jabba Desilijic Tiure|audio=IAmTakingCaptainSolo.flac|}} In [[4 ABY]], Skywalker set in motion the plan to rescue Solo from Jabba the Hutt due to their failure to do so during the [[Attack on the Executor|Attack on the ''Executor'']]. Once again, Skywalker returned to Tatooine, and to Kenobi's hut, wherein he found the missing parts he needed for the construction of his own lightsaber, the pieces left to him by Kenobi. While his friends bustled about preparing for the rescue, Skywalker retreated into the solitude of a desert cave they had chosen as their rendezvous point. Using the Force to assemble the weapon, he brought the kyber crystal inside to life, making the weapon his own, almost an extension of himself. [[File:FullOfSurprises-SWL56.png|thumb|right|250px|Skywalker returned to Tatooine in order to rescue Solo from Jabba the Hutt, but ended up facing his rancor, Pateesa.]] Afterward, Skywalker waited to see if Organa's impersonation of [[Boushh]] and liberation of Solo was successful without his intervention, but she was only half-successful. She then sent a message to Skywalker and Calrissian that she had been captured as well, prompting Skywalker to act and go to Jabba's Palace. Skillful use of the Force allowed Skywalker to get past Jabba's [[Gamorrean]] guards and use a Jedi mind trick to get his [[majordomo]], [[Bib Fortuna]], to present him to the Hutt. However, Jabba was not so easily swayed by Skywalker and ignored both his demand to give him Solo and Chewbacca and Skywalker's warnings about underestimating him. Jabba laughed and dispatched Skywalker through a trap door where he was standing, dropping the young Jedi into a pit below, where the Hutt unleashed his massive [[rancor]] [[Pateesa]]. Skywalker struggled against the terrifying creature that tried to feast on him. But to the shock of Jabba and his thugs, Skywalker was able to kill the monster by smashed the control panel with the [[Bone|skull]] - belonging to [[Bidlo Kwerve]][[Star Wars: Complete Locations (2016)|''Star Wars: Complete Locations'']]- dropping a large metal gate on its neck, upsetting [[Malakili]], the rancor's keeper. Jabba was furious and sentenced all the captured Alliance heroes—including an unfrozen Solo—to death in the [[Great Pit of Carkoon]] to be eaten by the [[sarlacc]] that resided there. Jabba's dancers, including [[Rystáll Sant]] and [[Lyn Me]], were ecstatic that Skywalker killed the beast and told [[musician]] [[Maximilian Rebo|Max Rebo]] about it, Me believing and fantasizing that he had done it to avenge [[Oola]], another dancer who had been fed to the creature, though dancer [[Greeata Jendowanian]] acknowledged that was not true.[[Return of the Jedi – Max Rebo 1|''Return of the Jedi – Max Rebo'' 1]] Skywalker was taken on a [[skiff]] to the pit, where Jabba watched on from his [[sail barge]] the ''[[Khetanna]]''. Before he was walked out onto a plank above the mouth of the sarlacc, Skywalker yelled to Jabba, telling him that he had one last chance to free them and would die if he did not. Skywalker nodded to Calrissian, who was on the skiff, and then saluted to R2-D2, who was on the ''Khetanna'', before jumping off the plank, grabbing onto it, and using as a springboard to flip back onto the skiff. Skywalker then escaped when R2-D2 shot his lightsaber to him, allowing him to take down the guards and free the other prisoners on the [[skiff]]. A skirmish ensued in which Skywalker protected his friends, including facing and fending off Boba Fett, jumping over and onto the ''Khetanna'', ending the life of several of Jabba's thugs—including [[Klaatu]] and [[Nysad]], who shot his cyborg hand during the skirmish— and helping Organa, who had killed the Hutt by strangling him, escape the ''Khetanna'' by swinging together on a rope back over to the skiff. After destroying the sail barge by pointing one of its guns at its deck and activating it before they left it, he and his friends left on the skiff once he made sure they brought C-3PO and R2-D2 back with them. Skywalker and his entire team then escaped unscathed through a dangerous sandstorm, after which he boarded his X-wing with R2-D2 and parted ways with the others. ====Keeping the promise==== {{Quote|Luke… when gone am I, the last of the Jedi, will you be. Luke… the Force runs strong in your family. Pass on what you have learned. Luke… There… is… another… Sk-… Sky… walker…|Yoda's last words, to Luke Skywalker|}} [[File:YodasDeath-ROTJ.png|thumb|left|300px|Keeping the promise, Skywalker returns to Dagobah, where he joins Yoda as he becomes one with the Force.]] Skywalker then returned to Dagobah to complete his training and keep the promise he had made to Yoda, but the aged Jedi Master, whose long life was supported by the Force, had fallen ill and was finally starting to succumb to age. Yoda explained this to Skywalker and assured him that it was the way of the Force, with no way to prevent it. Yoda told Skywalker that he would already completed all the training he required, but in order to finally become a true Jedi, he needed to confront Darth Vader one more time. As his final moments creeped up on him, Yoda reflected on Skywalker being too old for what he was learning, too serious, too tall to fit in the hut, truly good, and that he was able to see Anakin's eyes in Luke's.{{StoryCite|story=Masters|book=Stories of Jedi and Sith}} Skywalker inquired if Vader was truly his father. Having grown less and less sure since the revelation, Skywalker feared that it was the truth. Skywalker received such confirmation from Yoda, which angered him that they had lied to him for so long but Yoda confessed that he knew that Skywalker had not been ready to shoulder the burden of being the child of the Dark Lord of the Sith. When Yoda suggested that Skywalker should not have rushed to face Vader, Skywalker expressed his regret that he did not listen to him the first time. Yoda then reached out to Skywalker in the Force and felt his fear and awe. The dying Jedi then warned him not to underestimate the Emperor's [[Force power|powers]] or allow the dark side to take hold of him, and that as "the last of the Jedi" he had to pass on what he had learned. Wishing to give Skywalker a chance to find connection and family in someone other than Vader, Yoda made one final revelation to Skywalker before he became one with the Force—that there was "another Skywalker." ====Reunion with Kenobi==== {{Quote|Your father was seduced by the dark side of the Force. He ceased to be Anakin Skywalker and became Darth Vader. When that happened, the good man who was your father was destroyed. So what I told you was true, from a certain point of view.|Obi-Wan Kenobi to Luke Skywalker|}} [[File:Kenobi_and_Luke_Chatting.png|thumb|right|208x208px|Skywalker received confirmation from Kenobi that Darth Vader was indeed his father.]] Sensing his turmoil, the spirit of Kenobi appeared before Skywalker, who confronted him for lying about his father. Claiming that the good man that Anakin Skywalker had been had died upon his fall to the dark side, Kenobi stated that he did not directly lie to him about his father; he was simply telling him what happened "from a certain point of view." Skywalker voiced his belief that there was still good within his father, and that he could not bring himself to kill him, but Kenobi insisted that he needed to face him again in order to restore balance to the Force. Skywalker then asked about the "other Skywalker," who Kenobi told him was his long-lost twin sister, who had been separated from him at birth to protect them from the wrath of the Empire. Skywalker instantly came to the realization that this sister was Organa, which was confirmed by Kenobi. Skywalker almost immediately inquired about their mother's identity and fate, but Kenobi asked him to let that truth stay with him for a while longer, as he knew Skywalker carried too many burdens already. ====Adventure on the moon==== {{Quote|General, count me in.''"''
''"''I'm with you too!|Leia Organa and Luke Skywalker agreeing to join the team|}} [[File:Luke_on_Endor.jpg|thumb|left|215x215px|Skywalker left his allies on Endor, believing he endangered the mission.]] Skywalker nevertheless accompanied his friends on the mission to the forested [[moon]] of [[Endor]] to destroy the [[Death Star's shield generator|shield generator]] that protected the [[DS-2 Death Star II Mobile Battle Station]] in [[orbit]], volunteering immediately upon arrival at the Rebel briefing above [[Sullust]]. As they approached the moon on the stolen [[Lambda-class T-4a shuttle|''Lambda''-class Imperial shuttle]] ''[[Tydirium]]'', Skywalker sensed Vader's presence on the nearby [[Executor-class Star Dreadnought|Super Star Destroyer]] ''[[Executor]]'' and realized his presence was endangering the mission; yet, it was his presence that prompted Vader to allow their landing. Upon doing so, the Rebel force was discovered by a small force of [[Scout trooper|Imperial scout troopers]] that were guarding the shield bunker, and Skywalker and Organa pursued them on [[74-Z speeder bike|speeder bikes]]. Though they successfully stopped the scouts, Organa became separated from Skywalker. Upon learning of her disappearance, Solo, Skywalker, Chewbacca, and the droids went looking for her, only to be captured by a tribe of [[Ewok]]s. Using the Force to prove C-3PO's [[Deity|deific]] "[[Magick|magic]]," Skywalker convinced the Ewoks to release them and, after C-3PO's tale of their adventures, the whole group was accepted as a part of the [[Bright Tree Village|village]]. However, Skywalker felt as Vader reached out to him through the Force and landed on the moon, and knew that he had to confront Vader. He quietly slipped away from the celebration, but Organa noticed that he had left and followed him. He informed her of what he was planning to do and also told her that, in the event that he did not make it back, she would the last hope of the Alliance, going on to tell her that she was his sister, and she could use the Force too. Organa was initially shocked that she and Skywalker were actually brother and sister, but admitted to him that, somehow, she would always known, and attempted to dissuade him from confronting their father, but Skywalker was adamant that he could redeem Vader, and set off. Eventually encountering an Imperial patrol and willingly surrendering himself to Commander [[Altadan Igar|Igar]],''[[Star Wars: Geektionary: The Galaxy from A - Z]]'' Skywalker was brought to Vader and tried to convince his father to renounce the dark side by referring to him as "Anakin Skywalker," but Vader harshly denounced his former name. Although he managed to make Vader question the dark truths that had long ruled him, Skywalker ultimately became a prisoner of the Emperor as he was escorted to his [[Emperor's Throne Room|throne room]] onboard the Death Star. ====The final duel==== {{Quote|If you will not be turned, you will be ''destroyed''! Young fool. Only now, at the end, do you understand. Your feeble skills are no match for the power of the dark side. You have paid the price for your lack of vision! Now, young Skywalker…you will die.|Darth Sidious to Luke Skywalker|}} Palpatine retained a consistent belief that Skywalker would become his new apprentice and replace Vader, even making the claim to a spectre of Yoda that appeared before him. As Skywalker was brought before the Emperor, the Dark Lord of the Sith repeatedly told the young Jedi that he would fall to the dark side just as easily as Vader had, and let him know that he had purposely allowed the Alliance to discover the second Death Star's location in order to lure them into a trap and finish them off once and for all. [[File:DeathStarDuel-RotJAVA.png|thumb|right|250px|Skywalker confronted Vader on the second Death Star, believing he could redeem his father in spite of the Emperor's control over him.]] In order to temper Skywalker's negative emotions, Sidious forced him to watch as the [[Imperial Navy|Imperial Fleet]] [[Battle of Endor|engaged]] the Rebels. He constantly encouraged Skywalker to give into his anger and hatred. Though Skywalker was resistant at first, his feelings of hopelessness and desperation only grew as the destruction of the Rebel fleet and the death of his friends appeared imminent. Attempting to strike down the Emperor, Skywalker found himself once again facing his father in a duel. Unlike their previous encounter on Bespin (where Vader was largely able to dominate the proceedings, throughout), this time the pair would fight as equals. [[File:FullofSurprises-SWQ155.png|thumb|left|250px|Skywalker attempted to reason with Vader in an attempt to redeem him to the light side of the Force.]] After successfully parrying a flurry of blows, Skywalker sent Vader tumbling down a stairwell before regaining his composure and appealing to the good in his father. Vader would have none of it and attacked once again, though eventually Skywalker withdrew from combat altogether and refused to fight Vader any further, retreating into the shadows of the throne room. In order to goad his son back into fighting him, Vader used [[telepathy]] to probe his thoughts, learning of the existence of his daughter and Skywalker's twin sister, stating that perhaps she could be seduced to the dark side if Skywalker could not. This statement pushed Skywalker over the edge and caused him to finally give into his rage. Attacking his father much more aggressively this time, he unleashed his full might upon the Sith Lord. Eventually pushing Vader into a corner, right next to the Death Star's reactor shaft, Skywalker repeatedly struck him with multiple heavy blows, and with one final, devastating strike of his lightsaber, sliced Vader's hand off at the wrist, sending it—and the weapon it still gripped—cascading down into the depths below. [[File:CrispyFriedSkywalker-RotJAVA.png|thumb|right|250px|Skywalker was tortured by Darth Sidious for his defiant nature and his refusal to turn to the dark side of the Force]] A cackling Sidious, delighted that Skywalker had not only given into his hatred, but made use of it to such an extent, encouraged him to deliver the killing blow to his father and take his place as his apprentice. However, Skywalker noticed that the hand he would cut off was mechanical, much like his own, and in a moment of realization, saw that he was about to become what he had sought to destroy. Skywalker tossed his lightsaber aside and defiantly declared to the Emperor that he had failed, and that he was a Jedi like his father before him. Infuriated that his plan to corrupt Luke had gone up in smoke, Sidious declared that, if Skywalker would not be turned, he would be destroyed, and unleashed a barrage of [[Force lightning]] against him. Unprepared for the lightning, Skywalker desperately tried to protect himself, to no avail. During the Sith master assault on the Jedi Knight, Vader had gotten back to his feet and returned to his master's side, and Luke begged his father to save him. Eventually, seeing his son in such terrible pain became too great for Vader to bear any longer, and in that moment, the Sith Lord Darth Vader was gone, and the Jedi Knight Anakin Skywalker was reborn. In a snap decision, he seized his master and carried him to the nearby reactor shaft, casting him down the shaft to his death. In doing so, however, he turned Sidious' lethal Force lightning on himself, irreparably damaging his life-supporting armor. ====Anakin's redemption==== {{Quote|Now, go, my son. Leave me.''"
"''No. You're coming with me. I'll not leave you here. I've got to save you!''"
"''You already have, Luke. You were right. You were right about me. Tell your sister… you were right.|Anakin Skywalker and Luke Skywalker|audio=YouWereRight.flac|}} [[File:Anakinredeemed.png|thumb|left|260x260px|Vader found redemption through his son and fulfilled the prophecy of the Chosen One before ultimately dying as Anakin Skywalker.]] Luke carried Anakin to Imperial shuttle ''[[ST 321]]'', where his father asked him to remove his breathing mask. Though Luke was hesitant to do so, convinced that his father would die without it, Anakin told him that nothing could prevent his death now, but before he died, he wanted to look upon his son with his own eyes. Luke relented and removed the mask, gazing upon his father's real face for the first and only time. Anakin then encouraged Luke to leave him and save himself. Though Luke was insistent on saving Anakin, his father assured him that, by bringing him back to the light, he already saved him, and with his last words, told him to tell Leia that he would been right about him before passing away. At the cost of his own life and with the help of his son, Anakin Skywalker had finally fulfilled his destiny as the Chosen One and had brought balance to the Force.{{Databank|luke-skywalker-biography-gallery|Luke Skywalker Biography Gallery}} Similarly, by helping his father to return to the light side of the Force by offering him unconditional love and refusing to fight, destroy, or let his anger eclipse the goodness in his [[heart]], Luke Skywalker had achieved what Anakin and the whole Jedi Order failed to achieve upon being twisted by the Clone Wars: to forgive a monster and reveal a man.''[[Skywalker: A Family at War]]'' [[File:Celebration_on_Endor.png|thumb|right|260x260px|Skywalker celebrated the Rebel Alliance's victory over the Galactic Empire with his family and friends.]] Skywalker took his father's body on board the shuttle and escaped just before the Death Star's destruction, when he was almost intercepted by [[Green Squadron (Rebel Alliance)|Green Squadron]]{{'s}} Shara Bey, who proceeded to cover him from [[TIE/IN interceptor|TIE interceptors]] after he identified himself.[[Shattered Empire 1|''Shattered Empire'' 1]] Back on Endor, Skywalker [[Funeral of Anakin Skywalker|cremated his father's armor]] (his body had vanished) in the manner of a [[Jedi funeral|Jedi's funeral]], and then joined his friends and sister in the celebration. It was during this moment of celebration that Skywalker saw the onlooking Force spirits of Kenobi, Yoda, and his father, looking at him in approval and with a sense of peace. ===Aftermath of Endor=== ====Shattered Empire==== {{Quote|When I saw Leia for the first time, she spoke of hope
And that is what she has always embodied for me.|Luke Skywalker officiating Leia and Han's wedding.|''[[The Princess and the Scoundrel]]''}} [[File:LukeLeiaHanGoodbye-BattleOfJakkuInsurgencyRising1.jpg|thumb|left|220px|Luke and the Rebels on Endor after the battle.]] Following the Battle of Endor, In the battle's aftermath, Skywalker reported to the Rebel Alliance that the Emperor and Darth Vader were dead. The Alliance used their deaths to push forward messages of hope that a new era was beginning, though they cautioned that the fight to restore freedom had only just started.[[Aftermath (novel)|''Aftermath'']] Skywalker and Organa also helped the Ewoks [[Kneesaa a Jari Kintaka|Kneesaa]] and [[Wicket Wystri Warrick|Wicket W. Warrick]] reset their traps to stop a [[Gorax]]. Sensing that Ewoks and Organa needed time to complete the task, Skywalker used his lightsaber to slice through a log that the Gorax had thrown at him before he threw his lightsaber to Organa to use to cut a log.{{FOD|Traps and Tribulations}} At some point, catching up with Leia as she walked, Skywalker expressed the desire to train her after sensing her feelings while she visited Anakin's funeral pyre. He told her that her anger shouldn't guide her, and wanted to teach her the ways of the Force, but she wasn't willing to do so. Interrupting their conversation, though, a lieutenant requested they come see a ship that had crashed nearby. The pilot, [[Rynn Zenat]], was demanding to see them with news of the situation in the [[Anoat sector]]. She told Skywalker and Organa about the mad self-declared [[Grand Moff]] [[Ubrik Adelhard]]'s crackdown and [[Iron Blockade|isolation of the sector]]. [[File:Wedding_of_Leia_Organa_and_Han_Solo.jpg|thumb|right|200px|Skywalker officiated the wedding between Leia Organa and Han Solo on Endor.]] Around the same time, Skywalker officiated the [[Wedding of Han Solo and Leia Organa|wedding]] between his sister and Solo, speaking about their history together and those they've lost on the way to that moment. In the days ahead, the Rebel Alliance began the formation of the [[New Republic]], a successor state to the Galactic Republic. The Empire, meanwhile, reeled from its defeat and its leadership was in chaos, and the Imperial government claimed that the reports of the Emperor's demise were treasonous propaganda.[[Shattered Empire 2|''Shattered Empire'' 2]] During this time, [[Operation: Cinder]] and the Emperor's [[Contingency]] began, causing chaos across the galaxy.[[Battle of Jakku — Insurgency Rising 2|''Battle of Jakku — Insurgency Rising'' 2]] On Endor, Rynn Zenat was preparing for the [[mission to the Anoat sector]], and wished Skywalker could help– but he declined as he was feeling something was calling him on [[Pillio]]. In a long goodbye to Zenat, Skywalker gave her hope and encouraged her to not resign herself to darkness. To keep fighting, for all that they've done so far. Zenat thanked Skywalker and remarked that he was a good teacher, and he reminisced about when the cause was simpler for him. Zenat told him to follow what was calling him, and this echoed in Luke's mind, bringing a pang of sadness, but also a haunting answer. ====Call to Pillio==== {{Quote|If the Empire is here, then what I sensed is true. There must be something special about this place.|Luke Skywalker to R2-D2|''[[Star Wars Battlefront II]]''}} [[File:LukeSearchForJediStuff-Timelines.png|thumb|300px|left|Skywalker and R2-D2 searched out Jedi lore together.]] Skywalker then followed his calling to Pillio in the [[Jinata system]], and, along with R2, took his X-wing and set course for the remote aquatic planet. When they [[Mission to Pillio|arrived]], the two came across an Imperial Shuttle making its descent, confirming Skywalker's suspicions that the planet held something of importance. He left his faithful Astromech Droid with his ship, and it was not long before the young Jedi encountered Stormtroopers on guard, who attacked him on sight. Skywalker made his way through several dozens of troopers and officers, remarking that the Empire must have been searching the planet. Sensing something unnatural from within a nearby cave, the Jedi found that native wildlife, [[Scritter]]s, were attacking the invading imperials. Hearing cries for help, Skywalker made his way further into the depths of the planet to find [[Del Meeko]], a member of [[Imperial Special Forces]] Unit [[Inferno Squad]], with his arm stuck in the amber of the Scritters. Despite their different allegiances, Skywalker used his lightsaber to cut through the amber and free the soldier. When Meeko asked why the Jedi helped him, Skywalker simply responded, 'Because you asked'. [[File:Inside_the_Pillio_Observatory.png|thumb|right|220px|Skywalker encountered Del Meeko during his search for the Emperor's Observatory on Pillio.]] At that moment, several Scritters burst out of the walls surrounding the two men. Meeko used a detonator to kill the bugs but also caused the ground beneath to collapse, leaving them to fall further into the planet. They landed in a small shallow stream of water, and Skywalker used the Force to protect Meeko from falling rocks. After being helped to his feet, Meeko remarked that stories of the Jedi always scared him as a young boy. Skywalker responded that if they want to get out, they'll need to work together. Making their way through the caves, Luke shared that the Force has brought them to together and apologizes for killing the rest of his men; he was reluctant to do so, but they left him no choice, while Meeko did. As the two made their way out of the cave, Del revealed that the Emperor had an observatory on the planet and that Meeko was tasked with destroying it. Skywalker and Meeko eventually escaped the cave and gained access to the observatory by destroying its defense system. Skywalker discovered that the key to opening the vault door is to use the Force, prompting Meeko to wonder why the observatory could only be opened by the Force and if the man who hunted down the Jedi was secretly one of them. Luke suggested that Del had learned to fear the wrong thing. The two investigated the vault, apparently full of junk, and Skywalker took a [[Jedi star compass|compass]]. When Meeko asked why he should be allowed to keep it, Skywalker responded, 'Because I asked'. As the two left, Skywalker remarked that the Empire had done enough damage to innocent worlds and that Meeko could choose not between the Empire or the Rebellion, but to be a better person. He wished the Force with Meeko before leaving. [[File:LukeAcolytes-BattleOfJakkuInsurgencyRising2.png|thumb|left|250px|Skywalker encountered the Acolytes of the Beyond during his time on Pillio.]] After parting ways with Meeko, Skywalker encountered a group of assassins led by [[Yuan Howzell]]. Howzell told him that she represented the [[Acolytes of the Beyond]], a cult which worshipped the Sith. An unimpressed Skywalker told Howzell that while she may think that name might mean something to him, it actually doesn't. Seeking to claim the compass, the assassins attacked Skywalker. Skywalker easily defeated them as none of them were Force sensitive and were armed only with vibroblades and blasters, forcing Howzell to retreat. At some point Skywalker was promoted to General.[[Alphabet Squadron (novel)|''Alphabet Squadron'']] ====Brotherly love==== {{Quote|This was never going to be easy, ''Leia''. We can't los hope.|Luke Skywalker comforting his sister|[[Battle of Jakku — Insurgency Rising 3|''Battle of Jakku — Insurgency Rising'' 3]]}} [[File:LukeLeiaChandrila-BattleOfJakkuInsurgencyRising3.jpg|thumb|right|200px|Skywalker briefly visited his sister on Chandrila at the very beginning of the New Republic.]] After the mission to Pillio, Skywalker went to [[Chandrila]], the provisional home of the nascent New Republic. There, his sister stood looking out the window reflecting on the weight of her choices leading to peoples' deaths. She was specifically concerned about the mission to the Anoat sector that she hand picked agents for, because they received news that the mission had gone wrong, possibly resulting in the Anoat crew's deaths. Skywalker reassured her that their jobs were never going to be easy, but Organa confessed that she'd felt like Endor was the end, while now it feels like they've had to start over to fight Adelhard and the rest of the shattered Empire. Organa called this "a new darkness", but her brother pushed back– Skywalker said that even in the darkest of times, if you look close enough, you can find the light. After this reassurance, Luke departed for the Anoat sector to do something about this himself. ====Anoat sector rescue==== {{Quote|You're not a Sith. Just a ''pretender''. Reveal yourself."''
''"Oh Jedi...how little you truly know...how little you understand—about me, about''the Acolytes''...about ''yourself''.|Luke Skywalker and Reyna Oskure after the Jedi subdued the Anzati.|[[Battle of Jakku — Insurgency Rising 4|''Battle of Jakku — Insurgency Rising'' 4]]}} [[File:LukeOnScepter-BattleOfJakkuInsurgencyRising3.jpg|thumb|160px|left|Luke Skywalker arrives onboard the ''Scepter''.]] In the Anoat sector, the New Republic's mission had gone south thanks to the newly forged [[Adelhard coalition|alliance]] between Moff Adelhard's forces and the [[Spice Runners of Kijimi]]. The New Republic agents' [[Barloz-class medium freighter|freighter]] ''[[Oggrud]]'' had been damaged incapacitating the Spice Runners, was captured, and the crew was being held on Adelhard's flagship [[Scepter (Imperial-class)|''Scepter'']]. The group, consisting of Rynn Zenat, Kes Dameron, [[Therisa Alern]], and [[Jarek Yeager]] was freed by implanted New Republic spy [[Kith Alaytia]], but came into trouble in the form of the hulking Commander [[Bragh]] and a cloaked, [[Double-bladed spinning lightsaber|lightsaber]]-wielding figure. That was, until Luke Skywalker boarded the ''Scepter'' and fought countless stormtroopers to stand down Bragh and the figure. A duel began between Skywalker and the cloaked figure, who taunted him about his Jedi heritage. But as sabers clashed, Skywalker's abilities in the Force and lightsaber technique proved to be too much for his opponent, knocking the lightsaber out of her hand and onto the ground. Luke stood in front of the kneeling being, but Commander Bragh charged at him, only to be shot in the back by [[Preeti]], Rynn Zenat's girlfriend and former squadron-mate who was also captured onboard. Then, from the other end of the hallway, stormtroopers arrived and began firing at the New Republic agents. Meanwhile, Skywalker held his lightsaber in front of the figure, the two exchanging barbs until the woman removed her hood, revealing her identity as [[Reyna Oskure]], Adelhard's counselor and blade. She told Luke that Adelhard was doing the unthinkable, and would create a new Empire to fill the vacuum left behind after Vader and Palpatine's deaths, and that Luke couldn't stop that, before being tied up. [[File:ReynaVsLuke-InsurgencyRising4.jpg|thumb|230px|right|Duel onboard the ''Scepter''.]] Skywalker then told the freed crew to take the captive Oskure and Bragh to find a ship and escape, but Zenat protested, wanting Luke to come with. Oskure mocked Skywalker's nobility, and said Adelhard was waiting for him, as the group left for the docking bay. Skywalker, now alone, threw off his cape and set off intent on finding and stopping the mad Moff who had gone too far– Luke wanted the man to see consequences for his actions. Simultaneously, the crew that was escaping was cornered by stormtroopers and lost their captives, and the ship began to shake, being fired upon by a small New Republic fleet under Lando Calrissian's command. In the now-shaking Star Destroyer's control room, Luke came upon the scheming Adelhard, lightsaber ignited, surrounded by stormtroopers. Skywalker told the man that his reign was over, but Adelhard told him it was just beginning, as the stormtroopers fired. Expertly dodging and deflecting blaster bolts while taking out stormtroopers left and right, the Jedi advanced across a narrow bridge toward Adelhard, eventually using the Force to throw the remaining stormtroopers off of the bridge. [[File:LukeAdelhardStandoff-InsurgencyRising4.jpg|thumb|240px|left|Skywalker confronts Moff Adelhard.]] The two men now stood alone as a comm transmission came through warning Adelhard about the Republic ships encroaching on the ''Scepter''. As Skywalker was saying that Adelhard needed to stand trial for what he'd done, the entire ship rocked, knocking Luke off of his feet and onto the ground. Adelhard, still standing, then went to kick Skywalker in the head, but he blocked it with his forearm, and used the Force to draw his lightsaber back to him. As the Moff continued to kick Skywalker, he ignited his lightsaber and quickly slashed the bridge in two spots, causing the rogue Imperial to fall below with his fallen troopers. This allowed Luke to run to the docking bay and help his friends escape, lodging debris in front of a crowd of stormtroopers, allowing them all to board a freighter. With this ship, they blasted out of ''Scepter''{{'s}} docking bay as Skywalker told the rest that the conflict with Adelhard is far from over, and that the man was intent on seizing something he felt he was promised: the Empire. ====Training his sister==== =====Becoming a teacher===== {{Quote|You're going to make me a better teacher.''"
"''What do you mean?''"
"''Your footwork is terrible. Don't get me wrong, your lightsaber craft is coming along, but…you do other things. Naturally. What I mean is, you're exceptional. Just…different.|Skywalker and Organa during the latter's training|''[[Star Wars: The Rise of Skywalker: Expanded Edition]]''}} [[File:Luke-Leia-training.jpg|thumb|right|250px|After the Battle of Endor, Skywalker's sister became his first apprentice.]] At some point after the Battle of Endor, Skywalker took on his first student and trained his twin sister in the ways of the Force. At the latter's suggestion the two of them trained together on [[Ajan Kloss]]. Under his tutelage, Organa constructed [[Leia's lightsaber|her lightsaber]], and began to learn the principles of lightsaber combat. Skywalker also instructed in her in the basics of the Force, teaching her about light side, and in meditation. He was impressed by Organa's strength in the Force and how quickly she progressed in her training. While training her, he found it interesting that she struggled with skills and concepts that he had a natural affinity for (like lightsaber combat), but excelled in other areas (like meditation) that were harder for him to master. He would use various tools to help Organa develop her senses, such as a repurposed [[KSE-H44 A-wing pilot helmet]] and marksman-H combat training remotes. At some point during their training together, Skywalker and Organa spent an hour sparring with their lightsabers. Later that same day, Skywalker attempted to teach her in a scenario similar to what he did with Yoda on Dagobah, where she held herself up in a handstand with the Force. At another point, Skywalker explained from personal experience that the Force allowed glimpses of the future, past, and at times, departed, and that these voices would offer her guidance from beyond death in times of hardship. =====The Archivist's Holocron===== {{Quote|Here. I'll activate it for you.''"
"''This doesn't look like the other ones.''"
"''Well it's definitely a holocron of some kind, but I've never seen another like it. It responds to…well. You'll see it'll answer your questions though. I know it did for me.|Skywalker and Organa on the Archivist's Holocron|}} Sometime during Organa's training, the two discovered a [[The Archivist's Holocron|holocron]] that contained the story of Lady [[Qi'ra]], the former leader of Crimson Dawn, and her [[war against the Sith]] that she had carried out between 3 ABY and 4 ABY shortly before the fall of the Empire. Skywalker had listened to it beforehand and it had answered his questions, so he activated wit for Organa using the light side of the Force. He agreed with Organa that it was unusual for a holocron despite definitely being one, telling her she would see why and assuring her it would answer her questions.[[Crimson Reign 1|''Crimson Reign'' 1]] As the Archivist described Qi'ra's plans to kill Vader and Palpatine, Skywalker lamented that Qi'ra had never come to them for help and instead kept everything secret and did it by herself. Organa suggested it was because Qi'ra was not trusting.[[Hidden Empire 1|''Hidden Empire'' 1]] The Archivist suggested that the Rebel Alliance had perhaps been engineered by Palpatine, which Skywalker said the Archivist at at lest gotten wrong, but Organa pointed out that while he did not create it, he definitely used it. When she described the presence of Darth Vader as feeling like you were in the presence of an animal eating its own young, Skywalker held onto that idea and repeated it out loud.[[Hidden Empire 3|''Hidden Empire'' 3]] [[File:LukeAndLeiaHolocron-HiddenEmpire5.jpg|thumb|left|250px|Skywalker and Organa with the Archivist's Holocron]] At the end of the story, the Archivist said that Qi'ra had failed to take down the Sith and saw her hidden empire of Crimson Dawn destroyed, even theorizing that Qi'ra had been killed by the Empire or its [[Imperial holdouts|remnants]] as she had never seen her again. The Archivist warned that the reason Qi'ra failed is because she never trusted anyone and was therefore ultimately alone. Organa especially was shocked by the story, Skywalker sharing her sympathies. He told Organa that the Archivist had been wrong, however, in saying that Qi'ra had failed to take down the Sith and the Empire, as Crimson Dawn agents had been the ones that revealed the existence of the second Death star to the rebellion, Leia adding that Qi'ra's syndicate war had allowed the Rebellion to regroup by distracting Palpatine. Skywalker postulated that because nothing happens in a vacuum, Qi'ra had touched the galaxy and saved it from the Sith, just not in the way she thought. Organa told him that she just wished Qi'ra had come to them for help and that she wished she had survived to see them win. Unbeknownst to them, however, Qi'ra had survived. =====Leia's final training session===== {{Quote|It was the last night of her training. Leia told me that she had sensed the death of her son at the end of her Jedi path. She surrendered her saber to me and said one day it would be picked up again by someone who would finish her journey.|Luke Skywalker, to Rey|}} On the final night of her training, Organa experienced a dark vision that her Jedi path would lead to the death of her [[Ben Solo|son]]. Realizing where the galaxy needed her most, she set aside her lightsaber to focus on her new family and [[New Republic Senate|senatorial]] duties. While Skywalker hoped that his sister would resume her training later on, Organa gave him her lightsaber to convince him otherwise, asking to pass it on to a promising student someday. However, Skywalker did not do that and never told her where he stored her lightsaber. ====Recovering Force trees==== {{Quote|And ''why'' exactly are we doing this?''"
"''Because in the ''lab'' at the heart of that base is something the Emperor ''stole'' a long time ago. We're taking it ''back''.|Shara Bey and Luke Skywalker|[[Shattered Empire 4|''Shattered Empire'' 4]]}} [[File:LukeSkywalkerSharaBey-ShatteredEmpire4.png|thumb|right|240px|Skywalker and Shara Bey recovered the last fragments of the Great Tree from the Imperial research base on Vetine.]] In [[5 ABY]],''[[Star Wars: Galactic Atlas]]'' says that Shara Bey and [[Kes Dameron]] moved to [[Yavin 4]] in [[5 ABY]]. They moved shortly after the mission to [[Vetine]], placing this event in 5 ABY. three [[Standard month|months]] after the Battle of Endor, Skywalker planned a [[Mission to Vetine|mission]] to an [[Imperial base (Vetine)|Imperial research base]] on the planet [[Vetine]] in order to retrieve the last remaining fragment of a [[Great Tree (Coruscant)|Force-sensitive tree]]. The [[Uneti tree|tree]], which once dwelled in the heart of the Jedi Temple on Coruscant, was stolen by the Emperor after he came to power and converted the Jedi Temple into the Imperial Palace. Skywalker recruited Shara Bey to fly as his co-pilot on the mission, and, along with Artoo, they flew a stolen Imperial shuttle, ''[[Antarra]]'', to Vetine. While en route, Skywalker told Bey about the plan, including how she would pose as ISB Agent [[Alecia Beck]], using codes obtained by Solo and the Pathfinders during a [[Raid at the Wretch of Tayron|raid]] on an ISB base at the [[Wretch of Tayron|Wretch]] of [[Tayron]]. Upon their arrival, Bey claimed she was Agent Beck and that she had arrived to perform an unannounced inspection. The base's commander, [[Commandant]] [[Hurron]], showed them into the facility and led them to the research lab containing the tree, at which point he revealed that he knew that Bey was not Beck. Hurron questioned why two Rebels would break into the facility, and Skywalker explained the importance of the tree—which he found had two remaining fragments. Skywalker and Bey fought their way out of the base, making their way through numerous stormtroopers who attempted to stop their escape. Once back at ''Antarra'', Hurron ordered his forces to throw thermal detonators at the escaping Rebels, but Skywalker used the Force to deflect them back, killing Hurron and several of his stormtroopers in an explosion. The Rebel trio made their way back towards the Alliance Fleet. During the trip back, Skywalker and Bey discussed the latter's future plans for service in the Rebellion, as Skywalker knew that Bey was considering leaving the Alliance to reunite with her husband, Pathfinder Sergeant Kes Dameron, and their son Poe. Bey was unsure as to whether she wanted to leave the Rebels behind, but Skywalker's guidance helped Bey decide to leave the Alliance. The Jedi Knight gifted one of the tree fragments to her, as he had only expected to find one, believing that the important relic would be kept safe with Bey and her family.
