She and Dameron planted it outside of their [[Wetyin's Colony|new home]] on Yavin 4. ====The Lehanis affair==== {{Quote|The walls are closing in on you, Jedi—and on your friends. As they struggle to build something, the shadows will—"''
''"You talk too much. But that might help me.|Yuan Howzell and Luke Skywalker while dueling on Lehanis.|[[Battle of Jakku — Republic Under Siege 1|''Battle of Jakku — Republic Under Siege'' 1]]}} [[File:LukeRynnVsAcolytes-RepublicUnderSiege1.jpg|thumb|190px|left|The Acolytes of the Beyond ambush Skywalker and Rynn Zenat on Lehanis.]] Some time later, Skywalker was on the Outer Rim swamp planet [[Lehanis]] with Rynn Zenat, hunting for a [[Ky Narec's Compendium|compendium]] belonging to Jedi [[Ky Narec]]. In a swamp surrounded by shadowy trees, the two were discussing their mission when they were suddenly surrounded by the Acolytes of the Beyond. Seeing this threat, Skywalker drew his lightsaber and Zenat her blaster. The two fought the many Acolytes, all of whom had [[electrostaff]]s and surrounded the New Republic's heroes. In the battle, the Acolytes were going for the relic, which Zenat mockingly called a "rusty sundial" to Luke's chagrin. Then, Acolyte leader Yuan Howzell removed her hood and confronted Skywalker personally, saying that they were playing a game, and that the Acolytes had already won. But the fight continued, Skywalker realizing that this was all a trap and that they needed to leave. But the Acolytes raged on, Howzell now targeting Zenat and knocking the artifact on to the ground, injuring the pilot. Skywalker then struck Howzell, the two engaging each other in solo combat. As Howzell continued to try to intimidate Skywalker, he slashed her once more with his lightsaber, pinning her on the ground. Skywalker then asked Howzell what Adelhard was planning next, and she didn't cooperate, telling him that a true Jedi wouldn't threaten someone. But then Zenat stepped in, saying that she would be the one doing the threatening, and that Adelhard had tried to kill her twice. While Zenat aimed her gun at Howzell, her and Skywalker saw someone grabbing the artifact from the ground where it laid. Skywalker then shot up and the two chased this thief back to their X-Wing. It was, of course, the dastardly Doctor Chelli Aphra, who was thankful that Skywalker had made finding the compendium so easy. Aphra then threw the compendium back to Skywalker, who questioned why she'd stolen it. Aphra avoided answering directly, instead saying that she was there to warn Skywalker– as a gigantic [[Klyff'wat]] emerged from the woods, attacking the three. They all ran from the beast, until Skywalker spotted a clearing, igniting his lightsaber to hold off the Klyff'wat while his friends made it to the clearing.[[Battle of Jakku — Republic Under Siege 2|''Battle of Jakku — Republic Under Siege'' 2]] [[File:LukeAphraRynn-RepublicUnderSiege1.jpg|thumb|160px|right|Skywalker, Aphra, and Zenat run from the dreaded Klyff'wat.]] Running up a large branch, Skywalker slashed the Klyff'wat several times, not wanting to hurt the creature but needing to leave Lehanis as soon as possible. As the beast falls, Luke turns to Aphra, asking what she was there to warn him about. Holding the compendium, Aphra tells Skywalker that it took her less than a minute to determine it was fake– and someone wanted to distract Luke from somewhere else he was probably supposed to be. Aphra had come across intel about Adelhard seeking to push outward instead of just focusing on the Anoat sector like he had been. Luke and Rynn breaking for their starfighters, Zenat stopped Skywalker, asking what was wrong. He said he was longing for the simplicity of Rynn's life as a pilot, which caused Zenat to keep asking. Luke then expressed his regret at not confirming Adelhard's demise on the ''Scepter'', as the Imperial tried to trick the eager Jedi with an artifact, pulling him away from the conflict at hand. ====Targeted by Adelhard==== {{Quote|Back away from him, assassin. You only get one shot to strike at the heart of the Republic—and you missed.|Leia Organa standing down Kranor, the bounty hunter sent to kill Luke Skywalker on Chandrila|[[Battle of Jakku — Republic Under Siege 3|''Battle of Jakku — Republic Under Siege'' 3]]}} right As Skywalker had caused trouble for Moff Adelhard in the Anoat sector, the Imperial warlord placed a bounty on the young Jedi. After the mission to Lehanis, former [[Cloud-Riders|Cloud-Rider]] [[Weazel]] brought information about the bounty on Skywalker to Adelhard's Spice Runner allies, but [[Zeva Bliss]] revealed that she was already aware of Adelhard targeting Skywalker. This was a surprise to Bliss's lieutenant Tomasso, who then decided to leak this information to New Republic spy [[Calder Behrens]] to protect Skywalker. Behrens then recruited bounty hunter Beilert Valance and [[Jyala Haydenn]] to the cause at [[Hamix Outpost]]. [[File:KranorVsLuke-BattleOfJakkuRepublicUnderSiege3.jpg|thumb|left|240px|Skywalker and Kranor duel on Chandrila.]] Back on Chandrila, Skywalker had returned to his sister to inform her about what Doctor Aphra had told him: Adelhard wanted them divided, and was working to make that so. But as they were discussing a transmission from Behrens, Mon Mothma burst into the room with even more information from the same spy. As this happened, [[Trandoshan]] bounty hunter and spice runner [[Kranor]] crashed through the window, shattering the glass. Skywalker ignited his lightsaber and dueled the hulking hunter's vibroblade. As the two fought, Kranor mentioned the recent death of senator [[Mirim Kess]] before powerfully slashing and knocking down Skywalker. As Kranor raised his blaster at his enemy he was shot in the arm by Leia, giving Luke enough time to rise and strike back with his lightsaber. As the Skywalker twins held their weapons at the disarmed hunter, Luke asked who he worked for. Kranor then dove at and attacked Mothma before the pregnant Organa blasted him. Skywalker then struck once more, causing the Trandoshan to leap back out the window after telling Luke that the message was that no one is safe, not even him. This attack was followed up by another where [[Lan-Drus]] killed Calder Behrens, threatening Skywalker. ====Striking back==== {{Quote|There's a madman trying to undercut our goal of establishing this Republic. Do we think by ''ignoring'' him he'll go away? You heart what Lando said—They barely got out alive. If we just hope Adelhard disappears, we'll be sorely disappointed sooner than we'd like.|Luke Skywalker discussing plans on Chandrila|[[Battle of Jakku — Republic Under Siege 4|''Battle of Jakku — Republic Under Siege'' 4]]}} In the Anoat sector, Lando Calrissian was still leading a task force fighting against Adelhard's Iron Blockade, but Chandrila had heard little from them, leading to unease from Admiral Ackbar and Mon Mothma. The galaxy was in chaos and war still raged, and the New Republic simply didn't have enough ships to finish off the Empire like they wanted to. Suddenly, two ships entered Chandrilan airspace: Calrissian and the pilot Preeti had returned from the Anoat sector with news. Meanwhile, Skywalker discussed military deployments with his sister. Organa was once again haunted by the decisions lying in front of her, mainly potentially asking Ackbar to offer more ships to the campaign against Adelhard, or just leaving him alone. Skywalker tried to comfort her, while she wanted none of it, reminding him that Adelhard was actively working to assassinate senators as they spoke. Then, Zenat entered, getting Skywalker and Organa for a meeting called by Mothma regarding the information Calrissian brought in. [[File:LukesPlan-BattleOfJakkuRepublicUnderSiege4.jpg|thumb|right|235px|Skywalker explains his plan for dealing with the situation in the Anoat sector.]] Mothma informed the group that Behrens had died, but that he sent off a final batch of intel just before he did. This new intelligence revealed that Reyna Oskure was not as firmly allied to Adelhard as they once though, but also that the Imperial remnant, led by the mysterious [[Gallius Rax]], was seeking to confront the New Republic at [[Jakku]] in a [[Battle of Jakku|final confrontation]]. The choice was now between mobilizing forces toward Jakku and monitoring the situation in the Anoat sector. A debate began, with Skywalker adamantly advocating for taking action against Adelhard, but Ackbar and Mothma didn't know if it was possible. Practically begging, Luke asked if Ackbar would permit himself, Calrissian, Zenat, and more taking a small attack force to the Anoat sector, using this as a chance to undercut Adelhard's coalition with the Acolytes and the underworld. In Calder Behrens' memory, Skywalker said it was time they struck back against the mad Moff Adelhard. [[File:LukesFleet-BattleOfJakkuRepublicUnderSiege4.jpg|thumb|left|210px|Skywalker gathers his forces near the Iron Blockade.]] Soon after, on the fringes of the Anoat sector, Skywalker gathered his forces with Valance, Haydenn, Preeti, and Zenat, preparing to get past the Iron Blockade and bring the fight to Adelhard. Valance had heard about a weak point in the blockade's Imperial sensor network from a smuggler he knows, and they were going to use that to enter in. As Skywalker and Valance spoke, the cyborg hunter described that this was personal for many, as Adelhard had almost crushed an entire [[Uprising]] in his sector. The Moff had killed many of his own people in the process, and some of Valance's friend, so this was personal for him too. [[File:AttackOnTheScepter-BattleOfJakkuRepublicUnderSiege4.png|thumb|250px|right|Skywalker's fleet engages the ''Scepter''.]] The New Republic's fleet found entering into the Anoat sector easier than they expected, thanks to Valance's friend's information, and launched an attack on the ''Scepter'', Adelhard's flagship. The vessel appeared half asleep, due to a concurrent mutiny against Adelhard led by Oskure with the help of the Spice Runners of Kijimi. Skywalker's forces rapidly engaged the ''Scepter'', led by Luke's X-Wing, striking hard while the Star Destroyer's crew was caught unawares. Then, Preeti noticed something launch from the ''Scepter'', but Zenat dismissed it as debris. A broadcast then went out to New Republic forces: the voice of Reyna Oskure said that Ubrik Adelhard was dead. The Anzati witch was insistent that Skywalker's fleet should leave, claiming she was now in control of the Anoat sector and had Imperial reinforcements coming to bolster her forces. Upon hearing this, Calrissian told Skywalker he'd received word from Ackbar saying to pull back, but Lando was wary of this choice. Skywalker and Zenat then agreed to do one last spot-check of the area before heading back, as the rest of Skywalker's forces there pulled out. Little did they know, though, Moff Adelhard was not killed. The man had left the ''Scepter'' in an escape pod with a small group of loyalists, surviving to fight another day. ====Galowyss grapple==== {{Quote|And after what happened in this sector—how close ''Adelhard'' came to derailing what we were trying to build... part of me needs to be sure he's gone. Forever.|Luke Skywalker talking to Rynn Zenat on Galowyss.|[[Battle of Jakku — Last Stand 1|''Battle of Jakku — Last Stand'' 1]]}} [[File:SkirmishonGallowyss-BattleOfJakkuLastStand1.png|thumb|left|320px|Skywalker and Zenat face off against Adelhard loyalist stormtroopers.]] After the fleet left, Valance left Skywalker and Zenat with a ship to continue searching for Adelhard. After two days, over Galowyss, the Luke and Rynn discussed the blip that was picked up near the ''Scepter''. Zenat was dismissive, calling it a false alarm, but Skywalker was insistent that Adelhard was still around, and wanted to make sure he was dealt with for good. They then landed on the rocky world, where Skywalker confessed that he was sensing something there, dark and festering, that was drawing him. Little did they know, a now-caped and tattered Adelhard had set up camp uphill from them– and two of his stormtroopers had spotted the Jedi and pilot. The mad Moff insisted that he was no longer a believer like Skywalker, and sent his forces to destroy the Jedi, demonstrating his rebirth into something new. [[File:AdelhardDeparts-BattleOfJakkuLastStand1.jpg|thumb|right|300px|Adelhard flees Galowyss.]] Soon after, the stormtroopers engaged Skywalker and Zenat, and the two fought fiercely, Luke deflecting countless blaster bolts back at the former Imperials. Skywalker pointed out that their disorganization was quite strange, as a trooper received a communication saying their ship was leaving. Hearing the trooper give this order, Skywalker and Zenat sprinted after them, coming upon a ''Lambda''-class shuttle being loaded. Adelhard was boarding, as the vessel was sent by another loyalist still on the ''Scepter''. Seeing this, Skywalker and Zenat rushed to the shuttle intent on stopping the warlord, but they just missed it. Adelhard was once again in the air, departing Galowyss with his loyalists. Frustrated, Skywalker and Zenat ran back to their ship. Once onboard, they received a transmission from Organa. She told them that there had been a [[Attack on Chandrila (Acolytes of the Beyond)|bombing on Chandrila]], and that Luke needed to return immediately. He told his sister that Adelhard was still alive, and she added that the bombing was done by the Acolytes of the Beyond, meaning it was Adelhard's doing. The madman, now in command of the ''Scepter'' and coalition once more, was seeking revenge. The two then took off, and Zenat questioned if they were even going to make it back to Chandrila in time to help with anything. But Skywalker reassured her that they could still do good there, as Leia was sure to still be threatened, and more importantly they needed to regroup to fight off Adelhard's now cornered and desperate forces.[[Battle of Jakku — Last Stand 2|''Battle of Jakku — Last Stand'' 2]] ====Pieces falling into place==== {{Quote|"We"? ''We'' have to head to Jakku. The battle has started—the Empire has unleashed ''everything'' on us. The Operator wanted us there—it was a trap. Now our friends are stranded.|Luke Skywalker talking to Rynn Zenat on Chandrila, after the Battle of Jakku had begun.|}} [[File:TheNewRepublicHeroes-BattleOfJakkuLastStand2.jpg|thumb|left|270px|The Skywalker twins are reunited with Han Solo and Mon Mothma.]] In a tower on Chandrila, Mothma, Organa, agent [[Bastion (agent)|Bastion]], and the recently returned Han Solo were waiting for Skywalker as he and Zenat entered the room. There was a brief and joyous reunion between the former-Rebel heroes, before the discussion shifted to Adelhard. Organa then told Skywalker about the recent attack and Bastion told him about the [[Dowutin]] Acolyte [[Saycos Hawn]] that was captured. The agent was concerned with Adelhard's resurgence, and especially how this chaos has frayed his relationships with both the Acolytes and the Spice Runners– and she wished luck to Lando's forces still fighting in the Anoat sector. Organa then interrogated Hawn, and as she left the chamber with news of Adelhard's plan to tip the scales at Jakku, Skywalker and the rest received a transmission. It was from the undercover Kith Alaytia, and confirmed what Leia had just heard: Adelhard had his sights set on Jakku, and wanted to tear down both the New Republic and Rax's Imperial remnant forces alike. Soon after, the Empire and New Republic's forces were gathering at Jakku. The New Republic Senate had allowed their fleet to participate thanks to the efforts of Solo and Mothma, and the end of the war was about to begin.''[[Aftermath: Empire's End]]'' From Chandrila, Skywalker and the rest monitored the situation on Jakku, particularly the consolidation of the Imperial fleet around the Super Star Destroyer ''[[Ravager]]''. Gallius Rax gave a rallying speech, and the gigantic battle began, Adelhard's forces still in the Anoat sector preparing. Meanwhile, Skywalker and Zenat stood on a landing pad to meet the newly-escaped Alaytia and Kranor, the assassin who had previously targeted Mothma. Rynn knew they were coming, and Skywalker was confused by this. Skywalker was adamant that they needed to be helping out at Jakku, but instead they were meeting on Chandrila. Luke wanted to fight Adelhard himself, but Zenat assured him that there was another way. Kranor then said that Adelhard relied too hard on his alliances, thinking them unbreakable, but Luke wasn't inclined to believe because Kranor was a Spice Runner. But then, Zenat revealed that she herself was a Spice Runner as well, surprising Skywalker. Zenat told him that she knew how to take down Adelhard's coalition, and that he needed to trust her– which he unequivocally did, the group setting off to even the odds. [[File:SauwecerCrew-BattleOfJakkuLastStand3.jpg|thumb|right|270px|Zenat leads Skywalker to Sauwecer to make moves against Adelhard.]] On the planet [[Sauwecer]], the group landed and Skywalker learned that the Spice Runner Tomasso was Zenat's adopted father after her parents were killed by the Empire. She was raised to become a Spice Runner, but left to join the Rebellion instead. Then, Tomasso himself emerged, confusing Kranor and Alaytia about where the Spice Runners stood in regard to Adelhard. Zenat then asked her father to pull back the Spice Runners, and Skywalker begged the man to help them. Tomasso explained that Zeva Bliss was not blindly allied with Adelhard, and promised he would try to convince her to turn the Spice Runners against him. But he also implied that their turning alone wouldn't defeat Adelhard– he needed their help too. ====Pirate ally & infiltration==== {{Quote|Well, 'bout time you showed up, ''Skywalker''—the party's getting good.|Eleodie Maracavanya while fighting the Adelhard coalition in the Anoat sector.|}} [[File:BattleInTheAnoat-BattleOfJakkuLastStand4.jpg|thumb|left|230px|Eleodie Maracavanya's Super Star Destroyer ''Liberty's Misrule'' engaged Adelhard's forces before they went to Jakku.]] As the Battle of Jakku raged, Tomasso spoke to Zeva Bliss and guaranteed that the Spice Runners would turn on Adelhard. Then, in the meantime, Skywalker and Zenat arrived in the Anoat sector, where Adelhard's forces were staging for the hyperspace jump to Jakku. There, they came upon pirate ruler [[Eleodie Maracavanya]] and zher Super Star Destroyer ''[[Liberty's Misrule]]'', which had arrived to take on Adelhard. Maracavanya greeted Skywalker, and his ship was fired upon by Adelhard's vessels until a rogue TIE fired on his attackers. This was Therisa Alern, still working to free the Anoat sector. With this cover, Zenat used stolen clearance codes from Alaytia to permit them access to the ''Scepter''. The shuttle haphazardly landed in its hangar as Alern was shot down outside, something that greatly impacted Zenat. Skywalker then reminded her that they needed to calmly take this chance, this incredible opportunity to make Alern's sacrifice mean something more. Skywalker and Zenat were now in place on the ''Scepter'', ready to take down Adelhard, and Maracavanya contacted Luke to let him know that zhe was taking too much damage. After essentially delaying the mad Moff, the pirate regent departed, as Adelhard's fleet prepared to jump to Jakku. ====Jedi at Jakku==== {{Quote|Your ship is falling apart, Adelhard. I didn't come to fight you. I came to ''save'' you.|Skywalker speaking to Urbik Adelhard on the bridge of the ''Scepter'' during the battle of Jakku|[[Battle of Jakku — Last Stand 4|''Battle of Jakku — Last Stand'' 4]]}} Jakku's orbit was completely filled with vessels, the Imperial fleet making a ring around the ''Ravager'' and facing off against the New Republic's [[Starhawk-class battleship|Starhawk]] battleships. As Starhawk ''[[Amity]]'' was rammed and destroyed by Star Destroyer ''[[Punishment]]'', Adelhard's fleet arrived, Skywalker onboard its lead ship. Just when he posed the greatest threat, Adelhard was backstabbed by Reyna Oskure and the Spice Runners at the same time. The Star Destroyer was falling apart, Zenat met up with the fleeing Anzati in the ''Scepter''{{'s}} halls, and Skywalker made his way toward the bridge. As the once-mighty ''Ravager'' fell to Jakku and the New Republic began to emerge victorious, Skywalker confronted the mad self-declared Grand Moff Adelhard for the last time. [[File:AdelhardVsLuke-BattleOfJakkuLastStand4.jpg|thumb|right|250px|Adelhard and Skywalker duel as the old state of the galaxy burns down around them.]] Entering the burning bridge with his saber ignited, Skywalker found a kneeling, battered man, consumed by his own madness, crouching in front of him. Adelhard questioned Luke's presence there, saying that he'd already won– but the young Jedi told the old Imperial that he wasn't there to fight him, he was there to save him as his ship was falling apart. Skywalker told him there was another path, one averse to darkness, but Adelhard responded to this with only a mad laugh at the idea of being saved. Insisting he was beyond salvation, the man swung at Skywalker with his [[Vibro-ax]], which Luke easily blocked. Skywalker wouldn't give up, though, and insisted that Adelhard could survive this and truly live, pushing him back with the Force. Ubrik then said that there was no way he could be saved or redeeemed to continue living, as that required a reason to live, and his reason, the Empire, was a lie. As he explained that this would be a shallow victory, he was shot in the chest by Zenat, who came up behind Skywalker. Luke insisted that they should save him, but Zenat told him that Adelhard had been gone for a long time. Zenat told Luke that she admired his hope, but it was time for them to go. In the ''Scepter''{{'s}} collapsing docking bay, Skywalker and Zenat ran out to meet the ''Millennium Falcon''– Han Solo had left Chandrila to join the battle and rescue them. The two boarded the old freighter, and remarked that it finally, truly felt like this was over. The ''Scepter'' exploded, and with it, Adelhard's dreams of conquest, as the heroes flew off, victorious, into a new era. ====War's end==== {{Quote|He's ''beautiful'', Leia--I'm so happy for you both...the three of you.''"
"''How does it feel to be an uncle, Luke? Maybe that'll keep you close and stop your wandering.|Luke Skywalker and Leia Organa discussing the birth of Ben|}} [[File:GalacticConcordance-BattleOfJakkuLastStand4.png|thumb|left|250px|Skywalker attended the signing of the Galactic Concordance between the Galactic Empire and the New Republic on Chandrila]] While the Battle of Jakku lingered on the desert world's surface, the Galactic Civil War came to an end on Chandrila with the signing of the [[Galactic Concordance]], a peace treaty between the Republic and the Empire that forced the Empire to remain within pre-established borders, though some of the remnants of the once-powerful military force had disappeared into the [[Unknown Regions]].''[[Star Wars: The Force Awakens: The Visual Dictionary]]''. Skywalker, along with many other notable individuals witnessed the signing of the Concordance between Mas Amedda and Mon Mothma overlooking Hanna City. [[File:TheSkywalkerSoloFamily-BattleOfJakkuLastStand4.jpg|thumb|right|250px|Skywalker visited his family shortly after the birth of his nephew Ben.]] Following the signing of the treaty, Leia gave birth to her and Han's son and Luke's nephew, [[Ben Solo]], on Chandrila. Skywalker visited the family shortly after Ben's birth where Leia hoped that Skywalker being an uncle would keep him closer to home. An [[Unidentified Imperial gunner|Imperial officer]] stationed on a Star Destroyer during the Battle of Jakku claimed to have seen the Jedi Knight using the Force and a lightsaber to dispatch Star Destroyers in space, causing them to crash into the surface of the planet. When the Star Destroyer crashed into the surface the officer said he was recovered by a figure who dragged him across the desert searching wreckage for other survivors. He also noted the man wore clothes similar to Luke Skywalker and talked about being raised in another desert.''[[The Legends of Luke Skywalker]]'' ===Reconstruction=== ====Freedom for the Nagai==== =====Fenril pirate attacks===== {{Quote|I—I don't know who they are…all I know is that they're pirates…hidden in the shadows…"''
''"Where are they striking next?|The Gran merchant being interrogated by Luke Skywalker|{{StoryCite|story=Past is Prologue|book=Free Comic Book Day 2025: Star Wars 1|bformatted=Free Comic Book Day 2025: ''Star Wars'' 1}}}} [[File:FenrilSkirmish-2025StarWars1.jpg|thumb|left|280px|Luke Skywalker flew in a skirmish against pirate forces outside the Fenril sector.]] Around [[6 ABY]],{{StarWars2025Date}} a group of planets in the [[Fenril sector]] known as the [[Fenril Consortium]] [[Fenril crisis|became fiercely independent]], unsatisfied with the New Republic's [[Raid on New Republic supplies|protection of their trading vessels]] and unwilling to cooperate with the new democracy. Just outside the Fenril sector, Skywalker was flying with a squadron of X-Wings to investigate the threat after an incident on a former Imperial space station over [[Maldran]].{{StarWars2025Date}} A dogfight began between the New Republic's fighters and starships accompanied by a modified Imperial Star Destroyer.[[Star Wars (2025) 1|''Star Wars'' (2025) 1]] After losing some fighters, Skywalker and fellow pilot Rynn Zenat flew down to a nearby planet following a crashing pirate vessel. A [[Nagai|gray-skinned]] man emerged with a vibroblade and charged at Luke and Rynn. Skywalker fought the man, and knocked him down. Drawing Luke close, the pirate warned the Jedi about who he's facing, and told him about a [[Ibo Truddispal|collector]] of Jedi artifacts on the planet [[Gadrilam]], who has a crown that will help Luke "learn the truth". He then told Luke to brace himself,[[Star Wars (2025) 2|''Star Wars'' (2025) 2]] as he detonated himself to cover his tracks, knocking Luke out. Awakening in a trance-like state, Skywalker departed straight for Gadrilam, confusing Zenat and taking off into hyperspace while telling her that he needed to investigate this alone. =====Mission to Gadrilam===== {{Quote|That pirate shared something before he died. Something I couldn't ignore.|Luke Skywalker to R2-D2 upon landing on Gadrilam|}} [[File:LukeOnGadrilam-2025StarWars2.jpg|thumb|right|200px|Luke Skywalker lands on Gadrilam]] On the snowy world of Gadrilam, Luke apologized to R2-D2 about the promptness and strangeness of [[Mission to Gadrilam|his actions]] as he rushed off towards a [[Unidentified village (Gadrilam)|village]], thinking of what the pilot had told him about: a crown that would reveal the truth, held by Ibo Truddispal. Thinking back to his previous studies, Luke recalled the [[Crown of Verity]], an artifact that, when worn, would cause the user to only be able to speak the absolute truth– but it was thought to be destroyed. In the village, Luke entered into a [[Unidentified bar (Gadrilam)|bar]] filled with patrons, many of whom were Nagai, just like the pirate. Luke entered and spoke with the [[bartender]], [[Hossalana]], who was dismissive of Luke asking about Truddispal. He was properly answered by the Nagai woman sitting next to him, [[Jesrit]]– who spotted that Luke was a Jedi. Angry, Hossalana screamed that they should leave the bar, as [[Gallana Venk]] and her gang entered the establshment, letting Luke know that they'd found his ship, and know he's a New Republic pilot on some kind of mission. Jesrit tried to leave as Luke asked her about Truddispal, which made Venk's men grab him, wondering why Luke was looking for him. Responding with the Force, Luke pushed them back, and took out his lightsaber, to everyone's surprise. [[File:LukeInTunnel-2025StarWars2.jpg|thumb|left|220px|Luke Skywalker enters the tunnel on Gadrilam]] Chaos ensued as the hostile Nagai charged at Skywalker and a battle commenced, but Skywalker quickly dispatched with his enemies, analyzing their body language and using their own tells against them. Eliminating them and incredibly determined, Skywalker scared off Venk and the rest of her men, as Luke pleaded with Jesrit to stay and help him. She had called Truddispal a smuggler, which Luke had never said, meaning she knew him. Jesrit tried to explain herself as just a simple laborer, but Luke, sensing a darkness on Gadrilam, requested her help once more. The two then went into the nearby woods by torchlight, Jesrit guiding Luke to the tunnel where Truddispal was held. Skywalker asked what Jesrit was doing on the barren world, to which she told him that she isn't there by choice, and was brought there with many of her people, the Nagai. Luke was confused, because Venk is also a Nagai, but Jesrit asserted that Venk is not truly one of them, and is a traitor to the followers of [[Garlev]]. Luke then told Jesrit his name, and tells her he wants to help, as it's what Jedi do. As they arrived at the tunnel, Jesrit told Luke that her people are forced laborers on Gadrilam, and that they need help, if he wants to– and, ever the Jedi, of course he does. Sent into the tunnel alone by Jesrit, Luke though about how the pilot knew far too much for this to be a normal situation, unlike false artifacts Luke had been fooled by before. Going deeper, Luke overheard Venk and her men speaking about him around an injured Ibo Truddispal, and approached, lightsaber lit. Venk tossed down the silver object she was holding– the Crown of Verity. Luke rushed forward and caught it, as Venk spoke ill Garlev's followers, frustrated at how prevalent they are. Venk then fired at Truddispal from point-blank range, killing the Jedi relic collector. As her and her men left, she introduced Luke to members of the [[Zantarrk Gang]], a group that had been terrorizing surrounding areas recently. Luke cut them down and ran away after one of them revealed that they took out the village, which he found to be true upon emerging from the tunnel's depths and seeing the fiery blaze. =====Departing Chandrila===== {{Quote|The Pirrosi and their allies in the Fenril sector have made it clear—they want to disrupt our plans on every front. I ''refuse'' to sit back and let that happen.|Leia Organa to Mon Mothma before departing for Kaltrais.|[[Star Wars (2025) 4|''Star Wars'' (2025) 4]]}} [[File:LeiaAlaytiaLeave-2025StarWars4.jpg|thumb|right|200px|Organa and Alaytia depart for Kaltrais, leaving Skywalker behind.]] Back on the New Republic's capital, Chandrila, Skywalker and Zenat stood amongst a collection of artifacts while pondering the Crown of Verity, and Luke expressed grief about the fate of the old Jedi Order. Zenat asked Skywalker what the Crown does, which Luke explained is that it allows the wearer to discern truth from lies, while also preventing them from telling lies. He connected this idea to the idea of Jedi identity, being part of a greater movement than just oneself. Then, his comms buzzed as Kith Alaytia was calling for help in a nearby docking bay. There, Mon Mothma was actively trying to stop Leia Organa from leaving the planet on a diplomatic [[mission to Kaltrais]], a world that was a valued member of the [[Galactic Republic|Old Republic]] but had rejected the New Republic's offer to join. Leia insisted that the Prime Minister [[Kezrin Almovar]]'s [[Pirros]]i forces and their Fenril Consortium allies wished to disrupt the New Republic's efforts there, and she wouldn't let that happen, as the New Republic already had enough trouble with the Consortium completely shuttering its borders to New Republic trade. Leia had a bad feeling about Kaltrais, as she'd spoken to President [[Tusvein Shoirin]] to arrange the meeting in-person, and he sounded "off". Skywalker and Zenat arrived to speak to Leia. Luke attempted to sway Leia into staying, but she was adamant about going, seeing Kaltrais as a great way to demonstrate that the New Republic cares about the planets that join it. Luke begged to accompany Leia, but his stalwart sister declined and boarded the transport with Alaytia, bound for Kaltrais. Meanwhile, the ''Millennium Falcon'' was back on Chandrila as well, and Skywalker and Zenat met in its cockpit with Han Solo and Beilert Valance, who had just returned from investigating the Zantarrk Gang, and found the Nagai Garlev dead on Cloud City. Solo was shocked at Leia departing for Kaltrais, and Valance told Skywalker that Garlev's killer was moving towards Kaltrais as well. Luke then began connecting the dots between the oppressed Nagai, the Zantarrk Gang, and the rising Fenril Consortium. He'd heard Garlev's name on his mission to Gadrilam, and knew that he was a freedom fighter. Luke told his friends about his investigations so far, saying that the Nagai have been part of the groups hitting their supply lines, which led to him discovering the Zantarrk Gang holding Nagai slaves. Solo said that that sounded correct, and Skywalker told him about Jesrit, the Nagai who mentioned Garlev. This confirmed that the Zantarrk were connected to both the supply line hits and Garlev's death, leading Skywalker and the rest to depart for the Fenril sector immediately. =====Fenril frenzy===== {{Quote|Now what's the fun in that?"''
''"Luke... the way this is all shaping up—it's gonna be ''anything'' but fun.|Luke Skywalker and Han Solo over Kaltrais|}} [[File:FalconCockpitFenril-2025StarWars4.jpg|thumb|left|200px|Luke and his allies receive Mon Mothma's transmission about Loradil.]] On Kaltrais, Leia's meeting with Shoirin had quickly gone awry because of the Zantarrk Gang's presence on the planet, breaking out into a firefight on the rocky world. As Skywalker and his allies arrived in the ''Falcon'', they were surrounded by Fenril Consortium vessels. The modified ships fired on the Corellian freighter, and it took lots of hits– until the antagonistic starships suddenly pulled back because of Shoirin's final act on Kaltrais. The world's defenses fired on grounded ships, and the attack was completely called off. This gave Organa and Alaytia an opening to escape in their shuttle into orbit, where they were contacted by the Consortium's true leader, the devious Reyna Oskure. The Anzati witch had been manipulating the situation from the beginning under the guise of being an "advisor". Skywalker and the rest of the ''Falcon''{{'s}} occupants then received a transmission from Chancellor Mothma, requesting that they go to the desert world [[Loradil]] to [[Mission to Loradil|investigate a New Republic trading vessel]] that had been shot down by Fenril affiliated Zantarrk Gang vessels. Luke and the rest heard audio from the crash site– the New Republic traders were in distress and apparently surrounded. [[File:LoradilHallways-2025StarWars5.jpg|thumb|right|210px|Luke Skywalker battles through the ''Providence''{{'s}} insides.]] Arriving on the sandy world, Skywalker and his allies emerged from the ''Falcon'' as he pointed out a crashed [[Confederacy of Independent Systems|Separatist]] vessel, a [[Providence-class Carrier|''Providence''-class carrier]]. There was blood on the ground near an opening into the carrier's insides, and the heroes entered, searching for the merchant crew. Its systems were not fully down, and Zenat was able to reengage power, bringing lights on and allowing the crew to explore more effectively. But as they continued, a group of [[B1-series battle droid|B1 battle droids]] led by a [[Unidentified green-plated ST-series military strategic analysis and tactics droid|tactical droid]] stopped them in their path, as even more appeared behind them. Luke ignited his lightsaber, and a battle started against the former Separatists that continued a long-ended war. During the chaos, Zenat was grabbed by droids and dragged away, and Skywalker followed her, as Solo and Valance destroyed the tactical droid. While Luke followed Zenat, the pilot took down her battle droid captors and escaped out into the sand, running towards the wreck of the ''Nechrim's Wake''. Back inside, Skywalker reunited with Solo and Valance, now fighting a [[droideka]], [[B2-series super battle droid|super battle droid]], and several [[BX-series droid commando|commando droids]]. The Jedi made quick work of them all, as the other two descended further into the carrier to look for anything that could help the fight. As Skywalker joined them, Solo found a pile of [[Phase II clone trooper armor|Phase II]] [[clone trooper]] armor,[[Star Wars (2025) 5|''Star Wars'' (2025) 5]] which they equipped, fighting their way outside into a huge field of not only battle droids, but [[Armored Assault Tank Mk I|Armored Assault Tanks]], concerned about saving Rynn Zenat and reflecting on the armor's storied history.[[Star Wars (2025) 6|''Star Wars'' (2025) 6]] [[File:MissionToLoradil-2025StarWars5.jpg|thumb|left|220px|The Clone Wars reignited– the battle on Loradil.]] Skywalker, Valance, and Solo fought countless [[OOM-series security droid|security droids]] in their armor, but after Solo destroyed a group of droids surrounding him, he and Valance lost track of Luke. The Jedi was out of sight, hiding under an AAT, calling upon Obi-Wan Kenobi and Yoda for help in the battle. The droids were catching on, though, and began to search under the tank– but Skywalker wasn't there! Suddenly, the inspecting droid was thrown upward into the tank's front, flying up to the tank's pilot, destroying them both. Luke used the Force to destroy the rest of them, and after eliminating the final droid with his lightsaber, headed forwards toward the ''Nechrim's Wake''. Inside the ''Wake'', Zenat had been saved by its captain, [[Gauvis]], and the [[Duros]] [[Finch]]. Then, a third figure emerged from the shadows– it was another Nagai named [[Marntiv]], a member of the [[Nagai rebellion]], who was being transported on the ''Wake''. The man revealed that he was the reason the Zantarrk Gang attacked the convoy, the supplies gained just being a bonus. They aligned themselves with Reyna Oskure and the Fenril Consortium for wealth and power, and are trying to squash the Nagai rebellion while using Nagai slaves as troops. Trying to get to Rynn and the ''Wake'', Luke lept into battle as his father did before him, destroying countless droids, while reminding himself that he must avoid the traps and temptations that got his father. As Solo ran towards the ''Falcon'', he was knocked down by an onslaught of droids, and as they closed in on him, the entire crew, Skywalker, Zenat, Valance, Gauvis, Finch, and Marntiv, destroyed the droids and rescued him. Han immediately suggested they head back to Chandrila, but Luke let him know that the Nagai were [[Insurrection on Kaltrais|rising up on Kaltrais]], a [[Bastion (agent)|New Republic agent]] was present, and it was the Nagai's only chance at freedom. The group, having survived the Separatist onslaught, then left for Kaltrais. =====Uprising at Kaltrais===== {{Quote|...You're jere...you can help..."''
''"I'm a Jedi, remember?
It's what we do, Jesrit.|Jesrit and Luke Skywalker, after meeting again during the Nagai insurrection on Kaltrais|[[Star Wars (2025) 7|''Star Wars'' (2025) 7]]}} [[File:JesritLukeKaltrais-2025StarWars7.jpg|thumb|right|240px|Reunited, Luke Skywalker and Jesrit fight the Zantarrk Gang.]] Soon after, the ''Millennium Falcon'' arrived over Kaltrais, but didn't receive any communications from the surface– something was wrong. And as the freighter descended further, towards a central city, blaster fire could be seen from the sky. As the entire New Republic team exited the ''Falcon'', Luke Skywalker ran forward, shocked to see the Nagai he met on Gadrilam, Jesrit, alive and leading the insurrection in the plaza! Amidst the chaos, and a reunion between Jesrit and Marntiv, Luke called out to Jesrit, and the two fought the pirate troopers together. They took out several as Luke explained that he's a Jedi, and that means coming back to help. He sadly informed her of Garlev's death, and the two kept fighting the oppressors, many of which were Nagai themselves, enslaved by the Zantarrk or promised reward. They were then interrupted by Solo and the rest, Han informing Luke that Rynn Zenat was not doing okay, and was feeling weak. Meanwhile, New Republic agent Bastion was in place infiltrating the Zantarrk's base of operations, and entered Prime Minister Almovar's chamber, where the regal woman stood surrounded by holograms. Alarmed, Almovar immediately questioned who Bastion was, as Skywalker, Zenat, and Jesrit caught up and entered the room as well. Finally speaking to someone responsible for the continued oppression of the Nagai, Skywalker tried to rationalize with the fierce leader, as he and Jesrit told her that her actions were putting countless people–including her own–in danger. Almovar said she was doing everything for her home, but Luke and Rynn reminded her that her will doesn't exactly line up with what the people of Pirros really want. Kaltrais is in shambles, the people of Pirros don't want war, and she's been manipulated by Reyna Oskure. Jesrit was furious at the Prime Minister, seeing Nagai blood on her hands as she'd worked with Gallana Venk and used Nagai slaves. A bit resigned, Almovar then admitted that war was already here, that the Fenril Consortium had permanently allied itself with Oskure and the Zantarrk, and that it was too late to stop it all. Bastion refuted this, and Luke extended a hand of grace to the misguided woman, but Almovar was still concerned about Nagai retribution. At this, Jesrit told her that the Nagai rebellion's two goals were the freedom of the homeworld [[Nagi]], and the deaths of Venk and Oskure, as Luke rebuked her for this retributive anger and hate. [[File:LukeRynnBastionJesrit-2025StarWars7.jpg|thumb|left|220px|Skywalker, Zenat, Bastion, and Jesrit confront Prime Minister Kezrin Almovar on Kaltrais.]] Luke then testified of his experience with the Zantarrk, as they'd built a slave army and killed many, and then spoke of Oskure's Imperial past. Accepting that she had indeed failed her people, Prime Minister Almovar then, finally, declared that she would be withdrawing her fleet, as the Nagai insurrection's explosions outside rocked the building. Almovar dismissed the group and said that she had much to repair and ponder, as Rynn promised that the New Republic would be there to help deal with it. As the group left, quietly, Almovar said her fate was sealed, as a pair of white eyes opened in the shadows behind her, Reyna Oskure killing the Pirrosi leader. Outsiude, while Zenat grew weaker, Luke Skywalker helped her as the group fought their way towards a major hangar. Luke tried asking what was wrong, but Rynn refused to answer. The Nagai were winning, fighting their way onto and stealing ships, as the Zantarrk fell one trooper after the last. Luke and Rynn held the line while more Nagai escaped, until the two were picked up by the ''Falcon'', which departed into space towards Nagi to win this revolution once and for all. =====Liberation of Nagi===== {{Quote|We've got to locate ''Venk'' and ''Oskure''.
If we take them down, the Fenril Consortium will be finished.''"
"''Easier said than done, kid.|Luke Skywalker and Han Solo on the surface of Nagi.|[[Star Wars (2025) 8|''Star Wars'' (2025) 8]]}} [[File:HeroesOnNagi-2025StarWars8.jpg|thumb|220px|right|The New Republic's heroes split up on Nagi.]] As the ''Falcon'' and its Nagai allies arrived over Nagi, they were confronted with a Fenril Star Destroyer and lots of Zantarrk Gang vessels. The Fenril fleet fired on the freighter and other rebel ships as Han Solo performed a spin technique to batter away some fighters, while sending the ''Falcon'' down to the surface. The freighter crashed into a crowd of Zantarrk pirates, taking them out as the smoke rose from the vessel. The heroes emerged, and Rynn's condition was worsening while Skywalker helped her stand. But then a convoy of Nagai rebels on [[landspeeder]]s and [[speeder bike]]s appeared, one member saying that it was prophesized that Jesrit would arrive. Jesrit set their goals straight and introduced her new allies to the recently arrived Nagai. The group then decided to split up, Luke, Rynn, Jesrit, and Marntiv going with the Nagai to find medical aid for Zenat, while Solo, Valance, Gauvis, Finch, and Bastion set out to find and eliminate Venk and Oskure as quickly as they could. Skywalker and his allies were on a Nagai convoy as Zenat's illness quickly became all-consuming, as if her life is being drained. Jesrit promised that they wouldn't let Rynn die, as a group of [[Tof]] emerged in front of them and blew up their transports. As Skywalker woke up, he saw that Marntiv was killed in the blast, and that two of the large men were taking Jesrit and Rynn with them. The Tof departed on speeder bikes while claiming the Nagai rebellion was destined for death– with Skywalker left for dead in the barren wastes of Nagi. Wandering the wastes injured and reflecting on what and who he'd lost, Luke Skywalker fainted from exhaustion, but awoke to the Nagai [[Tuula]], a friend of Jesrit's and the daughter of Garlev. Tuula says that if Oskure kills Jesrit, the hope of the Nagai rebellion dies with her. She helps Luke up, and the two set off to find their friends, as Tuula used her tracking skills to guide the two towards Oskure. In the capital city of [[Siva]], Oskure was escorting the captured Zenat and Jesrit to a shuttle, guarded by Zantarrk stormtroopers, while her fleet gathered in orbit. Suddenly, a New Republic fleet, led by Alaytia, consisting of a [[Defender-class cruiser|''Defender''-class cruiser]], at least two [[EF76 Nebulon-B escort frigate|escort frigates]], several corvettes, and many starfighters arrived to confront the Consortium. But as the Anzati witch boasted, Skywalker, Solo, Valance, and Tuula, reunited, fired on Oskure. A new battle had begun as the stormtroopers unleashed a volley of fire at the New Republic heroes, who had the high ground. Luke noticed Oskure draining more of Rynn's life force from above, and slashed stormtroopers with his lightsaber as he dove down to face the Anzati. She'd been waiting for this, and accepted the young Jedi's challenge. The witch dove in with her claws out, slicing Luke and seeking to feast on his life force. She knocked his lightsaber out of his hand, and asked him if he'd made peace with his past and future. He then said that he'd made peace with who he was, and that his past is the Jedi's past, and that was also his future. Using the Force, Luke held Oskure back, pushing her to the wall as he held her still and approached her.[[Star Wars (2025) 9|''Star Wars'' (2025) 9]] [[File:OskureVsSkywalker-2025StarWars9.jpg|thumb|left|270px|Oskure and Skywalker finally face off.]] Luke then put the Crown of Verity on Reyna's head, causing her to scream as she was now only able to speak the absolute truth. Just before she began to speak, Oskure secretly pressed a button on a remote behind her back, and told Luke that if he wanted the "truth", that she, a creature of lies and shadows, would reveal it. She confessed to forcing the Nagai peasants to haphazardly assemble a fleet made of Imperial scraps, but in a way that would specifically ensure victory for herself. To Luke's horror, Oskure then said that the truth would set her free, and prove to be his final resting place. Then, to the shock of Stannix in orbit, the fleet above Nagi suddenly detonated, causing massive explosions and scaring New Republic pilots. Nagi had now become a death trap. New Republic pilots in orbit dodged and fought to eliminate debris from the detonated fleet, some of it managing to fall to the surface, threatening the Nagai. There, the standoff between Skywalker and Oskure ended with the Anzati throwing off the Crown of Verity as wreckage from the fleet rained and Skywalker used his lightsaber and the Force to redirect falling debris.[[Star Wars (2025) 10|''Star Wars'' (2025) 10]] On the wastes of Nagi, the final battle for Nagi had begun as Oskure's forces, consisting of Tof soldiers, pirates, and Zantarrk stormtroopers faced off with Skywalker and his allies. The heroes fought fiercely, as Luke helped Rynn Zenat to limp away, her condition worsening even more. Skywalker wanted to help her, but she begged him to stop Oskure and end the fighting first. While Skywalker deflected a sudden barrage of blaster fire, Zenat crawled on the ground to grab the Crown of Verity as Oskure approached her ship to escape. Then, while the battle raged, a New Republic transport accompanied by two X-Wings landed– and Mon Mothma and Leia Organa emerged to announce that the New Republic stood with the Nagai– the Pirrosi delegation had surrendered. The fighting ceased upon this declaration, the combatants looking at the arriving dignitaries. Jesrit took this opportunity to address the crowd– saying that they now stood on the precipice of true peace, a free Nagi, and freedom from mainpulators, monsters, and their lackeys. Leia denounced the Fenril Consortium as a shadow government run by Oskure, stated that the New Republic stands with Nagi as a free, independent world they will help rebuild, and the enemy Nagai removed their salvaged Imperial trooper helmets, cheering the phrase "in Garlev's name", freed. Close by, the heroes cornered the escaping Oskure, Skywalker telling her that she had much to answer for, attacking the vampiric witch. Oskure was able to knock Skywalker down while her guards were killed, but Zenat emerged from behind, placing the Crown of Verity this time on her own head. [[File:BattleOnNagi-Luke-2025StarWars10.jpg|thumb|right|270px|Skywalker and his allies charge Reyna Oskure as she attempts to escape.]] Rynn's eyes glowed, and she explained that the Crown allows the wearer to not only see the truth, but all that they've left behind. Grabbing Oskure, Zenat told the ancient Anzati that she'd taken something from her, a piece of her that's helped her destroy so many lives in the Fenril sector. Oskure mocked Zenat's [[Spicerunner|spice runner]] background, but the pilot continued, telling Oskure that she'd left something behind inside of her, the sorceress's skin growing more and more decrepit as the rapidly aging woman begged to be left alone. This began to restore Zenat, who became somewhat mad with power, taunting the dying witch– to Skywalker's dismay. He begged her to stop, to not lash out for revenge, and it was Solo's hand on Zenat's shoulder that finally stopped her, as he reminded her that she had won, and shouldn't drag herself down with Oskure. The crumpled, old body of Reyna Oskure then fell to the ground, barely clinging to life, as Rynn removed the Crown. Some time later, Rynn asked Luke if it was really over, to which the Jedi said that it was, for now– but there was always a potential challenge waiting around the corner. In the city of Siva, the New Republic heroes celebrated and gathered with the Nagai, as they began clearing debris and rebuilding. Jesrit thanked Luke and his friends, and Luke clarified that he was just keeping his promise from Gadrilam. Zenat saw this moment of reconstruction, celebration, and all the rest of it, and reflected on the moment of happiness with Luke, who told her that these moments were incredibly important. The Jedi said these moments were what keep one moving through the dark times, even when the fight feels endless: moments of peace and happiness like this give one life. ====Foundations of an order==== {{Quote|I had great hope for the future of the Jedi. I came to believe that if a single Jedi could help bring balance back to the Force, then perhaps a restored Jedi Order could maintain peace and prevent the dark side from ever regaining its hold on the galaxy. So I scoured worlds for the remaining Jedi texts and gathered a new class of apprentices under my tutelage.|Luke Skywalker|''[[Star Wars: The Secrets of the Jedi]]''}} [[File:Elphrona-TheRiseOfKyloRen2.jpg|thumb|left|250px|Luke Skywalker visited many places in search of Jedi lore, including Elphrona.]] Just as he promised Farnay near the start of his own Jedi studies, in 5 ABY,''[[Star Wars: The Rise of Skywalker: The Visual Dictionary]]'' states that Luke began searching for Force lore twenty-nine years before the [[Hosnian Cataclysm|Starkiller Incident]], which ''[[Star Wars: Galactic Atlas]]'' dates to [[34 ABY]]. Therefore, he began traveling the galaxy for Force lore in [[5 ABY]]. Skywalker set about rebuilding the Jedi Order. Despite his optimism, he had many unanswered questions''[[Star Wars: The Last Jedi: The Visual Dictionary]]'' and was hesitant to take on another apprentice after his sister Leia, unsure of his grounding in Jedi lore. Luke became a caretaker of the Jedi Order's legacy, and largely disappeared from galactic view and dedicated himself to traveling the galaxy in hopes of finding what remained of the Jedi after the Empire's long efforts to eradicate their history. Through his quest, he came to understand much about himself and his destiny and gained the confidence he needed to rebuild the Jedi Order. As he traveled the galaxy, he also searched for force-sensitives who could possibly become his students. During this long and difficult task, Skywalker was aided by [[Lor San Tekka]], an explorer and member of the [[Church of the Force]]{{Databank|lor-san-tekka|Lor San Tekka}} who, though not Force-sensitive himself, believed in the Jedi ideals. San Tekka was old enough to remember the Jedi Knights before the Clone Wars, and he did not believe the Emperor's lies about how the Jedi betrayed the Old Republic. San Tekka, who believed that the return of the Jedi Order was essential to bring balance to the Force, became a valuable ally for both Skywalker and Organa. [[Gatalenta]] was one of the first destinations in Skywalker's search,[[Bloodline (novel)|''Bloodline'']] and he also traveled to Moraband,''[[Star Wars: The Dark Side]]'' the ancient home of the Sith, to investigate anything he could about the Force. He visited the [[Deep Core]] planet of [[Tython]] many times and studied its ancient [[Force-henge|ruined temple]], impressed by the majesty of the site every time he visited. He scoured many worlds and assembled a collection of eight ancient bound [[book]]s and scrolls that described Jedi tenets, history and guidance for those following the path of the Jedi—[[sacred Jedi texts]]. One of the books was the ''[[Rammahgon]]'', an influential work that was thought destroyed over 5,000 years ago but retrieved by Skywalker while he explored the subterranean ruins of [[Ossus]]. The ''[[Aionomica]]'' was another, a two-volume collection of Jedi explorations and codifications of the Force, part codex, correspondence and scrapbook. He also found a book that was a catalog of the [[Eeshaypher Collection]], a forbidden gallery of artifacts related to the dark side of the Force. At one point, Skywalker journeyed to [[Black Spire Outpost]] on [[Batuu]], searching for ancient Jedi texts and artifacts.[[Star Wars: Galaxy's Edge|''Star Wars'': Galaxy's Edge]] [[File:Aionomica.png|thumb|right|250px|Skywalker uncovered the ''Aionomica'' and other Jedi relics on his travels.]] Skywalker dedicated much of these years to finding the site of the [[first Jedi Temple]]. He uncovered many tantalizing clues that hinted at the origins of the Jedi, but the precise location was a mystery. One key to unravelling the mystery was his study of the spread of the Force-sensitive uneti saplings. He also made use of the [[Jedi star compass]] he had discovered in the Emperor's storehouse on Pillio. With a [[plasma]]-encased [[supraluminite]] [[lodestone]] at its center, the compass functioned much like the ancient [[wayfinder]]s and was attuned to specific points in hyperspace. Through studying the compass, Skywalker uncovered a path to Ahch-To the site of [[Temple Island]] and the first Jedi Temple. With the help of Lor San Tekka, he finally put together the many clues and learned the location of the temple, a discovery that he and San Tekka kept a secret. With San Tekka, Skywalker hunted down relics the force across the stars. Following the Jedi compass he recovered on Pillio, the pair mapped out the network of Jedi temples scattered across the galaxy, many of which were forgotten after the end of the Jedi Purge. Their voyages proved fruitful most of the time, Skywalker amassing a massive collection of tomes, texts, scrolls, data cards, ritual items, sigils, and other antique symbols. Besides the Jedi star compass, Skywalker also acquired lightsabers. All of this, the pair of men researched, gaining even deeper understanding of the old Jedi Order and its teachings. [[File:LukeDiscoversJocastasCache-2017DarthVader10.png|thumb|left|250px|Skywalker discovered the lost cache of Jedi artifacts belonging to Jocastu Nu.]] Around [[6 ABY]], in his explorations of Jedi lore, Skywalker discovered the [[Jocasta Nu's cache|cache]] of Jedi [[Chief Librarian]] [[Jocasta Nu]] and recovered her holocrons, which contained a wealth of Jedi knowledge and history.[[Darth Vader (2017) 10|''Darth Vader'' (2017) 10]] He uncovered many lost Jedi and Force relics throughout the galaxy, including a [[Jedi Crusader pendant]] and a holocron belong to Jedi Master [[Avar Kriss]] of the High Republic era.[[The Rise of Kylo Ren 3|''The Rise of Kylo Ren'' 3]] Skywalker came to learn about some of the Jedi Masters that existed before the fall of the Order, such as Nu, [[Mace Windu]], and [[Qui-Gon Jinn]]. He became versed in the [[Midi-chlorian]]s, the [[Jedi Code]], and the various Jedi temples that existed, like the [[Lothal Jedi Temple|one on Lothal]]. As well as the light, Skywalker also learned about the Dark Side. He studied the history of the Sith, including the creation of Darth Bane's Rule of Two and events like the Scourge of Malachor. He learned of several Sith Lords and dark side warriors: Darth Bane, Darth Maul, [[Dooku|Darth Tyranus]], and the Jedi hunters of the Galactic Empire's [[Inquisitorius]] among them. Along with [[Fortress Vader]], his father's castle on Mustafar, he became familiar with several locations and temples strong with the Dark Side. Another relic Skywalker recovered was a page of the [[Journal of Caleb Dume]], a survivor of the Jedi Purge and early rebel who fought the Empire under a new identity, Kanan Jarrus, and eventuallly trained his own apprentice, [[Ezra Bridger]]. He brought this and the other Jedi artifacts he had uncovered to Ahch-To and compiled his knowledge into a book he called ''[[The Secrets of the Jedi]]''. Ahch-To was also where Skywalker collected the ''Rammahgon'', the ''Aionomica'', the ''[[Chronicles of Brus-bu]]'', ''[[Poetics of a Jedi]]'', and the other sacred Jedi texts into a small [[library]] housed in an [[Tree library|uneti tree]].{{Databank|jedi-texts|Jedi Texts}} ====Rescue of Grogu==== {{Quote|He is strong with the Force, but talent without training is nothing. I will give my life to protect the Child… but he will not be safe until he masters his abilities.|Luke Skywalker, to Din Djarin|}} [[File:Luke_and_Grogu_-_Mando_Chapter_16.png|thumb|right|305px|Luke Skywalker takes Grogu as his student.]] In approximately [[9 ABY]], a [[Force-sensitive]] member of [[Yoda's species]] named [[Din Grogu|Grogu]] reached out in the Force from the [[seeing stone]] on Tython. Grogu had been raised at the [[Imperial Palace|Jedi Temple]] on Coruscant before the [[Great Jedi Purge]] but had not yet been fully trained as a Jedi,{{TheMandalorian|Chapter 13: The Jedi}} and had since become a [[foundling]] cared for by the [[Mandalorian]] bounty hunter [[Din Djarin]], whom had been tasked with taking Grogu to someone who could train him in the use of the Force. Shortly afterwards, Grogu was [[Battle of Tython (9 ABY)|taken]] by an [[Gideon's Imperial remnant|Imperial remnant]]. Feeling a presence in the Force,''[[Star Wars: Character Encyclopedia, Updated and Expanded Edition]]'' Skywalker tracked Grogu to a [[Gideon's light cruiser|light cruiser]] that Djarin and his allies had boarded in [[Assault on Moff Gideon's cruiser|their own efforts]] to rescue him. Skywalker boarded the vessel with R2-D2 and defeated a [[platoon]] of [[Phase-III Dark Trooper|third-generation dark troopers]] that had trapped Grogu and Djarin's team on the ship's bridge. Afterwards, Skywalker offered his hand to Grogu, and, noting the child's strong attachment to Djarin, told Djarin that he would take care of him if Djarin allowed it. Djarin relinquished Grogu to Skywalker to be trained in the ways of the Force and Skywalker left the ship with the child. ====Building an academy==== {{Quote|You've taught him well.''"
"''It's more like he's remembering than I'm actually teaching him anything.''"
"''Sometimes the student guides the master.''"
[...]"''Sometimes I wonder if his heart is in it [...] What should I do about him?''"
"''Trust your instincts.|Luke Skywalker and Ahsoka Tano on Grogu's training|{{BOBF|Chapter 6: From the Desert Comes a Stranger}}}} [[File:FrogLift-BoBFCE.png|thumb|left|300px|Skywalker instructing Grogu on Ossus.]] Fulfilling the dying wish of Yoda, Skywalker set out to begin training a new generation of Jedi. Having rescued and brought in an original Jedi Padawan from the twilight years of the Galactic Republic, Skywalker ventured to Ossus with the young Grogu to build the first [[Jedi Temple of Luke Skywalker|Jedi Academy]] after the Jedi Order's near extinction following Order 66. Possessing the wisdom and teachings of his own masters, Skywalker tried to educate his young student through the ways of the Force. Telling tales of Master Yoda onto Grogu, the young Jedi Master passed on what he had learned, echoing Yoda's words "size matters not" and to do, not try. However, Skywalker strived to make impression on his small student, having to stop him from using the Force to eat creatures and let Grogu use the Force as he did. Knowing that knowledge lied in Grogu's memory, Luke offered to help him remember and placed his hands gently on the alien's head. Seeing the traumatic images of the 501st Legion gunning down three Jedi Knights protecting the Padawan, everything faded to black when the clones killed the Jedi and moved towards Grogu. When his student awoke, Luke greeted his return and began to better understand the turmoil and subsequent reluctance of Grogu towards his lessons. [[File:TanoandSkywalker.png|thumb|right|275px|Skywalker speaks with Tano about Grogu, while watching him train on the riverbank.]] While carrying Grogu on his back as he had done with Yoda on Dagobah, Skywalker felt the presence of the Mandalorian, Din Djarin. After a time, Grogu seemed to master balance and studied in awe as Luke practiced his skills with the lightsaber. Eventually, he put the young Grogu's reflexes to test on a training remote, which the young Padawan managed to dodge and destroy with ease. [[Ahsoka Tano]] approached Skywalker and complimented him on his progress with Grogu. The doubtful Jedi expressed his concerns that Grogu's progress was due to him gradually remembering his training on Coruscant, not necessarily his training so far with him. Ahsoka stated that sometimes the student teaches the master. Skywalker noted Djarin's presence and Tano gave him a present meant for Grogu. Not sure whether Grogu had heart for the way of the Jedi, Skywalker shared his thoughts. Fortunately, Tano knew the same mind of Skywalker's father, seeing that same compassionate heart which she felt Anakin had for her and mentioned Luke's alikeness. Skywalker asked what should be done and Tano told him to trust his instincts, wisdom she learned from her master. She then departed the planet and said the two would perhaps meet again and told the Force be with him. [[File:LukeYodasSecondLightsaber-FromTheDesertComesAStranger.png|thumb|left|282x282px|Skywalker showing Grogu Master Yoda's old lightsaber]] Heeding the advice of Tano, Skywalker decided to offer Grogu a final choice. In the stone hut, Skywalker presented Grogu with Din Djarin's gift as well as the lightsaber of Master Yoda, which Skywalker had kept. The first path was to accept the present from Djarin and be returned to him, however, by choosing attachment he would forsake the Jedi way. The second was to pick up [[Yoda's second lightsaber|Yoda's lightsaber]] and pledge himself to Luke's teachings to become his first Jedi Padawan. He told Grogu that to become a Jedi would take years and hard work, though at the end he could be a great Jedi. He then let Grogu choose. Grogu would choose the armor, thus leading Skywalker to put him in his X-wing starfighter and instruct R2-D2 to pilot him to Tatooine to be reunited with Djarin.{{BOBF|Chapter 7: In the Name of Honor}} Despite their time together being brief, Skywalker's guidance had a significant impact on Grogu. After being asked about Grogu's impressive use of the Force by fellow Mandalorian [[Bo-Katan Kryze]], Djarin noted that his abilities were a result of Skywalker's training.{{TheMandalorian|Chapter 20: The Foundling}} Some time after his meeting with Ahsoka Tano, the [[Nightsisters|Nightsister]] [[Morgan Elsbeth]] recruited former Jedi Knight of the old Jedi Order [[Baylan Skoll]], who was aware of the truth behind Skywalker's father, to help locate Imperial [[Grand Admiral]] [[Mitth'raw'nuruodo|Thrawn]]. As Skywalker had become prominent during the Galactic Civil War, Skoll became aware of his existence, and kept his name, alongside the names of other Rebel heroes, listed in a device on his gauntlet during the search for the planet [[Peridea]] in a [[Far galaxy|distant galaxy]].{{Ahsoka|Part Two: Toil and Trouble}} ====Recruiting his nephew==== {{Quote|He's an amazing teacher. Very strong. I've learned so much from him…|Ben Solo, on his uncle|[[The Rise of Kylo Ren 2|''The Rise of Kylo Ren'' 2]]}} [[File:Luke_and_Ben.png|thumb|200px|right|Skywalker and Solo together]] Though reluctant to take on another apprentice at first, when the Force awakened in Skywalker's nephew Ben Solo and his mother Leia could see the dark side taking hold of her son, she entrusted the boy to her brother to help him find balance. He agreed to train the 10-year-old Solo, in [[15 ABY]].According to ''[[Star Wars: The Rise of Skywalker: The Visual Dictionary]]'', Luke Skywalker began training his nephew [[Ben Solo]] 19 [[Standard year|years]] before the [[Hosnian Cataclysm]]. Since ''[[Star Wars: Galactic Atlas]]'' dates the Hosnian Cataclysm to [[34 ABY]], Solo's [[Jedi]] training began in [[15 ABY]]. Skywalker took on the responsibilities of a Jedi Master by teaching his nephew. After Ben's fall to the dark side however, Luke would say that he was merely playing the role of Jedi Master as it was a title he had not formally earned. Skywalker taught Solo the ways of the Jedi, in its many forms, under the tutelage and impressed on his pupil the importance of practicing discipline and control. Solo gave his best efforts to gain his Master's approval, although at times their familial bond caused him to address Skywalker as uncle instead of Master. Though he loved his nephew, Skywalker had committed his life to reestablishing the Jedi Order's teachings, which had virtually nothing to do with family ties; therefore, he taught Solo that detachment and distance were necessary to gaining the pure focus that every Jedi aspired to achieve. His nephew soon joined in exploring the galaxy for ancient Jedi lore, and together they found holocrons from forgotten eras and ancient Jedi texts with arcane writings. The two shared more than the same Skywalker blood, for like him, Ben gained a strong devotion to the ways of the Jedi Order. Skywalker saw his nephew's raw power and believed he could pass on his strengths to him, and he attempted to manage his progress through the Force by having him exercise a level of restraint.''[[Star Wars: The Rise of Skywalker: A Junior Novel]]'' Solo was his strongest and most prized student, and Skywalker went on to place his hope for the Jedi Order's future within his nephew, and despite knowing of the darkness within his pupil, the Jedi Master believed he was strong enough to keep it in check. Skywalker was a kind master,''[[The Star Wars Book]]'' and Solo considered his uncle to be a strong and amazing teacher, but Skywalker made mistakes that culminated over time, protecting Ben from the dark truths of their family, much like his sister did before him, and inadvertently isolated Ben over the years of his training. At the request of his sister, Luke never provided his nephew with the details of Anakin Skywalker's fall to the dark side or Darth Vader's redemption and return to the light. During his training of his nephew, a powerful dark side-practitioner known as [[Snoke]], who was the [[Supreme Leader]] of a splinter group of the Empire known as the [[First Order]], and also secretly a puppet of the resurrected Emperor Palpatine, began influencing Ben from afar, clouding him with the dark side. At some point Skywalker had encountered Snoke and supposedly damaged him, and Snoke was responsible for indirectly inspiring Luke to rebuild the Jedi Order, having tried to shatter his resolve. ====More apprentices==== {{Quote|We all studied together. I was first, but they came not long after.|Ben Solo, on Luke's training other apprentices|}} [[File:LukeTeachingJedi-TheRiseOfKyloRen3.jpg|thumb|200px|Skywalker training a new generation of Jedi]] Around [[16 ABY]], Skywalker gathered disciples, young force-sensitive beings adrift with no way to harness their abilities as a result the Jedi Purge, who went on to be his first students. Skywalker's new students numbered about a dozen besides his nephew, including students [[Voe]], [[Tai]], and [[Hennix]], and he worked to teach them everything he had learned in his own training and about the light side of the Force per Yoda's command. Skywalker hoped that teaching the students in a real Jedi Temple would offer them a more traditional Jedi path than his own training under Obi-Wan Kenobi and Yoda. He kept temple's location on Ossus a secret known only to the members of the Order and his loyal droid R2-D2. Skywalker stored the recovered Jedi knowledge and relics that he and Lor San Tekka had recovered within the Jedi Temple, a decision which Solo disagreed, which he believed was just locked up and never used. With the small gathering of his new students looking to him as a spiritual guide and mentor for the Jedi arts, Skywalker believed he could usher in a new era of enlightenment. With his attention now split between several other apprentices, Skywalker's nephew Ben Solo's focus was drawn away to dark Force knowledge. Teaching several Jedi techniques and traditions as telekinesis, meditation, and the use and construction of [[lightsaber]]s, Skywalker's approach for guiding the young minds under his care was steeped in his own master Yoda's teachings passed on while he was on Dagobah, so would often be preaching about patience and balance. While also instilling the belief that all beings were equal within the Force, he gave lectures outside his temple, passing on ever more experience from training with Yoda on Dagobah as he taught the levitation of rocks through the Force. During one such event, student Voe asked why Ben Solo was stronger, where Skywalker compared the Force to a door, that it would become easier to use the more she opened herself up to it. The Jedi Master also tutored Hennix in opening holocrons through the Force, reminding the young [[Quarren]] to listen to the unique voices of each holocron, for each one was different based on their teachings. Skywalker desired heavily to preserve the teachings of the Jedi Order, laboring to pass on the best of what Yoda and Obi-Wan taught him as Jedi mentors at his Jedi temple and to instill the core beliefs they embodied within the next generation. Additionally, Luke understood what Yoda experienced with himself on Dagobah as teacher, having the same unique frustrations with his own pupils; a master guiding a young unseasoned student that was convinced they were wasting time on pointless exercises, such as stacking stones. At some point during his time as a Jedi Master, Skywalker would face a group of [[IG-RM bodyguard and enforcer droid|IG-RM assassin droids]] alongside his nephew.[[Legacy of Vader 10|''Legacy of Vader'' 10]] ====Encountering the Knights of Ren==== {{Quote|Well, hello there. Everything here is ours. We're going to take it…but ''how'' we take it is up to you. Your call, friends.''"
"''You're wrong. So, so wrong. This is a ''Jedi outpost''. Everything in it belongs to the Jedi Order, which, at the moment, means me. I am the last Jedi.|Ren and Skywalker|}} [[File:Elphrona-TheRiseOfKyloRen2.jpg|thumb|left|250px|Skywalker, Solo, and San Tekka discover the Jedi Outpost on Elphrona.]] In [[19 ABY]], the year his nephew turned fourteen, Skywalker, Ben, and Lor San Tekka [[Mission to Elphrona|traveled]] to a [[Elphrona Outpost|Jedi outpost]] on [[Elphrona]], a location from the days of the High Republic Era, hoping to find Jedi artifacts. Luke flew the ship and conversed with San Tekka, while Solo, without his master's knowledge, was communing with Snoke. Skywalker was initially skeptical of a Jedi presence so far from the core, but San Tekka assured him that with his expertise he had recognized the description from his contact as a Jedi Outpost, and explained that the Jedi's activity was greatly expanded throughout the galaxy during the High Republic Era. Meanwhile, Solo telepathically communicated with Snoke, expressing that he was tired of missions to find artifacts with Skywalker that he would just lock away in the temple and never use. Solo admitted that Skywalker was an amazing teacher, but was frustrated that he never wanted Solo to use any of the things he had taught him, which Snoke claimed was because Skywalker viewed Solo as a child and had not realized his true capabilities. Skywalker then told Solo that they would possibly find insights into the old Jedi, and added that they could find interesting weapons, as he knew that Solo was interested in such subjects, which San Tekka affirmed. Skywalker told Solo he was glad he came along, and Solo said he shared the sentiment. When they landed, Skywalker was impressed by the sight of the outpost. He cautioned his apprentice to careful and warned that such a place was likely to be rigged with traps, recalling a time he found a lightsaber in a similar place that turned out to be a trap and nearly killed him. Inside, they found a treasure trove that Skywalker judged so impressive he thought it may be better than Jocasta Nu's cache, including many Jedi holocrons and a [[lightsaber rifle]]. Skywalker was excited by the possibility of learning many new things. As the three perused the outpost, instantly, both Skywalker and Solo felt a cold presence within the structure. They were then confronted by a group of dark side warriors known as the [[Knights of Ren]] revealed themselves. [[File:OnlyOneMan-TheRiseOfKyloRen2.png|thumb|right|210px|Luke battles the Knights of Ren]] Their master, "[[Ren (human)|Ren]]," declared themselves, and claimed ownership of all within the outpost and that they way they took it was up to Skywalker. Skywalker countered, shooting back that all within the outpost, due it being a Jedi location, belonged to the Order; all the holocrons and relics belonged to Luke, for he was the last Jedi Knight even though he would not be for long. Skywalker told the Knights he could sense the dark side in them and would never let them have the artifacts. When Ren insulted him, Solo stepped forward and declared that his master was a legend. Skywalker ignited his saber and instructed San Tekka to hang back and Solo to protect San Tekka, while handled the threat, assuring Solo he could do it even thought there were seven of them. Ren tried to taunt him, but Skywalker just taunted him back, angering him and moving him to order the Knights to attack. As Solo watched on and called out to him, Skywalker engaged the knights, not intending to kill any of them, and managed to overpower them quite easily despite their numbers, which he explained as him not being alone because he had the powerful ally that was the Force by his side. He criticized them for their crude use of the Force, saying they wielded the dark side like a hammer, contrasted by his blade-like precision with the light side. He eventually used the Force to destroy the Knights' weapons and proceeded to prepare himself for a duel with [[Ren (human)|Ren]], who wielded a [[Ren (lightsaber)|red lightsaber]]. Ren informed Skywalker that he activated a kill switch on his lightsaber that would detonate the room if it left his hand. Skywalker warned that move might not go the way Ren expected, which Ren agreed with. Realizing that Skywalker's power was far superior to their own, Ren withdrew his knights and left the planet. However, before he left, Ren removed his helmet and warned Skywalker about the strong presence of the dark side within Solo, before offering the boy chance, if he chose, to seek them out if decided he wanted another path. Ultimately, the structure proved to be a source of more knowledge for Skywalker, for he recovered the holocrons and other relics inside, leaving the outpost empty, but his nephew was prompted with the dark side of the Force. ===Quest for Exegol=== ====Visions and voices==== {{Quote|But this…place, whatever it is. I'm seeing it for a reason, Lor. I can feel it.|Luke Skywalker to Lor San Tekka on his visions|}} As his first disciples grew older and new younglings came into the New Jedi Order's care, Skywalker had a Twi'lek named [[Enyo]] help him as one of the younglings' instructors. In [[21 ABY]],''[[Shadow of the Sith]]'' takes place seventeen [[Standard year|years]] after the [[Battle of Endor]], which ''[[Star Wars: Galactic Atlas]]'' dates to [[4 ABY]]. Therefore, ''Shadow of the Sith'' must take place in [[21 ABY]]. Skywalker started feeling an increasing darkness in the Force and having dark visions that frequently came to him in meditation. One day, Lor San Tekka, who was the only person Skywalker told about the visions, visited Skywalker in his temple on Ossus, his old friend's arrival heralded to Skywalker by Ben Solo. San Tekka greeted Skywalker and Solo, but once the latter was gone, asked Skywalker about the visions and whether or not they had become stronger or changed. Skywalker asked San Tekka to help him understand the visions and learn what the place in them was by standing vigil over him while he accessed the vision and described it. San Tekka was hesitant, but agreed, and Skywalker thus began the meditation. [[File:NewCitadel.png|thumb|left|250px|The ancient Sith world of Exegol and its [[Sith Citadel]], which Luke Skywalker had a vision of in 21 ABY.]] Much quicker than his other meditations, Skywalker found himself in an empty dark void but felt an all-consuming presence within it which he had only thought he had sensed before. Then the vision shifted and he found himself standing on the ancient hidden Sith world of [[Exegol]], though he did not know that was what he was seeing. Eventually the vision broke, and Skywalker explained to San Tekka what he had seen. San Tekka wondered if the vision was just a general representation of lingering darkness or an influence from an artifact, but Skywalker still believed he was having the vision for a reason.
