He is disturbed by Vario's revelation of receiving an encoded transmission from Crimson Dawn; one of the syndicate's representative and former captain under Maul's Shadow Collective, Dryden Vos, wants an audience. ====An unlikely alliance==== [[File:DrydenVosContactsMaul-MSL-Chapter9.png|thumb|right|280px|Contacted by Vos, who offered to help Maul if he kills his superior Rintero.]] Seating himself in the late Deemis’ chair, the hardened criminal lord had Kast patched in Dryden Vos, from Vario's comlink, in order to hear his former employees' offer. The proposal was one of mutual benefit: he would personally extract Maul and his followers from Janix while the window was still accessible; in return, the current leader of Crimson Dawn, [[Rintero]], would be eliminated by the Dathomorian's hand, and Vos would be installed as the new boss of the syndicate. Hesitant to believe their rescue would end without another double cross, Vos eased Maul’s suspicion by informing him that he was contacting without Rintero’s knowledge. Pleased with the young man’s devious ambition, Maul confirmed they would be at the rendezvous coordinates, but Vos warned if Maul isn't at the coordinates he will leave without him. Walking towards the [[transparisteel]] window overlooking all the Imperial patrols searching for them, Maul commanded them for departure as he had one final objection to accomplish on Janix: Izara.{{MSL|Chapter 9: Strange Allies}} [[File:Armistice_Fountain.jpg|thumb|left|280px|Maul had Izara's allies meet at a statue where he proposed an alliance to escape the planet.]] Kast questioned how they would reach their rescue location with the whole city on lockdown, to which Maul believed Captain Lawson could divulge. Focusing deep [[meditation]] in the Force, Maul [[Mind probe (Force power)|probe]]d the cityscape for his connection to Izara until he reached her mind. Putting a [[Force vision|vision]] in her dreams of a female statue, the [[Armistice Fountain]], he lured her to where he would be waiting. Certain they would seize the bait, and both Lawson and the Jedi being out of options, Maul waited by the fountain, and after a while, the group of stragglers reached him. Proposing a necessary alliance to escape the planet together, Maul showed a [[holomap]] of their intended location and challenged Lawson if he knew any secret route not on the Empire’s radar. Begrudgingly, the group agreed to help each other, though Maul was vexed by the ancient Jedi Master urging his comrades to stay wary of their saviour’s intentions. Together, the band of unlikely allies headed to their exit from Janix. Not taking chances that their secret route could be swarming with Imperials, Maul made Lawson take point in directing them towards a power station, after which they could travel through an underground crevice to get to the forest where their rescue ship would land. As he suspected, the station was crawling with stormtroopers and an armoured [[All Terrain Armored Cannon]] [[walker]], too many to sneak past. Predictably, the Jedi council patience, but their limited window made that not an option. Fighting was the only path, and it would show Izara the powers of the Dark Side. Jerking his worn leg, Maul approached in sight of the troopers and ignited his lightsaber and ran towards them, blocking the incoming blaster bolts as he drew closer. As Spybot [[Sensor jammer|jammed]] their helmet [[comlink]]s, Maul cut down one trooper on a [[speeder bike]] before drawing the attention of the walker, using his mobility to spin out of line form each large blast fired. Finishing off the last stormtroopers, Maul jumped high and struck strongly at the Walker’s left leg, managing to cut through the ankle point and finished it by heaving his spinning double-bladed weapon along its back, making the weapon collapse and explode. Demonstrating his raw power and dominance by seizing the moment, Maul felt Izara’s awe at seeing the possibilities emotions in combat could bring. Running through the power plant, they eventually made it to the passage going under the building and out of the city. [[File:TheJediAndMaulFaceTheInquisitors.png|thumb|right|280px|With the Jedi, Maul, battles the First Brother and Eleventh Brother underground but lost most of his friends.]] Climbing underneath the gridded panels, Maul was queried by the ever-questioning Kast of what fate Master Daki awaited. Noting his importance as a skilled warrior, Maul calmed her worry that the Mysoks’s presence was only momentary while he was of use. Eventually they group encountered an unforeseen complication: a separation in a larger cave opening with an underground lake, but only the liquid was [[acid]]ic waste pouring down from the city. The layout of the cave was a low ceiling and a noticeable gap to the other side, too long a jump with too little vertical space for even a Force-assisted leap. Their only salvation was a rusty, slow [[skiff]] that fit no more than two individuals, which Spybot needed to drag from one side to the other. Letting his weaker allies cross first, Maul was disturbed to see the old Jedi Master turn to the cave entrance behind them and even more by learning Daki sensed danger nearing. Understanding what was hunting them, all three Force users ignited their lightsabers for the coming conflict. Just then, the pack of Inquisitors sprinted into sight and went straight at them, with Maul meeting blade-to-blade against the First Brother and the Jedi duo handling the Eleventh Brother. Holding his own against the more formidable hunter, Maul commanded Kast to cross the other side immediately, in spite of her opposition to abandoning her lord. Keeping pace with his attacker, Maul and his compatriots eventually circled around each other in tandem while switching which opponent they fought. Resuming duelling the First Brother alone, the fighter promised their collective death, yet Maul responded by pointing out the First Brother’s misconception, believing him to be anything more than another pawn of Sidious’ will, sent to die like himself. Poking at the Inquisitor’s ego, the flustered Imperial kneed Maul’s weakened leg and kicked him away before throwing his spinning weapon not at Maul, but at Spybot, carving the droid in two. Giving a last call to his master, a growling Maul went on the offensive. Yet again, though, the surprising, lethal style and swift moves of his recurring enemy pressed Maul into a retreat near the bank of the acidic lake, needing to break off the momentum from the First Brother with a [[Force push]]. Noticing the damaged [[skiff]] barely hovering above the waste, Maul, along with Master Daki, held the Inquisitors at bay while Izara made it across. As Izara crossed, the First Brother kicked Maul away before killing a Mandalorian super commando when he attempted to help Maul and Icarus died to push three TK troopers into the acid lake. Left with no more soldiers alive, the rogue Sith lord threw his lightsaber at three TK stormtroopers and knocked the rest away with the Force, recalled his weapon just in time to block his back from the First Brother’s strike. Managing to kick him away and break off for a while side-by-side with Daki, their allies at the other side fired at the Imperials as Izara shouted for her masters to leap onto the skiff she was desperately holding up with the Force. Deciding to give time for Daki, Maul volunteered went alone against both fighters that a day earlier had defeated him. Fending off their combined assault, Maul shook his faulty leg and split his lightsaber into two single blades for better reach and leverage. Fully unleashing his mastery of [[Jar'Kai]], the determined Zabrak handled his aggressors well enough to place a good kick on the First Brother’s head and sprang to leap onto the small skiff. As he landed, Maul deflected a thrown lightsaber away and landed safely on the other side of the lake. Now separated with no more small platforms to make the jump, Maul stared down at his hunters before joining the others to continue. Shortly after, they fortunately reached the forest, though the jungle was covered in thick fog, making tracking to the exact coordinates difficult. Letting Rook and his last Mandalorian commando scout ahead, Maul received kind words from Izara about his lost men. However, their momentary peace was soon broken off at the sound of screams and shots ahead. Feeling unnaturally cold, Maul was shocked to see a fleeing Kast returning and warning them of danger before she got recalled back into the fog. Her final screams were silenced as eery quiet got disturbed by a faint mechanical breath. Slowly, the silhouette of a tall, black-clad figure appeared in the fog and finally neared them in plain sight. The sight of a big, helmeted warrior with a long [[cloak]] made Maul uneasy as the silent foe brandished his own red lightsaber, prepared to end the remaining fugitives. ====Encounter with a Sith Lord==== [[File:Maul-Vader-Duel-MSL.jpg|thumb|left|300px|Maul and Darth Vader duel on Janix.]] Despite a brief hesitation Maul engaged the mysterious foe but was immediately pushed back towards the others. Daki and Izara then joined the defense while [[Brander Lawson|Lawson]] and [[2B0T|Two-Boots]] attacked with blaster fire which was swiftly deflected by the armored figure. Maul, Daki and Izara began their attack however their strikes were effortlessly batted away and a strike from the dark warrior further injured Maul's already damaged cybernetic leg causing him to scream in pain. The rest of the group cautiously moved around the duel and tactically retreated into the jungle providing covering fire for their allies but were met with an overwhelming force push that hurled the entire group backwards. Outmatched by the sheer power of this opponent and recognizing their disadvantage the group, at the behest of Lawson and Maul, made a run for it into some nearby ruins.{{MSL|Chapter 10: The Dark Lord}} As the group entered the ruins, a pillar was brought down in front of them, prompting Daki to command the others to go on ahead while he, Izara and Maul engage their pursuer. Even as they fled, Vader crumbled the ruins around them as he approached the three defenders. Maul, seeing the raw power of this foe, ignited his second lightsaber blade, stating their enemy was no inquisitor engaging him directly and openly questioning just what this formidable adversary was. Even after Daki and Izara joined the fight, the three were still horribly outmatched, with Daki being pushed aside and Maul falling onto his back from the power of their enemies' onslaught, only surviving with the assistance of Izara, who, together with Maul were able to force push Vader back. Escaping through the collapsed pillar, the trio then used the force to bring what remained of the ceiling down, stalling Vader's relentless approach. Aimlessly making their way through the fog-covered, labyrinthian ruins, Master Daki expressed concern and fear, believing their enemy to be a Dark Lord of the Sith, with Maul expressing similar panic at his own realizations. Izara questioned her Master as to how they could defeat such an enemy, with Maul interjecting that only by letting go of her restraint and tapping into her rage could they stand a chance, to which Daki immediately objected, counseling Izara to not give in to such emotions and to remain calm in the face of fear. Maul countered, saying that their enemy knows how Jedi fight and that they would have to adapt to outsmart him. Disturbed by rumblings in the ruins, Master Daki scouted ahead, leaving Izara with Maul, who explains to her that he knows how to defeat it because he was taught by the most powerful Sith Lord of all, Darth Sidious. Continuing his pleas, Maul stated how his master had purged the Jedi Order and made himself the Emperor and implored Izara to utilize her rage before Master Daki returned and instructed Izara to go on ahead and assist the Lawsons while Daki assisted Maul through the ruins. Maul and Daki briefly conversed about their enemy with Maul stating how powerful he was and that only with aggression could they overcome him whereas Daki believed that by defending one another they would be stronger. Just as the two finished their talk, Maul sensed a disturbance, which was immediately followed by a gloved hand smashing through the wall he was leaning against and the return of the Sith Lord, who once again engaged them in combat. Maul and Daki were pushed out of the ruins and onto the remains of a bridge where Izara was fighting both the First Brother and Eleventh Brother. Seeing his padawan in danger, Master Daki aided his apprentice while Maul was thrown back by a strike from Vader. Worn from fatigue and panting heavily, Maul and Daki regained their composure as all three stood ready against the inquisitors and their Sith master. The two Jedi fought the inquisitors while Maul duelled Vader as they were all pushed further along the bridge until Master Daki was able to overcome the First Brother and dispatch him with a force push that saw him fall into the surrounding jungle. Separated from his padawan, Daki was unable to assist her before being attacked by Vader, forcing him to defend himself alongside Maul, reiterating that together they could do this. Maul and Daki mounted what defense they could with, Daki coming to Maul's aid after he had been knocked down and forcing the Sith Lord back with a joint force push. Standing together, Maul yelled and led a ferocious charge against Vader, although his attacks were still batted aside as the Sith Lord laid out a brutal counterattack, backhanding the Jedi Master and breaking Maul's guard, slashing him across his already wounded hip. Grunting in pain, Maul quickly regained himself and once again launched an attack towards Vader; however, he caught it in place using the force and retaliated with his own strike, which Maul defended in kind, but was swiftly overcome by a force choke from the Sith Lord, who then threw Maul into Daki, knocking them both to the side. [[File:MSL-Chapter10-Thumbnail.png|thumb|right|300px|Maul and Daki fighting Vader before escaping on Vos' ship.]] Crumpled on the bridge, both exhausted, Maul and Master Daki exchanged a glance, as Daki re-engaged Vader, Maul rose to his feet, igniting his saber and prepared to continue the fight. However, his damaged leg crackled in resistance, causing him great pain. As he looked between his wound and the Jedi Master's fight with the Sith Lord, he heard Izara struggling against the Eleventh Brother before proclaiming "No." and using the force to push Daki towards Vader, betraying their alliance and leaving him to fight Darth Vader alone. Unknownst to Maul, however, Captain Lawson witnessed the betrayal. Dejected, Lawson was quickly brought back into the battle by blaster fire as Maul made his escape. As Maul limped away from the duel, Master Daki, pushed down by a strike from Vader, looked around to see that Maul had abandoned him. Alone and outmatched, Daki was soon overpowered, beaten down by repeated blows of overwhelming force and finally impaled by the Sith Lord. Izara cried out in anguish at her Master's death, as Maul watched from the shadows. She unleashed her rage upon the Eleventh Brother, but was still beaten down. Maul approached, and seeing that Izara had lost her lightsaber, offered one of his own. The padawan accepted, arose, and together she and Maul stood against the Eleventh Brother. Together they pushed the inquisitor onto the defensive with Maul watching as Izara unleashed her rage, injuring the Jedi hunter and forcing him to flee into the nearby ruins. Izara pursued him but was soon met by Vader, who pummeled her with relentless strikes, seeing this Maul screamed in rage and began to use the force to bring the ruins down upon them, allowing Izara to retreat to his side. As the Sith Lord began deflecting and destroying the falling debris, Izara attempted to attack him once again, only for Maul to hold her back, insisting they must go. In tears at her Master's death, Izara exclaimed that she would kill them, to which Maul stated that she was not yet strong enough, but that he would train her, and together they would have their revenge. Together, the two ran from the crumbling ruins, dodging and deflecting the incoming blaster fire from stormtroopers and gunships alike and boarding [[Dryden Vos's shuttle]]. Darth Vader watched on as the ship was pursued by Imperial forces as it made its way to break atmosphere. Narrowly avoiding the Imperial gunships fire the ship jumped into hyperspace. Maul stood within the cockpit reassuring Vos that he would honor his end of the bargain, returning to Izara, still cradling the lightsaber he had offered her, Maul sat down beside her. Izara, angry and determined, clutched the saber tightly and declared to Maul she was ready. ====Leading the Five Crime Syndicates==== {{Quote|But that was when the five syndicates worked against each other. Now that we are allies, we cooperate. I suppose ''[Aemon]'' misses the good old days, when we could operate however we wanted. It certainly had some benefits. And anyone else, well, he had a method for silencing them, too.|Dryden Vos|}} [[File:MaulHologram-Solo.png|thumb|right|300px|Maul, leader of the Five Crime Syndicates]] During the Imperial Era, Maul became obsessed with the destruction of Sidious and his revenge on Kenobi. Knowing that he could not underestimate either enemy, he scoured worlds in search of knowledge that would give him an advantage in his missions. Over the years, Maul remained elusive enough to the Imperial hunters that they began to refer to him as "The Shadow." At some point after his escape during the Purge, Maul had once again returned to Dathomir, where he took up residence, frequently haunting the dead world, using Nightsisters' relics, tomes, and specially crafted potions to increase power and advance his desire for vengeance.''[[Dawn of Rebellion]]'' Maul also became the shadowy leader of Crimson Dawn, with Dryden Vos as his figurehead. Despite the fall of the Shadow Collective, he also had control of the [[Five Crime Syndicates]] and prevented them from fighting with one another. During his time as leader of Crimson Dawn, Maul began a search for an ancient [[Sith holocron]]. While searching, Maul used a tactic of stealth, wearing a hooded cloak to hide his appearance and exchanged his double-bladed lightsaber for [[Maul's lightsaber|another one]], which which appeared as if it used parts salvaged from an [[Double-bladed spinning lightsaber|Inquisitor's double-bladed lightsaber]]''[[Star Wars: The Mini Book of Lightsabers]]'' and to which he added a wooden part to in order to give it the appearance of a staff. However, not all members of the syndicates were happy with this arrangement, with Black Sun member [[Alorium]] believing that Maul "[kept] them under his boot". However, the riches reaped from Maul's leadership kept most of his protestors silent, with Maul making sure to silence any detractors who did not keep quiet. Due in part to his desire for independence from Maul, Alorium unsuccessfully attempted to take over a part of the Black Sun organization. In the time after Alorium's failed coup, Vos's underling [[Qi'ra]] met Maul for the first time,{{Twitter|StarWarsExplain|status/1682486219283001344|Star Wars Explained|quote=.@ek_johnston says Crimson Climb covers about a year and a half, starting right after Qi'ra is separated from Han taking us up to the point where she is about to meet Maul for the first time.}} with Qi'ra considering the act of meeting him something she could not walk away from and thus set her future in stone. In [[10 BBY]], following Vos's death at Qi'ra, Maul was contacted by her through a hologram from [[First Light|Vos' ship]], who informed him that Vos had been [[Showdown on Savareen|betrayed and murdered]] by [[Tobias Beckett]] and [[Han Solo|his]] [[Chewbacca|associates]] that he employed, before having his shipment of [[coaxium]] stolen while it was being refined on the desert planet [[Savareen]]. Irritated, Maul recalled Qi'ra to Dathomir, where he said that the two would decide how best to deal with Beckett and the other traitors. He then activated his new lightsaber and told Qi'ra that they would be working more closely from then on, elevating her to the late Vos's position. [[File:QiraMaul-CrimsonReign1.jpg|thumb|left|230px|Working more closely with Qi'ra, Maul taught her many secrets of the Sith.]] Maul taught Qi'ra about the Sith Order, revealing to her on his mutterings the Rule of Two, he told her that Galactic Emperor Sheev Palpatine was actually the Dark Lord of the Sith known as Darth Sidious and that the Imperial enforcer Darth Vader was his Sith apprentice and told her about his plan to use Crimson Dawn to take down the Empire.[[Crimson Reign 1|''Crimson Reign'' 1]] He also trained Qi'ra to fight the Sith. Through Qi'ra and the Dawn, Maul's desire for vengeance against the Sith continued as the organization tried to destroy them.''[[Star Wars Encyclopedia: The Comprehensive Guide to the Star Wars Galaxy]]'' Maul also learned about the [[Fermata Cage]], a [[weapon]] of the [[dark side of the Force]] which could freeze individual moments and was used to contain an [[Unidentified Sith Lord (Fermata Cage)|ancient Sith Lord]]. Maul planned to free the Sith Lord and watch them come after both Sidious and Vader in accordance to the Rule of Two.
