Think of what we find as spoils of war. I'm not offering you a chance to back out. You're here, you knew the risks, and any one of us could die badly, same as the pirates. But this is the way to arm ourselves for survival. For revolution, should it come to that.|Gerrera, to his guerrillas|<ref name="MOF" />}}
Over the fossilized city-planet [[Eyo-Dajuritz]], site of the Separatist cache, the ''Dalgo'' alternated propulsion methods to confuse the planet's sensor net, causing the starship's occupants—including Gerrera—some discomfort. Declaring that they were entering the realm of the dead, Gerrera headed from the cabin to the cockpit as Vak-Nhalis provided guidance to the pilot. Asking the cyborg if he was certain, which Vak-Nhalis confirmed that he was, Gerrera said his people would ready the gear. Vak-Nhalis' description of the Separatist cache disheartened Saw's guerrillas, a reminder of Confederate brutality. Gerrera lamented his disinterest in working with Jedi, let alone Separatists, and suggested any gains be considered as spoils of war. Refusing to back out, Gerrera reiterated that they knew the risks, and that this was the only way to be armed for survival—for revolution.<ref name="MOF" />

Waiting until daylight, Gerrera's team, led by Vak-Nhalis, secured the cache. Some time later, Gerrera noticed an unidentified starship on approach. As it landed Eyo-Dajuritz, Gerrera ordered his guerrillas to return to camp. Its captured occupants, Senator [[Bail Prestor Organa|Bail Organa]] of [[Alderaan]] and aide [[Haki Zeophrine]] (a [[Imperial Intelligence]] spy who identified herself under the false name "Haki Nevzal" to Gerrera), were brought to the cache to avoid detection. Gerrera asked Nevzal about her modified blaster pistol, to which she pleaded ignorance. Vogorath assaulted Nevzal for killing [[Qaterman]], another Partisan, causing Gerrera to dismiss Vogorath and Karama, leaving only him and Vak-Nhalis with Organa and Nevzal. Organa, believing Gerrera to be fighting for the Separatists, tried placating him with a reminder that [[Separatist Reintegration Day]] was only a week away. Gerrera denied the accusation and properly introduced himself.<ref name="MOF" />

Recognizing him, Organa began to recount how the Republic had aided the Onderon militia, but Gerrera accused the government of using the militia as disposable proxies to capture the world at no risk to themselves. When Organa asked what Gerrera was doing Eyo-Dajuritz, Gerrera returned the question, and Nevzal broke down in tears, pleading for their release. Gerrera asked if Organa was alone, where his ship was, if it was being tracked, and again why he had come. Organa claimed Alderaan was against violence, and that no one should possess the weapons the cache contained.<ref name="MOF" />

Gerrera interrogated Organa, who maintained his story, and the blubbering, incoherent Nevzal. Privately, Gerrera consulted with Vak-Nhalis, who believed Organa was a senator but should be killed to spare any complications. Gerrera raised the idea that Organa could be useful, but Vak-Nhalis retorted that Organa represented the Empire, the enemy. Gerrera countered that although the Separatists had considered the Onderonians terrorists, and although they sometimes violated Republic codes of military conduct, they did not target civilians; they were not murderers.<ref name="MOF" />

Later, guerrillas aboard the ''Dalgo'' spotted an Imperial military transport, and Gerrera sent Karama to fetch Vak-Nhalis. Gerrera explained that the transport did not appear to have spotted at ''Dalgo'', flying low and slow as if scouting. If the guerrillas left immediately, they would be able to recover a quarter of the intended equipment, but Gerrera figured that they could not make it from the cache to the ship without being detected. Vak-Nhalis considered loading up and running under fire, and Karama suggested leaving behind everything but the money, though Gerrera was unconvinced.<ref name="MOF" />

Coming to two options, Vak-Nhalis proposed informing the Imperials that they had hostages. By providing a deadline, the guerrillas could force an Imperials attack the cache without reinforcements, outflank them with the ''Dalgo'', and escape. Gerrera concluded that timing was an issue, as they had no way of knowing if other transports were actually nearby, ready to reinforce at a moment's notice, and an incorrect guess would mean death. Vak-Nhalis then put forth a plan of retreat into the bunker, the guerrillas sealing themselves in and setting traps before descending, hoping that another exit was present or that the construction droids that built the bunker could dig them out. Gerrera and Vak-Nhalis agreed to take the hostages as leverage rather than release them, Gerrera opting to put them in hazard suits.<ref name="MOF" />

=====Boxed in=====
{{Quote|It's a pity. But no regrets.|Gerrera, on Eyo-Dajuritz's annihilation|<ref name="MOF" />}}
Descending into the lower levels, Gerrera spoke again with Vak-Nhalis before issuing orders to excavate and plant traps at irregular intervals to slow the enemy force, which Gerrera confirmed consisted of fifteen clone troopers. Several hours later, Gerrera instructed the group to take four hours' sleep. Later still, Vak-Nhalis told Gerrera that Organa and Nevzal were trying to plot an escape, though he was unsurprised. When Vak-Nhalis suggested killing the troublesome Nevzal to cow Organa, Gerrera refuted his logic, believing that Nevzal's death would only catalyze Organa to act out more quickly. Vak-Nhalis consequently felt that Gerrera was unwilling to embrace "Separatist" habits, though did not say so aloud.<ref name="MOF" />

Vorgorath encountered a Separatist excavation droid that was trying to dig itself out, prompting Gerrera to order his guerrillas to explore for alternative exits. Karama suggested using the hostages, a play Nevzal objected to as futile; although Gerrera agreed, he figured it their best hope regardless. Organa similarly dissented, voicing his belief that the clones were only interested in the cache's data files, a sentiment Vak-Nhalis seconded. Returning to ideas for escape, Nankry suggested blasting. Gerrera asked Vorgorath about using explosives, but the guerrillas lacked any shaped charges, scans of the caves, or reinforcement fields to excavate effectively. Karama suggested rigging the doors and walls. Gerrera overruled Vorgorath's objections and ordered his forces to hold off any arriving clones. Organa approached Gerrera, desiring to talk. Gerrera, observing Vak-Nhalis' nonchalant response, told Organa to talk fast.<ref name="MOF" />

As the clones besieged the guerrillas, Gerrera asked Organa how the clones would attack, but Organa responded that he rarely spoke to clones about tactics. Gerrera asked what Organa wanted, and Organa replied that Vak-Nhalis had files from the cache that could expose the Empire, files Organa intended to use in his [[investigation into the framing of the Jedi]]. Organa proposed that Gerrera's fight was unnecessary; Onderon's freedom could be won through the political arena. Gerrera sardonically retorted that Organa thought that the war he was waging was a waste of time, but Organa countered that Gerrera had already won it, that this could be his last battle. Responding to a status report through his comlink, Gerrera gave orders to prep for detonation and told Organa that the conversation could wait. Organa retaliated that Gerrera needed to prioritize—the supplies, killing clones, or orchestrating Organa and Vak-Nhalis' escape.<ref name="MOF" />

Later, as Gerrera was accompanied by Vorgorath and [[Rynark]] to trade red water from the planet [[Po'yin]] for weapons and credits, he learned of Vak-Nhalis' terrorist attack on Coruscant.<ref name="MOF" />

=====An Act of Terror and the Conference=====
{{Quote|I was told that your people were responsible for the explosions at Center One. I need to know if that's true before we go further.''"<br />"''It is true.|Mon Mothma and Saw Gerrera|<ref name="MOF" />}}
Sometime thereafter, Gerrera planned and executed an attack on [[Center One]], a reeducation camp for political prisoners of the Empire, then still under construction. While Karama watched at a distance in the dirt for almost forty hours, waiting for Gerrera's orders, Nankry infiltrated the facility and planted explosives without being noticed, and with its relevant codes having worked as expected. Gerrera then made the signal, and Karama triggered the detonation.<ref name="MOF" />

Saw Gerrera later met with Senators Mon Mothma and Bail Organa at the abandoned [[Palace of the High Games Masters]] on [[Phothrell]] to discuss coordinated resistance against the Galactic Empire. Mothma had called the meeting in the aftermath of the Eyo-Dajuritz incident and Gerrera’s bombing of Center One, which he confirmed his group had carried out. He defended the attack as a necessary step to inspire recruitment and take the offensive against the Empire.<ref name="MOF" />

The meeting revealed major ideological divides between the three. Organa condemned the loss of life and accused Gerrera of misusing his access of codes shared with him. Gerrera, in turn, criticized the senators' reliance on laws and institutions. Mothma attempted to mediate, arguing that opposition to the Emperor would require both moral clarity and strategic compromise. Throughout, Gerrera challenged their assumptions and pushed back against efforts to constrain his tactics.<ref name="MOF" />

Though no formal alliance was formed, the three acknowledged the need for broader opposition. Gerrera offered limited insight into his operations and rejected any oversight, asserting his independence. He departed first, declining to maintain direct contact unless absolutely necessary. The meeting marked an early, informal point of contact between Gerrera and figures who would later form the Rebel Alliance.<ref name="MOF" />

=====Recruitment on Ylagia=====
{{Quote|Good clanspeople of Houramis—will you listen to my story?|Saw Gerrera, addressing the Houramis clan|<ref name="MOF" />}}
Sometime after the [[Separatist Reintegration Day]]<ref name="MOF" /> in 19 BBY,<ref name="MOFDate70">{{MOFdate|70}}</ref> Gerrera and his Partisans landed their [[starship]] ''Dalgo'' on [[Ylagia]], near the shantytown where the [[Houramis]] clan settled after fleeing the nearest [[spaceport]] city due to a planetwide drought. The Partisans offered the Houramis relief in the form of [[ration pack]]s, [[power converter]]s, and third-tier [[medkit]]s, some of these originating from the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems]] [[cache site]] in [[Eyo-Dajuritz]]. Gerrera used this opportunity to speak to the Houramis to try to enlist them to his cause.<ref name="MOF" />

=====Raven's Peak=====
{{Quote|''[To Hunter]'' You expect me to call this off to save a few prisoners? I'm trying to fight an Empire.''"<br />"''Have you considered that by destroying this facility, you are wiping out any chance to gather intel that could help your cause?''"<br />"''Taking out several of their top commanders is a good start.''"<br />"''Well, that victory will be short-lived, as their ranks will quickly be replenished.''"<br />"''Maybe so, but sacrifices have to be made for the greater good.|Saw Gerrera and Tech|<ref name="The Summit">{{TBB|The Summit}}</ref>}}
[[File:Saw_Gerrera_on_Eriadu.png|thumb|left|250px|Saw Gerrera during the [[bombing of Raven's Peak]].]] 
During or after [[18 BBY]],<ref name="TBB Date">{{TBBDate|215}}</ref> Gerrera targeted an Imperial summit held on [[Eriadu]]. In the facility known as [[Raven's Peak]], Governor Tarkin headed a table of five highly ranked officers, including [[Doctor]] [[Royce Hemlock]]. Gerrera lead a small infiltration team into the facility, disguised as stormtroopers, with the intention of completely destroying the base. Armed with remote explosives, the team stealthily littered the lower levels with them. When they were almost finished, Gerrera ran into another group of intruders: Clone Force 99. Gerrera explained his plan to the clones, to which Hunter protested, as they had a separate goal to track Hemlock to the location of imprisoned clone troopers. Despite logical counterarguments made by [[Tech]], Gerrera insisted it needed to be done "for the greater good."

Before the two group's conversation could conclude, a security team interrupted, forcing them to part ways. With the imperials alerted to their presence, Gerrera order his comrades to retreat to an escape shuttle, although they had failed to place detonators in the command center. Most of his team fought their way to the shuttle and off-world, at which point Gerrera promptly detonated the explosives. While the explosion destroyed the hangar and much of the interior, the command tower was left undamaged. Unbeknownst to Gerrera, it had also caused a power outage to the facility's [[Raven's Peak Sky Rail|skyrail]], which Clone Force 99 was using to escape. Ultimately, due to Gerrera's actions, Hemlock's [[Hemlock's shuttle|tracked shuttle]] was destroyed and Tech was forced to sacrifice himself to allow his companions to escape.<ref name="The Summit" />

Gerrera [[Campaigns of Saw Gerrera's Partisans|fought]] against the [[Imperial Military]]<ref name="Bloodline" /> and reorganized the Onderon resistance into a group he dubbed the [[Partisans]].<ref name="Ultimate, New">''[[Ultimate Star Wars, New Edition]]''</ref> Around 18 [['ABY-BBY' dating system|BBY]],<ref name="Timelines" /> he hired a [[Lasat]] [[Unidentified Lasat mercenary|mercenary]] and fought an [[Alexsandr Kallus' squad|Imperial squad]] under [[Imperial Security Bureau|ISB]] [[Agent]] [[Alexsandr Kallus|Kallus]] when they were sent to Onderon to bring peace;<ref name="The Honorable 1s">{{Rebels|The Honorable Ones}}</ref> the mercenary and other allied partisans killed Kallus' entire unit, save Kallus himself<ref name="Timelines" /> Gerrera ultimately came to think Onderon was lost and thus retreated from his own homeworld, however.<ref name="Ultimate, New" />

=====Helping the Ersos=====
Sometime before [[17 BBY]],<ref name="Timelines" /> Gerrera joined an arms smuggling ring led by [[Has Obitt]]. The smugglers were to deliver arms to resistance fighters in the [[Salient system]], however, this smuggling ring was the brainchild of [[Orson Callan Krennic|Orson Krennic]]. Krennic was using small uprisings as an excuse to take control of planets heavy in resources needed to build the [[DS-1 Orbital Battle Station|Death Star]]. Obitt had revealed this information to his smuggler partners, and they decided to double-cross the Empire. When they arrived at Salient, it became clear that the Empire was expecting to arrest Obitt and the other mercenaries. Gerrera convinced Obitt to stay and fight the Empire. The people of the Salient system eventually lost the battle and Obitt was captured and later released by [[Wilhuff Tarkin]]; Gerrera, however, was able to escape.<ref name="Catalyst" />

In [[17 BBY]], Gerrera led a [[Mission to Gyndine|mission]] with six other Onderonian Partisans to [[Gyndine]] to infiltrate the [[Central Medical Facility]] and install a [[transmitter]] inside the medical network to spy on Imperial intelligence. To gain access to the facility, Gerrera had his friends killed and drugged himself to appear dead temporarily, so they would be carried into the medcenter. Gerrera then impersonated an Imperial officer and shut down power to the hospital, to ensure the planted node would not be rejected by the system. Two days later, he met up with Senator Bail Organa on the planet [[Taris]], where Gerrera reported to him the success of the mission. Organa admonished the Partisan for the deaths incurred in powering down the hospital, to which Gerrera replied that he also lost loved ones, but the mission made it worth it. Gerrera then left for Coruscant to help the Ersos.<ref name="SawGerrera1">[[Rogue One – Saw Gerrera 1|''Rogue One – Saw Gerrera'' 1]]</ref> 

In that same year, Obitt came in contact with [[Lyra Erso]]. Erso wanted to have her husband, [[Galen Walton Erso|Galen]], to quit working with Krennic, and the only way to do so was for the family to flee Coruscant. Obitt, who had known the Ersos since Jyn's birth, knew Krennic would expect him to help the Ersos, so he asked Gerrera to go in his stead. Gerrera smuggled Lyra, Galen, and [[Jyn Erso]] off Coruscant and helped them set up a [[Erso homestead|homestead]] on [[Lah'mu]].<ref name="Catalyst" /> The Ersos stayed vigilant while living on Lah'mu, forming an escape plan in case Krennic found them. The plan was for Lyra and Jyn Erso to hide in a shelter dug under a cave and to contact Gerrera for extraction.<ref name="Rogue One" />

====Recruiting Cal Kestis====
=====Freeing the Wookiees=====
{{Quote|These have been hard years. We've lost comrades, friends, family...to the Empire. Dark times. And yet the fire still burns. ''Hope'' still burns. The Jedi are not yet lost. ''We'' are not yet lost. ''Kashyyyk'' is not yet lost! For the cause!|Saw Gerrera, to his Partisans|<ref name="Jedi: Fallen Order">''[[Star Wars Jedi: Fallen Order]]''</ref>}}
[[File:KestisAndGerrera-JFO.jpg|thumb|250px|Gerrera speaking with Kestis on Kashyyyk.]]
Sometime later in [[14 BBY]],<ref name="LargeDateNote">{{AndorDate|108}}</ref> Gerrera and several of his Partisans [[Liberation on Kashyyyk|traveled]] to [[Kashyyyk]]. There, he used<ref name="Jedi: Fallen Order" /> a [[DH-16 Blaster Pistol]].<ref name="GoH">''[[Star Wars: Galaxy of Heroes]]''</ref> The Partisans discovered that one of the Empire's [[Imperial Refinery|refineries]] was using [[wroshyr tree]] [[Wroshyr sap|sap]] to make a powerful compound. Following that, they met Jedi Padawan [[Cal Kestis]], who they asked for help in their attempts to free the [[Wookiee]]s.<ref name="Jedi: Fallen Order" /> 

In return for Kestis' assistance in the attack on Kashyyyk, the Partisans agreed to search for Wookiee Chieftan [[Tarfful]], who could aid Kestis in searching for a [[Jedi holocron]] with the names of several force-sensitive children. After the takeover of the refinery, Gerrera made a speech to encourage the flame of rebellion against the Empire and offered Kestis a place among the Partisans, saying that it would be nice to have a Jedi fighting at his side. Kestis felt honored by the offer, but he refused because he could not abandon his mission. Gerrera asssured Kestis that offer would continue to stand before leaving. After finding Tarfful in the [[Shadowlands]], the Partisans became overwhelmed by the Imperial forces, and the majority were forced to retreat before Kestis returned to Kashyyyk. Gerrera shot down an AT-AT during the retreat. Those who remained on Kashyyyk did so to Gerrera's disdain.<ref name="Jedi: Fallen Order" />

=====Continued work with Kestis=====
Some time after their work together on Kashyyyk, Kestis and Gerrera would reunite, with Kestis joining the Partisans as part of [[Stinger Mantis crew's crusade against the Empire|his crusade against the Empire]]. By [[9 BBY]], Kestis would pause further involvement with the Partisans once he became involved with a [[Quest for Tanalorr|quest]] for the lost planet [[Tanalorr]] and the [[Hidden Path]].<ref name="Jedi: Survivor" />

====Mentor for Jyn====
{{Quote|The last time I saw you, you gave me a knife and a loaded blaster and told me to wait in a bunker 'till daylight.''"<br />"''I knew you were safe.''"<br />"''You left me behind.''"<br />"''You were already the best soldier in my cadre.''"<br />"''I was sixteen.''"<br />"''I was protecting you!|Jyn Erso and Saw Gerrera|<ref name="Rogue One" />}}
[[File:Saw-prise.png|thumb|left|300px|Saw Gerrera finds Jyn Erso on Lah'mu in the aftermath of the capture of Galen Erso]]
In [[13 BBY]]<ref name="LargeDateNote" /> Saw was tasked with protecting Jyn, after Lyra was killed and Galen was [[Capture of Galen Erso|taken]] by Orson Krennic to continue his work on the Death Star. He rescued Jyn from Lah'mu<ref name="Rogue One" /> and brought her to the planet [[Wrea]], where he had an [[Saw Gerrera's Wrea outpost|outpost]] set up that was still mostly empty of occupants. He revealed his dislike for droids after Jyn suggested he obtain a unit. The day after her arrival, Jyn found a training ground set up with hanging husks of dilapidated droids used for targeting practice by Saw. Jyn then asked for Saw's help in training to fight. On the third day of her stay, she got the chance to practice her hand to hand skills on several sets of stormtrooper armor Saw had put up for her benefit. Gerrera had many partisans, including [[Reece Tallent]], a human who Gerrera personally trained, the [[Twi'lek]] [[Xosad Hozem]], and [[Idryssa Barruck]], who Jyn took a liking to. Supplying the fighters with a place to stay, [[Foodstuff|food]], although mainly in the form of [[nutritive milk]], and operations for them to undertake, Wrea became a hub for various rebel fighters to visit for various reasons.<ref name="Rebel Rising" />

[[File:SawTrainsJynWrea-RogueOne2.jpg|thumb|right|300px|Saw trains Jyn on Wrea]]

In [[10 BBY]],<ref name="Timelines" /> Saw allowed Jyn to accompany him while he negotiated with [[Enfys Nest]] for [[coaxium]] obtained from the syndicate [[Crimson Dawn]].<ref name="Solo Expanded">''[[Solo: A Star Wars Story: Expanded Edition]]''</ref>

In [[9 BBY]], Saw received military information stolen from the Empire by Cal Kestis, who had maintained liaison with Saw since they first met on Kashyyyk.<ref name="Jedi: Survivor">''[[Star Wars Jedi: Survivor]]''</ref>

====Inusagi====
=====Sakoola blossom festival=====
In [[6 BBY]],<ref name="Timelines" /> Saw and several other members of his Partisans were hired by [[Arane Oreida]] to go to [[Inusagi]] and to infiltrate [[Sakoola blossom festival]] and kill [[Governor]] [[Cor Tophervin]]. He and his Partisans massacred the festival, killing Imperials, the Inusagi [[chief]]tess, guests and many [[Inusagian]] civilians to send a message to the Empire.<ref name="Rebel Rising" />

During the mission, Gerrera was shot in the leg, and [[Nankry]] was captured by the Empire and taken to [[Oovo 4]]. Her arrest prompted the man to reach out to former Partisan Karama (at this point known as "Kara") to kill her before she could reveal Partisan operational secrets. Kara considered poisoning her with [[roundroot]], given her fatal [[allergy]] to it, but in the end decided against killing the prisoner. Nankry was nevertheless murdered when someone infiltrated the [[Oovo Four detention center]] and fed her tainted milk. After the ordeal, Gerrera pleaded with Kara to re-join the Partisans, but she refused.<ref name="Edge of the Abyss">''[[Reign of the Empire: Edge of the Abyss]]''</ref>

=====Aftermath=====
{{Quote|You think that if people know what happened to you and your world, they will care? That they will take up arms and fight because the injustice will be too much to stomach? You are a fool! People are selfish. Small. They crave safety, comfort. Revolution is for the brave, Anto. Those willing to die. Are you willing to die?''"<br />"''A-all I’m asking is for you to help…''"<br />"''Answer the question. Are you willing to die?''"<br />"''I am.''"<br />"''I don't believe you.''"<br />"''I am. I mean, no one wants to die, do they? I want to pull off a successful mission. Wouldn't the victory be in surviving to do it again?''"<br />"''Not yet, not yet. You don't want it badly enough.|Saw Gerrera and Anto Kreegyr|<ref name="Edge of the Abyss" />}}
[[Luthen Rael]] urged Gerrera to decommission the Library, a location on Naboo. Revolutionary [[Anto Kreegyr]] sent a message to Gerrera, who did not reply. Discontent, Kreegyr located the Library, and Gerrera confronted him at a nearby café. Approaching the café, Gerrera recognized Kreegyr from a description provided to him by a librarian. Gerrera cursed himself for not guessing Kreegyr would not wait for a response but was more concerned Kreegyr located the Library. He reflected that Rael had been right and that the Library was less secure than he thought.<ref name="Edge of the Abyss" />

Looming over Kreegyr, Gerrera surprised the man, eliciting a nervous response. Gerrera indicated the two would walk together and turned on his heel. Kreegyr stumbled into his table as he got to his feet, amusing Gerrera. Once they were down the block, Gerrera observed that Kreegyr appeared much the same as he had before, although he reassessed his low opinion of Kreegyr's intelligence for his discovery of the Library. Kreegyr informed Gerrera that he had been looking for him, confirming that Gerrera had received his transmission and stating that he was ready to fight. Always in need of soldiers, Gerrera offered Kreegyr three minutes to prove that he was not still a fool.<ref name="Edge of the Abyss" />

Kreegyr told Gerrera that his actions on Inusagi were all over the holofeeds. Everyone knew who Gerrera was and that he was unafraid to face down the Empire, Gerrera briefly ruminating on his ghosts and flesh and blood fears. Kreegyr emphasized that everyone was talking about Onderon and about Gerrera, but Gerrera countered Kreegyr, asking if that brought his friends or his sister back or made them free. Kreegyr pointed out that Gerrera's methods attracted attention and support, showing Kreegyr, a former believer in peaceful protest, that violence worked.<ref name="Edge of the Abyss" />

Wondering if that was what Kreegyr had learned from Inusagi, Gerrera asked him what he wanted. Kreegyr said he needed his own Inusagi to spread awareness about what the Empire had done to Bizen, and to that end, weapons. Amused, Gerrera asked what kinds of weapons. Kreegyr suggested blasters, rifles, cannons, detonators; whatever Gerrera had, he could make work. With no intention of giving Kreegyr such firepower, Gerrera inquired what those weapons would be used for. Kreegyr claimed he had a target, although Gerrera perceived his unsteady voice as a sign of a lie or a lack of confidence. Refusing to elaborate, Kreegyr referred to his plans as spectacular. Gerrera admonished Kreegyr that they were not playing a game, asking if he thought killing was fun; spectacular. Kreegyr denied the accusation. When Gerrera asked if Kreegyr had a crew, he admitted that he had not found one yet.<ref name="Edge of the Abyss" />

Gerrera judged Kreegyr as not ready, which Kreegyr protested. Waving him off, Gerrera informed Kreegyr that his approach was out of order: decide on your target, find your crew, then talk weapons. Grasping Gerrera's arm as to halt him, Kreegyr assured Gerrera that he knew what he was doing and that his failure on Fesat Four would not be repeated. Gerrera interrupted Kreegyr, who reiterated that he needed the news to talk about Bizen, crowding him and looking the man in the eye. Growling that people knowing about Bizen would not be enough to spur them to action, Gerrera told Kreegyr that he was a fool. People were selfish and small, craving comfort and safety. Gerrera said that revolution was for the brave, for those willing to die, and asked Kreegyr himself if he was willing to die.<ref name="Edge of the Abyss" />

Kreegyr became flustered and stuttered that he was only asking for Gerrera's help. Gerrera repeated his question, refusing to back down. Kreegyr claimed that he was, but Gerrera observed a lack of conviction and told Kreegyr he did not believe him. Repeating himself more forcefully, Kreegyr expressed that no one wanted to die and his desire to succeed at a mission, asking if surviving to do it again would be the victory. Moving away, Gerrera murmured he did not yet want it badly enough. Kreegyr flinched, upset at the death of his mother and destruction of his home.<ref name="Edge of the Abyss" />

As Jyn matured, and as Saw became increasingly paranoid over time, he came to fear that Jyn would eventually be recognized as the daughter of a known Imperial collaborator and thus exploited to be used as a ransom against Galen. To help prevent this, Saw tortured Partisans to assess if they knew of Jyn's identity, even disposing of [[Jari]] at an unknown Imperial [[barracks]] due to the same reason. With the constant worry of others finding out Jyn's identity Saw decided, when Jyn was sixteen, to abandon her in a bunker with nothing more than a knife and a blaster for protection. He had instructed her to wait in the bunker until morning, by which time Saw was gone.<ref name="Rebel Rising" /> He came to justify the decision by telling himself, and later her, that she was already one of his best people and that he knew she could survive without his aid. The decision was seen as a betrayal by Jyn, left a feeling of disenchantment for Saw, and for the rebellion in general, in her mind.<ref name="Rogue One" />

====Dealings with Axis====
=====Meeting with Luthen Rael=====
{{Quote|Kreegyr's a ''separatist''. Maya-Pei's a ''neo-republican''. The Ghorman front, the Partisan alliance, sectorists, human cultists, galaxy partitionists…they're ''lost!'' ''All'' of them! ''Lost!'' Lost. What are ''you'', Luthen? I've never really known.|Saw Gerrera, to Luthen Rael|<ref name="Narkina 5">{{Andor|Narkina 5 (episode)}}</ref>}}
After the raid on the Imperial garrison on Aldhani<ref name="Aldhani">{{Andor|Aldhani (episode)}}</ref> in [[5 BBY]],<ref name="LargeDateNote" /> [[Luthen Rael]] traveled to Gerrera's base on [[Segra Milo]] and met with him. Getting down to business, Rael offered the freedom fighter the opportunity to trade several pieces of stolen Imperial technology, including a full set of Imperial drive adapters and three sealed [[Steergard]] targeting deflectors. After Rael confirmed that he had the items with him, Gerrera asked for him to set his price.<ref name="Narkina 5" />

[[File:Saw_Gerrera_Andor.png|left|thumb|267x267px|Saw Gerrera grew increasingly extremist as the Imperial era continued on.]]
To Gerrera's surprise, Rael asked that he meet [[Anto Kreegyr]], a contact who has been probing the [[Spellhaus Imperial power station|Imperial power station]] at [[Spellhaus]]. Rael continued by saying that Kreegyr has found some weaknesses in the defense, but that he had an angle. Since Kreegyr was a Separatist, Gerrera dismissed Rael's offer, but Rael insisted that Gerrera hear Kreegyr out. As Gerrera was unwilling to work with Kreegyr, Rael stated that technology would come on the condition that he work with Kreegyr, warning him that he would go to someone else if he did not comply.<ref name="Narkina 5" />

Gerrera insisted on working alone, but Rael asserted that that would have to change, telling Gerrera that they needed to work together to bring down the Empire. Gerrera persisted by saying that he was not a mercenary, but Rael asked him to imagine Spellhaus in flames. After listing a number of fallen rebel alliances, Gerrera asked what Rael was trying to accomplish. Rael responded by saying that he was a coward and was terrified that the Empire's power would grow beyond their means to stop it. He carried on by saying that they needed to put aside their differences, but Gerrera countered by claiming that he was the only one with clarity of purpose. Laughing, Rael stated that anarchy was a seductive concept for a man hiding in cold caves and begging for spare parts. Despite this, Gerrera refused to buy parts from Rael, telling him to find someone else to help Kreegyr.<ref name="Narkina 5" />

=====Second meeting with Rael=====
{{Quote|Thirty men.''"<br />"''Plus Kreegyr.''"<br />"''For the greater good.''"<br />"''Call it what you will.''"<br />"''Let's call it…war.|Saw Gerrera and Luthen Rael|<ref name="Daughter of Ferrix">{{Andor|Daughter of Ferrix}}</ref>}}
A little more than a month later, Gerrera had reconsidered his position and met with Rael a second time to join Kreegyr's attack on the Spellhaus power station. He told Rael that he would provide air power, but that aside from being told when it was needed he would be taking no tactical orders from Kreegyr and that his terms were non-negotiable. With the attack just a day away, Rael said he was too late. Since Gerrera would not back down so easily, Rael reluctantly explained that the ISB had learned of the imminent attack and would be waiting for the rebels on arrival at Spellhaus. Gerrera asked how Rael knew he would not warn Kreegyr, to which Rael replied that Gerrera was completely unpredictable. He continued by stating the decision to warn Kreegyr was now Gerrera's, but to consider the repercussions of both outcomes.<ref name="Daughter of Ferrix" />

Deducing that Rael must have an informant in the ISB, Gerrera began looking around his HQ, wondering if a spy was among his own ranks. Rael said that Gerrera was avoiding the matter at hand, but Gerrera demanded to know who the spy was. Rael claimed Benthic was his man who told him everything, to which Benthic stepped forward in protest. Rael swiftly took Benthic's blaster from his holster and pointed it at Gerrera to get him to listen. Rael elaborated on how the ISB would become arrogant after Kreegyr's downfall, giving them a "clear field to play." He commented the alternative would lead to doubt and distrust in the ISB just as Gerrera is exhibiting now. Confirming a final time that thirty-one men would be sacrificed for this, Gerrera decided against warning Kreegyr for the sake of the war.<ref name="Daughter of Ferrix" />

====The perfect night====
=====Rhydonium reverie=====
{{Quote|Have you ever seen a man die from rhydonium? Maybe you're like me, maybe you, you love… ''[sniffs]'' the smell of it. And maybe you breathe just a little too deeply. Burned from the inside. You watch your skin blister as it melts away. Or, you die loud. Cut a line? Drop a wrench? Let it spill? Don't even need a spark, do you, boy? Do you? Boom! Burn from the outside.|Saw Gerrera, to Wilmon Paak|<ref name="Ever Been to Ghorman?" />}}
By [[3 BBY]], Gerrera's Partisans established a base of operations on D'Qar. That year, Rael put [[Wilmon Paak]], an engineer belonging to Rael's Axis network, at Gerrera's disposal to manufacture a rhydonium mechanism. Paak presented the device to Gerrera who, admiring its loveliness, admitted it was a dream of his. Gerrera asked if it was "healthy" and had a full kit, which Paak confirmed, indicating its six gauges and eight variations.<ref name="Ever Been to Ghorman?" />

Becoming excited, Gerrera lauded the technology to his guerrillas as a galaxy of opportunities; rhydonium on demand—what they wanted, when they wanted it. Gerrera asked Paak if the machine had been tested, to which he plainly stated that it worked. Demeanor shifting, Gerrera asked Paak who had taught him, leading Paak to question the inquiry in turn. Acknowledging rhydonium's high volatility and that few survived working with it, Gerrera reiterated his question. Paak replied that he was there to teach the variations and could not elaborate further.<ref name="Ever Been to Ghorman?" />

Gerrera commended Paak's bravery, causing an eruption of laughter from the assembled Partisans, before asking if Paak had ever seen anyone die from rhydonium. Engaging in speculation, Gerrera wondered aloud if Paak, like himself, loved the smell of rhydonium; if inhaled too strongly, it would cause Paak's skin to blister as he combusted from the inside out. If Paak spilled it, cut a line, or dropped a wrench, Paak would ignite without a spark; immediate, explosive immolation.<ref name="Ever Been to Ghorman?" />

Asking Paak's name, Gerrera dubbed him "the Boy," inquiring if he had any actual experience. Paak admitted that he'd configured the device twice, though never alone. Observing that Paak was still alive, Gerrera summoned Pluti and instructed Paak to teach him the variations, starting with Paak's favorite. Paak alluded that it would be helpful to know what station the Partisans intended to hit, but Gerrera refused to disclose the information. Stressing that he needed to leave the next day, Paak was refuted by Gerrera, who altered the deal, promising to tell Rael that Paak was being cared for. Gerrera ordered that accommodations be made for Paak, who would stay as long as Gerrera had need of him.<ref name="Ever Been to Ghorman?" />

=====High on his own supply=====
{{Quote|Where are you, boy? You're here! You're not with Luthen. You're here! You're right here, and you're ready to fight!|Saw Gerrera, to Wilmon Paak|<ref name="I Have Friends Everywhere" />}}
Studying under Paak, Pluti approached Gerrera with an understanding of the variations, though he desired more practice. Gerrera asked if they could lose Paak, who knew too much, confirming if Pluti was ready. Pluti defended Paak as a great engineer and asked what they would tell whoever sent him, but Gerrera dismissed Pluti, preferring to write Paak off as an accident. When Pluti expressed disappointment that Paak would not join them, Gerrera claimed he lacked confidence. Pluti, overwhelmed, pressed Gerrera for the information to focus on a single variations. Gerrera revealed that the attack would target the Station Four junction of Neen Valley's Markez Moon pipeline, occurring the next night. Specifying that Tubes had the pipe numbers, Gerrera opted to keep Paak around for a while longer.<ref name="I Have Friends Everywhere" />

Later, Gerrera and Tubes approached Paak and Pluti. Gerrera asked Paak if Pluti could perform the operation independently, which Paak believed to be the case. Questioning his uncertainty, Gerrera raised a blaster to Paak's head, causing Paak to plead for his life. Gerrera instead executed Pluti, revealing him to be a traitor transmitting to the Empire. Having fed Pluti false information, Gerrera reassured the Partisans that they would not be caught in the ambush waiting for them on the Markez Moon, peacefully drinking rhydo parsecs away. Gerrera ordered the guerrillas to move quickly and burn what they did not take, as the Partisans would not be back to D'Qar.<ref name="I Have Friends Everywhere" />

Once the Partisans arrived at their actual target, Paak began calibrating the mechanism on a pipeline. As he waited, Gerrera began to tell a story from his younger days, reminiscing on his internment to a labour camp in the Onderonian jungle and the horrific conditions he faced, one of three hundred prisoners working in weather so hot they were forced to work naked. One day, everyone at the camp started to itch simultaneously, caused by a spillage of rhydonium that could be felt before being smelt. While everyone fled, Gerrera was the only one to stay, because the rhydo was "new" for him. Paak then succeeded in arming the device, which caused rhydonium steam to begin spilling from a valve in front of them.<ref name="I Have Friends Everywhere" />

Gerrera approached the steam with glee and muttered about his love for it, causing Paak to react with alarm and confusion as he began huffing the rhydonium with no side effects. Gerrera could do so because he understood the rhydo, loving it like a sister and calling the burn a joy. He suspected Paak thought him crazy, but instead admitted that he was; revolution wasn't for the sane, but the broken and hunted like them still stand, despite knowing they won't live to see the Republic reborn. He questioned where Paak was at that moment, then began to howl that he was right there with Gerrera and ready to fight. Inspired by Gerrera's words, Paak removed his protective mask and began painfully breathing in the rhydo, fueled by Gerrera's wild inspirations urging him to let it in. As Paak screamed in agony from the rhydo's burn, Gerrera cheered for him to let his newfound freedom run wild.<ref name="I Have Friends Everywhere" />

====Assassination of Moff Panaka====
{{Quote|The bombing was the work of a group that calls themselves the partisans, ''[sic]'' led by a man named Saw Gerrera. He's a brave man, an intelligent fighter…but his methods are becoming more violent, more extreme.|Breha Organa|<ref name="Leia">''[[Leia, Princess of Alderaan]]''</ref>}}
[[File:SawGerrera-SWR.png|thumb|right|200px|Gerrera arranged for the assassination of Moff Panaka.]]
In 3 BBY,<ref name="Timelines" /> Gerrera, shaven his head bald again, arranged<ref name="TSWB">''[[The Star Wars Book]]''</ref> for a bomb to detonate at the [[Quarsh Panaka's chalet|residence]] of [[Moff]] [[Quarsh Panaka]]. The bomb achieved its objective of [[Strike on Onoam|killing]] the Moff who was supposedly one of the [[Galactic Emperor|Emperor's]] most loyal servants. The timing of the bomb narrowly missed killing [[Princess]] [[Leia Skywalker Organa Solo|Leia Organa]] of [[Alderaan]] and [[Naboo]]'s [[queen]] [[Dalné]], who had only just bid farewell to the Moff in his chalet moments before the explosion after discussing improving the working conditions of the [[miner]]s on [[Onoam]]. Although no real proof was ever given that Saw ordered the Moff's death, Leia's mother [[Breha Organa]]<ref name="Leia" /> correctly<ref name="TSWB" /> surmised that as leader of the Partisans, he must have been involved in some way and told Leia that she and her husband would be telling Saw how close he had come to murdering their daughter.<ref name="Leia" />

The assassination of Panaka greatly upset the rest of the rebels, who became increasingly frustrated at trying to keep the Partisans in line, as Panaka was the highest ranking member of the Emperor's inner circle that they had any hope of contacting some day and possibly even working with. With Saw's actions this was no longer a possibility. Princess Leia also didn't approve of Panaka's assassination as she viewed him as a good man though she initially allowed the Partisan she saw on Onoam to escape Imperial arrest as she feared that her parents may have been involved in the assassination, an accusation that greatly angered and offended Bail Organa.<ref name="Leia" />

Unbeknownst to Gerrera, his actions had indirectly saved Leia and her adoptive family as during Panaka's meeting with her and Danlé, Leia was wearing the [[jubilation dress]] that was once worn by her biological mother [[Padmé Amidala Naberrie|Padmé Amidala]] which caused Panaka a great shock, and he managed to deduce Leia's heritage, unknown to even the princess at the time, and had planned on telling Palpatine however his death prevented this.<ref name="Leia" />

===Galactic Civil War===
====Mission to Geonosis====
{{Quote|The Empire is hiding something. Something important.|Saw Gerrera, to the Spectres|<ref name="Ghosts of Geonosis" />}}
In [[2 BBY]],<ref name="Timelines" /> Saw led a [[Mission to investigate Geonosis|mission to investigate]] the apparent [[Sterilization of Geonosis|disappearance]] of the [[Geonosian]] species of the planet [[Geonosis]].<ref name="Rogue One Visual Guide" /> His Partisan group had become one of the many cells that would form the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic|Rebel Alliance]]. Saw undertook the Geonosian mission on behalf of [[Alliance High Command|Rebel Command]] and Senator [[Bail Prestor Organa|Bail Organa]], an ally of the growing rebellion in the [[Imperial Senate]]. His team lost contact with Rebel Command after picking up an energy reading, which turned out to be an operational deflector shield generator.<ref name="Ghosts of Geonosis" />

While exploring an underground labyrinth, Saw and his team were ambushed by [[Klik-Klak]],<ref name="Ghosts of Geonosis" /> the sole Geonosian to have survived the Sterilization of Geonosis.<ref name="Klik-Klak">{{Databank|klik-klak|Klik-Klak}}</ref> Klik-Klak's battle droids killed Saw's team but Saw managed to survive long enough for members of the [[Spectres]] rebel cell and Rex to rescue him. Saw saved the Spectres and Rex from a group of B1 battle droids and a droideka. Believing that the "bug" Klik-Klak was key to finding out why the Empire had exterminated the population of Geonosis, Saw convinced Rex and the Spectres to help him capture Klik-Klak.<ref name="Ghosts of Geonosis" />

[[File:Saw_gerrera_on_Star_Wars_Rebels.png|thumb|left|250px|Saw Gerrera on Geonosis in 2 BBY.]]
While exploring the central air shaft, Saw and his team discovered Klik-Klak hiding on the other side. While the Spectres [[Ezra Bridger]] and [[C1-10P|Chopper]] pursued the Geonosian, Saw waited with Kanan and Rex when the Spectres' leader [[Hera Syndulla]] contacted Kanan. When Hera told them to leave, Saw convinced the Spectres to delay their stay so that they could complete his original mission to investigate the disappearance of the Geonosian species. Using [[the Force]], Kanan used a stone bridge to ferry Saw and Rex safely across to the other side of the air shaft.<ref name="Ghosts of Geonosis" />

Once they had crossed, Saw and his rebel companions managed to corner Klik-Klak. Saw also shot out Klik Klak's remote controller with his blaster; deactivating several droidekas which were attacking the Spectres [[Sabine Wren]] and [[Garazeb Orrelios]] above. Saw then interrogated Klik-Klak and demanded to know what the Empire was building on Geonosis. Unable to speak [[Galactic Basic Standard]], Klik-Klak drew in the sand repeatedly. Ezra managed to befriend Klik-Klak. After Chopper picked up an energy reading, Saw forced Klik-Klak to lead them to the source.<ref name="Ghosts of Geonosis" />

Saw and his companions soon discovered the energy reading came from [[Klik-Klak's nest]], which served as his workshop and contained a [[transmitter]]. Still bitter about the loss of his sister Steela at the hands of the Separatists, Saw aggressively questioned Klik-Klak and rummaged through his place. Saw's aggressive methods yielded no results while Ezra's gentler methods convinced Klik-Klak to reveal that he was the custodian of the last known Geonosian queen egg. Saw wanted to interrogate Klik-Klak off-world but Ezra objected on the grounds that Klik-Klak and the egg were among the last of their species and belonged on Geonosis. In the end, Kanan brokered a compromise whereby the rebels could question Klik-Klak at Chopper Base and then return him to Geonosis.<ref name="Ghosts of Geonosis" />

Saw, his rebel allies and their prisoner Klik-Klak rendezvoused with the Spectres' ship ''[[Ghost]]'' in the central air shaft. Once aboard, Saw exchanged pleasantries with Hera and the rest of her crew. While Kanan and Hera were preoccupied, Saw reneged on his earlier agreement and tried to take Klik-Klak off-world on the shuttle ''[[Phantom II]]''. To force Klik-Klak's cooperation, Saw shocked him with an electro-shock device. This sparked an argument with the Spectres and Rex, who all objected to Saw's harsh methods. After fighting off Ezra and Rex, Saw threatened to destroy the Geonosian queen egg. In response, Ezra and Rex urged him not to become like the Empire he was fighting against.<ref name="Ghosts of Geonosis" />

Saw's argument with the Spectres was interrupted by the arrival of [[Captain]] [[Brunson]]'s [[Brunson's Arquitens-class command cruiser|''Arquitens''-class command cruiser]], which blocked the air shaft and deployed a squad of [[Jumptrooper]]s to board the ''Ghost''. Saw joined the rebels in repelling the Imperial boarders as the ship descended into the depths of Geonosis. Once at the bottom, Saw and his rebel comrades discovered several poison canisters which provided compelling evidence that the Empire had perpetrated genocide against the Geonosians. Regretting his past behavior towards Klik-Klak, Saw argued that the Geonosians deserved the same right to rebuild as other peoples and released Klik-Klak and the Geonosian egg.<ref name="Ghosts of Geonosis" />

After releasing Klik-Klak and taking several of the poison canisters, the ''Ghost'' managed to escape Geonosis by blasting through the Imperial light cruiser with [[proton torpedo]]es. Despite their successful escape, the rebels lost the poison canisters and were forced to make do with images of the canisters instead. Though Senator Organa and Commander [[Jun Sato]] regarded the mission as a success for rescuing Saw and obtaining a new [[deflector core]], Saw was disappointed that they still had not found out what the Empire was building on Geonosis. Kanan reassured him that they would eventually find out sooner or later.<ref name="Ghosts of Geonosis" />

====Jalindi and a personal quest====
{{Quote|If you continue to allow this war to be fought on the Empire's terms, not yours, you are going to lose."<br />"I will not be lectured on military strategy by a man who has proven himself a criminal."<br />"The Empire considers ''both'' of us criminals. At least I ''act'' like one.|Saw Gerrera and Mon Mothma|<ref name="In the Name of the Rebellion">{{Rebels|In the Name of the Rebellion}}</ref>}}
[[File:In_the_Name_-_Saw_Speaks.png|thumb|right|250px|Saw Gerrera clashed with Mon Mothma's Rebel Alliance over tactics.]]
In [[1 BBY]], Saw was first mentioned by Bail Organa, where he gave information that was supplied by Saw; primarily, a new [[Jalindi Station|relay]] being used by the Empire. When the Rebellion wanted to tap into the relay to learn what the Empire was doing, Saw, who had sent an [[R4-C2|astromech]], appeared and stated that they were cowards, as they were not doing what it would take to win. After [[Mon Mothma]] cut off communications with him, Saw prepared to head to the relay to destroy it. He arrived on his [[UT-60D U-wing starfighter/support craft|U-Wing]] with the help of his pilot, [[Edrio]]. Upon opening the doors to drop bombs, he was surprised to see Ezra and Sabine, greeting the two while tossing out three packs of proton bombs onto the relay. Telling them that the bombs would detonate soon, he let them board his starfighter and proceeded to fly out of the area just as the bombs exploded, destroying the relay and killing [[Brom Titus]].<ref name="In the Name of the Rebellion" />

Outside in Jalindi's space, Hera contacted him and told him to return Ezra and Sabine. Saw agreed and prepared the process; however, a [[Star Destroyer]] suddenly appeared, forcing Saw to leave for [[Faos Station]] with them. During the trip, Saw told the two that he needed their help as, after the events on Geonosis, he still did not know what the Empire was building. Upon arriving at Faos Station, he, Ezra, Sabine, and Chopper boarded [[Freighter 2716]].<ref name="In the Name of the Rebellion" />

Upon investigating the materials, which were used for the construction of Star Destroyers, Saw claimed that the Empire was up to something. Continuing his investigation, they found Imperial stormtroopers on the ship and learned that the freighter was heading towards the remote [[Tonnis sector]], cementing Saw's suspicions. When Chopper told him that hold 12 contained an Imperial shuttle, they went in and found prisoners, who were either power or reactor technicians. Later on when Ezra kept hearing "singing," Chopper revealed that hold 17 was a restricted area. Upon opening the door to that hold, they encountered a [[death trooper]], prompting Saw to fire at point-blank range, killing the trooper. Sabine tossed several smoke grenades into the room, which Saw used to blend in and take down several troopers.<ref name="In the Name of the Rebellion" />

After clearing the area, [[DT-F16|one of the troopers]] managed to escape. Saw wanted to go after her, but Sabine told him not to. They inspected the mysterious cargo the troopers were protecting and realized that it was an unusually large [[kyber crystal]]. Saw, adamant in finding out what the Empire was building, reluctantly stayed to guard the [[crystal]] while Ezra and Sabine went to sabotage the hyperspace drive. However, he quickly betrayed them and stunned the two in the engine room.<ref name="In the Name of the Rebellion" />

When Ezra and Sabine woke up, they asked Saw why he betrayed them. Saw stated that they were very close to finding out the secret weapon and told them to look on the screen. When the freighter arrived at the Tonnis sector, they only saw a single Star Destroyer. Confused, but still convinced of the Empire's nefarious designs with the crystal, he used Ezra's lightsaber to destroy the freighter's hyperdrive before firing onto the crystal's mounting, effectively turning the crystal into a time bomb. He then freed the two, while Edrio, who had tailed the freighter, informed Saw that he was outside. Knowing that Ezra and Sabine no longer agreed with his methods, Saw bid farewell to them while they made their individual escapes before the freighter and Star Destroyer were obliterated.<ref name="In the Name of the Rebellion" />

====Mission to Dooma 4====
{{Quote|Hold On! We'll wait here for a while!|Saw Gerrera|<ref name="Crossing the Line">{{RebelsAnimationCite|4|Crossing the Line}}</ref>}}
Gerrera later learned that the [[Imperial Metal Factory]] on [[Dooma 4]] was providing components for a secret Imperial project. He and the Partisans undertook a [[Assault on Dooma 4|mission]] to the factory to blow up the station.<ref name="Crossing the Line" />

====Taking the fight to Jedha====
{{Quote|We are not insurgents. We are partisans. We are a rebellion. I bring battle-hardened fighters. I bring experienced tacticians. I bring pilots, a squadron of them. I bring the means with which to fight back. I am inviting you, both of you, to join me in this.|Saw Gerrera to Baze Malbus and Chirrut Îmwe|<ref name="Guardians of the Whills" />}}
[[File:Saw_Recruits_Chirrut_and_Baze.png|thumb|left|250px|Saw Gerrera meeting with Chirrut Îmwe and Baze Malbus and attempting to recruit them into his Partisans.]]
With his campaigns against the Empire becoming increasingly brutal, Alliance High Command, at the urging of Mon Mothma, [[Resolution of Censure Condemning Saw Gerrera of the Partisans|formally censured Gerrera]] and severed all official ties with the Partisans. By this time, Gerrera had lost his right leg and struggled to walk on a low-grade [[Cybernetics|cybernetic replacement]].<ref name="Rogue One" /> Additionally, beyond his years spent huffing rhydonium fumes,<ref name="TonyGilroy" /> his exposure to [[Insecticide|Geonosian insecticides]]<ref name="Rogue One Visual Guide" /> had scarred his [[lung]]s, confining him to a [[Saw Gerrera's suit|pressurized armor suit]].<ref name="Rogue One" /> Within that suit, however, he continued to suck down rhydonium fumes<ref name="TonyGilroy" /> through an oxygen mask.<ref name="Rogue One Junior Novel" />

Having previously learned that the Empire's massive kyber crystal had come from [[Jedha]], Gerrera relocated his militia to the moon, feeling that it was an appropriate place to bring his rebellion, as it was a sacred world to many different galactic religions.<ref name="Guardians of the Whills" /><ref name="Rogue One Visual Guide" /> Due to the Imperials defiling many religious temples and artifacts in their pursuit of kyber crystals, small, local insurgent cells had begun forming in the Holy City of NiJedha in opposition to the occupation. From his new base of operations in the [[Catacombs of Cadera]], just a half-day's walk outside the Holy City, Gerrera began recruiting and organizing the local insurgencies under the umbrella of his Partisans.<ref name="Rogue One Visual Guide" /><ref name="Rogue One" /> During this time, he still held command over a pair of UT-60D U-wing troop transports and six T-65 X-wing fighters.<ref name="Rogue One" /><ref name="Saw Gerrera card">{{FFGXW|set=Saw's Renegades Expansion Pack|cardname=Saw Gerrera|ship=U-wing}}</ref>

Among the local insurgents Gerrera recruited were [[Guardians of the Whills]] [[Chirrut Îmwe]] and [[Baze Malbus]], whom he enticed into joining by providing much needed provisions for the [[Gimm sisters' orphanage|orphanage]] run by Îmwe and Malbus's friends, [[Kaya Gimm|Kaya]] and [[Killi Gimm]]. Over several months, the Partisans attacked the Imperial occupiers, leading to harsher and harsher reprisals from the Empire. The Star Destroyer that had previously orbited high over Jedha descended to rest right above the Holy City, and the number of [[stormtrooper]]s, tanks, and walkers on patrol in the streets increased significantly. Îmwe and Malbus came to Gerrera asking for assistance stealing a spacecraft so the Gimm sisters could flee the planet with their orphans. A group of Partisans, led by [[Beezer Fortuna]], helped Îmwe and Malbus steal a [[Sentinel-class landing craft|''Sentinel''-class shuttle]]. Under the orders of Gerrera, Fortuna and the other Partisans attempted to double-cross Îmwe and Malbus, wishing to use the shuttle to blow up the Star Destroyer over the city. Îmwe and Malbus were able to talk the Partisans out of taking the shuttle, allowing the orphans to escape Jedha. However, this led to Gerrera parting ways with Îmwe and Malbus.<ref name="Guardians of the Whills" />

====Reuniting with Jyn and death====
{{Quote|Save the Rebellion! Save the dream!|Saw Gerrera, to Jyn Erso, as Jedha is ripped apart|<ref name="Rogue One" />}}
[[File:Saw_Gerrera_with_cane.jpg|thumb|right|250px|Gerrera meeting with Jyn Erso.]]
In [[1 BBY]],<ref name="Timelines" /> just prior to the [[Battle of Scarif]], the Partisans captured [[Bodhi Rook]], a recently defected Imperial pilot. Bodhi carried a message from Galen Erso, who was trying to alert the Rebellion to the nearly-completed Death Star project. However, increasingly paranoid and believing that Imperial spies were everywhere, Gerrera was convinced that the defection was a trick by the Empire. To ascertain the truth, Gerrera used a [[mairan]] named [[Bor Gullet]] to read Rook's mind, at the risk of driving him insane. Afterward, he left the catatonic Rook in a cell, before deploying his men under Benthic and Edrio to attack an Imperial kyber convoy in [[Jedha City]]. In the ensuing firefight, [[Rebel Alliance Intelligence Service|Rebel intelligence]] Captain [[Cassian Jeron Andor|Cassian Andor]], along with Jyn Erso, were captured: both were on the moon in search of Rook, whom the Rebel Alliance had learned had a message from Galen Erso.<ref name="Rogue One" />

Jyn and Cassian, along with Îmwe and Malbus, who had been caught up in the fighting, were brought to Saw's headquarters in the Catacombs of Cadera. Saw would see only Jyn. He questioned her on why she was there, demanding to know if she was there to kill him. She told him that she was there to ask for the message from her father and when it was given to the Rebel Alliance she would be on her way. Saw asked her why she did not believe in the dream of freedom throughout the galaxy. She told him about how he abandoned her at the age of sixteen and that his war did not mean anything to her. He then showed her the message from her father which revealed the weakness in the Empire's superweapon.<ref name="Rogue One" />

[[File:SawGerreraSteela-RogueOne3.png|thumb|left|300px|Saw Gerrera thinks of his sister moments before his death]]
However, as they spoke, [[Grand Moff]] Wilhuff Tarkin and Orson Krennic had resolved to test-fire the Death Star's [[superlaser]] on Jedha, having traced Bodhi there and seeing an opportunity to wipe out Saw's insurgency. A low-power shot [[Destruction of Jedha City|wiped out]] Jedha City in an instant and created a blast wave that spread for kilometers in every direction, threatening the Catacombs. Realizing the threat, Saw released his prisoners, commending Galen's message to Jyn and begging her to save the Rebellion. However, he declared that he would run no longer and remained in the Catacombs. After seeing Jyn's party escape, his last act was to tear off his breath mask before the blast wave consumed the Catacombs, killing him.<ref name="Rogue One" /> His last thoughts were for his late sister, Steela, and his last word was her name.<ref name="RO 3">[[Rogue One Adaptation 3|''Rogue One Adaptation'' 3]]</ref>

===Legacy===
====Partisan inspiration====
{{Quote|We call ourselves the Dreamers.''"<br />"''Dreamers? Azen said you were Saw Gerrera's partisans.''"<br />"''We can't be him. We're just following in his footsteps. We're keeping alive the Dream. Saw was the face, the voice, of our cause.|Staven and [[Iden Versio]]|<ref name="Inferno Squad">''[[Battlefront II: Inferno Squad]]''</ref>}}
[[File:LuxBonteri-TotOR2023.png|thumb|left|200px|Saw's old ally Lux lead his remaining Partisans, renaming them the Dreamers.]]
Shortly after the [[Battle of Yavin]], some remaining partisans regrouped and formed the [[Dreamers]] led by [[Staven]] and [[Lux Bonteri]]. The group were supplied by an old ally a [[Pantoran]] [[pirate]] named [[Lassa Rhayme]], who supplied the Dreamers with food and weapons. The elite Imperial unit known as [[Inferno Squad]] [[Dreamers Infiltration|infiltrated]] the Dreamers at their [[Dreamers' encampment|base]] of [[Jeosyn]] and destroyed them from the inside.<ref name="Inferno Squad" /> Another group of remaining partisans led by [[Benthic]] remained on Jedha defending against the Imperials who returned to the moon for more kyber crystals.<ref name="Star Wars 38">[[Star Wars (2015) 38|''Star Wars'' (2015) 38]]</ref>

Gerrera's old ally Bonteri eventually joined the Dreamers as "the Mentor" after having contacted his [[Lux Bonteri's stepdaughter|stepdaughter]] telling her that Gerrera's death had upset him more than he could have realized and asked for amnesty in exchange for surrendering to the Empire and disclosing all his information on the Rebel Alliance and their operations. She gave him a list of specific times and locations where he could turn himself in. Bonteri, however, instead used the locations to give Staven a supply of targets to hit.<ref name="Inferno Squad" />

====Under a New Republic====
{{Quote|For years, Saw Gerrera was the most wanted criminal in the galaxy. His rampant terrorist strikes resulted in atrocious civilian casualties earning him this distinction. He was known to subject prisoners to torture behind the bounds of the Alderaan Convention.|Exantor Divo, ''Scum and Villainy: Case Files on the Galaxy's Most Notorious''|<ref name="Case Files on the Galaxy's Most Notorious">''[[Star Wars: Scum and Villainy: Case Files on the Galaxy's Most Notorious]]''</ref>}}
By the time of the [[New Republic]], some like the [[Centrists|Centrist]] [[junior senator]] [[Ransolm Casterfo]] remembered Saw Gerrera and his Partisans as violent extremists who represented the worst of the Rebel Alliance. Casterfo cited Saw's actions among others as evidence of the Alliance's alleged atrocities during a political discussion with the [[Populists|Populist]] [[Senior Senator|senior senator]] Leia Organa, rebutting that the Alliance did what they thought was necessary and reminded the Empire employed far more brutal tactics and the stakes being too high.<ref name="Bloodline" />  While reviewing past reports of the Rebel Alliance during her time in the [[Resistance]], Organa also recalled the reveal of the Death Star to be a cumulation of Saw's crusade and acknowledged the Alliance taking his efforts for granted until it was too late.<ref name="Rebel Files">''[[Star Wars: The Rebel Files]]''</ref> Gererra was mentioned in the ''[[Galactic Explorer's Guide]]'', a survival guide written by [[Hondo Ohnaka]] and [[DK-RA-43]].<ref name="Galactic Explorer's Guide">''[[Star Wars: The Galactic Explorer's Guide]]''</ref>

Historian [[Beaumont Kin]] mentioned Saw Gerrera and his partisans several times when he published ''[[The Rise and Fall of the Galactic Empire]],'' having accessed his personal datafile that allowed him to confirm the existence of [[Luthen Rael]] and the [[Axis network]], remarked on his connection to the [[Erso family]], and noted how Gerrera's file for the Spellhause Operation had casualties at 30 versus the Alliance stating around 50.<ref name="Star Wars: The Rise and Fall of the Galactic Empire">''[[Star Wars: The Rise and Fall of the Galactic Empire]]''</ref>

==Personality and traits==

===General information===
Saw Gerrera was a human (Onderonian) male who was 1.80 [https://starwars.fandom.com/wiki/Meter meters] tall with dark skin. During the Clone War, his [https://starwars.fandom.com/wiki/Hair hair] was [https://starwars.fandom.com/wiki/Color black], with an orange [https://starwars.fandom.com/wiki/Hair_dye stripe]. His hair later began graying and he stopped dying the orange stripe. Gerrera's [https://starwars.fandom.com/wiki/Eye eyes] were blue, later becoming green before turning brown by the time of the [https://starwars.fandom.com/wiki/Jedha_insurgency Jedha insurgency]. Gerrera had multiple cybernetics; a [https://starwars.fandom.com/wiki/Cybernetics cybernetic] right [https://starwars.fandom.com/wiki/Limb leg] as well as an [https://starwars.fandom.com/wiki/Oxygen oxygen] [https://starwars.fandom.com/wiki/Breath_mask respirator], a [https://starwars.fandom.com/wiki/Saw_Gerrera's_suit pressurized suit of armor] and [https://starwars.fandom.com/wiki/Armor reinforced] [https://starwars.fandom.com/wiki/Lung lungs].   Gerrera had a addiction to the smell of and burning sensation of [https://starwars.fandom.com/wiki/Rhydonium rhydonium] that dated back to his younger years;<ref name="Ever Been to Ghorman?2">{{Andor|Ever Been to Ghorman?}}</ref> During the Imperial era, it impacted his facilities as he believed he "understood" it and used no protection against its fumes.<ref name="Ever Been to Ghorman?2" />

===Onderonian hero===
 {{Quote|I'm not a terrorist. I'm a patriot. And resistance is not terrorism.|Saw Gerrera|<ref name="The Soft War" />}}
In his younger years, Saw Gerrera was a hot headed soldier who was eager for leadership and considered himself a patriot of [https://starwars.fandom.com/wiki/Onderon Onderon]. A compassionate and charismatic man, Saw valued freedom, independence, and was a loyal follower of King [https://starwars.fandom.com/wiki/Ramsis_Dendup Ramsis Dendup] willing to fight for causes supporting them.<ref name="The Soft War2">{{TCW|The Soft War}}</ref> While considered a terrorist in the eyes of Dendup's usurped administration and [https://starwars.fandom.com/wiki/Confederacy_of_Independent_Systems Confederacy of Independent Systems], Gerrera considered himself a patriot, believed that resistance was not the same as terrorism.<ref name="The Soft War4">{{TCW|The Soft War}}</ref>  Having a competitive spirit and charm, he was also more aggressive than his fellow rebels and butted heads with his sister and Lux Bonteri alike; while she and many others wished to unite others with the support of the people, Saw instead desired to hurt his enemies and lacking this understanding became a flaw that once his sister a more popular leader, leaving him temporarily disheartened.<ref name="Front Runners" /><ref name="Dawn VG">''[[Star Wars: Dawn of Rebellion: The Visual Guide]]''</ref> The untimely death of his sister weighed heavily on his mind, sowing the seeds for him vowing to fight evil in all forms.<ref name="Ultimate, New">''[[Ultimate Star Wars, New Edition]]''</ref> 

[[File:SawGerrera19BBY.png|right|thumb|300x300px|In the early years of the Empire, Gerrera was a ruthless but charismatic hero of Onderon.]] In the early years of the Empire and it's transformation from the Republic, Gerrera's reputation was heightened for a time, marking him as a Onderonian hero and a candidate for the position of Governor of Onderon before he publicly rejected the Empire.<ref name="MOF22">''[[Reign of the Empire: The Mask of Fear]]''</ref> Retroactively considering himself more smart and prepared than he was during the Clone Wars at that point in his life,<ref name="Rebel Rising" /> Mothma noted upon meeting him for the first time, he moved with confidence akin to a chancellor or a judge and noted when accused of having no strategy by Organa, he revealed himself to be pragmatic, clever, more concerned for public opinion than he let on, having grand plans, ambitions, and capable of working with criminal elements to achieve his goals although she believed him limited to a single-[https://starwars.fandom.com/wiki/Sector sector] conflict. Fitting this image, he practiced giving speeches to inspire others to his cause. [https://starwars.fandom.com/wiki/Haki_Zeophrine Haki Zeophrine] opined that Gerrera believed himself persecuted and any notion contradicting it frustrated him.<ref name="MOF">''[[Reign of the Empire: The Mask of Fear]]''</ref> 

Despite his public support of the Galactic Republic, he was skeptical about accepting their aid, believing it could lead to the Republic laying claim to Onderon should they emerge victorious in the war, a notion revealed to be true when it transformed into the Galactic Empire.<ref name="Dawn VG" /> Not believing him idealistic, he also believed people did not fight for principles or democracy despite their claims, instead yearning for resources, land, and self-preservation.<ref name="MOF" /> He also would strategize bold tactics, believing sacrifices to be worthwhile to achieve his goals.<ref name="The Summit" /> Through a combinations of his own actions as well as both accounts of the Empire and from allies alike,<ref name="Replacements22">{{TBB|Replacements}}</ref> be it true or falsified by both (the latter in other to give plausible deniability),<ref name="MOF22" /> Gerrera's image eroded overtime and leaned more into extremism.<ref name="Saw Gerrera Databank" />  

===An impassioned rebel===
 {{Quote|You target civilians, kill those who surrender, break every rule of engagement! If we degrade ourselves to the Empire's level, what will we become?''"<br />"''There she is! That's the leader the Rebellion needs! Where is that fire, that passion, when your people need it most? I hope, Senator, after you've lost, and the Empire reigns over the galaxy unopposed, you will find some comfort in the knowledge that you fought according to the rules.|Mon Mothma and Saw Gerrera|<ref name="In the Name of the Rebellion" />}}
 [[File:Saw_Gerrera_SaV.png|left|thumb|270x270px|Although Gerrera fought for freedom against oppressors such as the Galactic Empire, his methods negatively affected his image.]] Long considered a extremist during the later years of the Imperial Era, he was unapologetic in his use of torture and could, at times, justify a slaughter on civilian targets such as the [https://starwars.fandom.com/wiki/Mission_to_Inusagi mission to Inusagi].<ref name="Rebel Rising" /> Retroactively, Gerrera disagreed with some of the Jedi's principled tactics, believing them lacking and costing them the Clone Wars.<ref name="Ghosts of Geonosis" /> He also pragmatically regarded their actions as being underwhelming despite their belief in the Force and powers associated with it.<ref name="Rebel Rising" /> Within his Partisan ranks, betrayal was considered a high cost, with summary execution from himself often being the punishment<ref name="Dawn VG" /> and held little regards for purging his own men for espionage against him, be it on behalf the Empire or Alliance.<ref name="Rebel Rising" /><ref name="Rebel Files">''[[Star Wars: The Rebel Files]]''</ref> Alternatively, he would state his survival from spies and infiltrators from enemies (and supposed allies) was due to learning how to manipulate them to his wishes.<ref name="Jedha, Kyber, Erso">{{Andor|Jedha, Kyber, Erso}}</ref> He often found it frustrating that members of the [https://starwars.fandom.com/wiki/Alliance_to_Restore_the_Republic rebellion] worried about how they would be labelled being the Empire would classify them negatively regardless.<ref name="Rebel Rising" />

Gerrera harbored great antipathy towards the Separatists for invading his homeworld Onderon.<ref name="Daughter of Ferrix" /> He also disliked the Geonosians due to their alignment with the Separatists and for building gunships which led to his sister Steela's death. This coupled by the loss of his comrades during a mission on Geonosis led him to interrogate the Geonosian Klik-Klak, much to the discomfort of his former comrade Rex and the Spectres.<ref name="Ghosts of Geonosis" /> Gerrera also develop paranoia as he became more battled-damaged and unstable, eventually believing both the Empire and Rebellion are conspiring to target him for his crimes.<ref name="Rogue One Visual Guide" /><ref name="Jedha, Kyber, Erso" /><ref name="The Soft War Episode Guide" />  

While often upholding a callous exterior in most instances, Gerrera still retained a level of care and compassion he had in the earlier years of his lifetime;<ref name="Saw Gerrera Databank" /> Despite his antipathy towards the Geonosians, Gerrera was horrified by the Empire's genocide against the species and believed that they had the same right to rebuild as other species. leading him to concede with Erzra and release both Klik-Klak and the [https://starwars.fandom.com/wiki/Karina Geonosian queen egg] he was guarding.<ref name="Ghosts of Geonosis" /> Despite partaking in the [https://starwars.fandom.com/wiki/Mission_to_Inusagi mission to Inusagi] willingly and justifying it, he harbored a level of regret for it.<ref name="Rebel Rising" /> Often times, reluctant allies and friends alike commended Gerrera for his efforts in overtly combating the Empire when many in the galaxy were willing to overlook their atrocities.<ref name="In the Name of the Rebellion" /><ref name="Jedi: Survivor">''[[Star Wars Jedi: Survivor]]''</ref> He also held a conscience enough to show a level of reluctance in the idea of sacrificing those fighting against the Empire for a greater good even if he could accept and justify it.<ref name="Daughter of Ferrix" />  

===Relationships===
====Allies, friends, and family====
=====Steela Gerrera=====
Saw loved cared for his younger sister profoundly, coming to see her potential as the best leader of the Onderon rebels even when he was at first dismayed at the fact.<ref name="Tipping Points" /> As siblings, the pair would often jokingly taunt one another. Her death would carry a powerful presence in his life, making him somewhat disillusioned with the Jedi in later years, believing their powers in the Force was limited from experiencing his sister's death.<ref name="Rebel Rising" /> Ultimately, he felt responsible for the death of his sister, Steela. Thus, he vowed to keep up his war against what he saw as evil, no matter what form his enemies took.  

=====Jyn Erso=====
{{Quote|''Jyn! My daughter!''|Saw Gerrera|<ref name="R1Novel" />}}
 The pair first meet during his early years of the Empire when he helped smuggled them off of [https://starwars.fandom.com/wiki/Coruscant Corusant] to escape Krennic, with Jyn taking an immediate liking to him and considering him a friend.<ref name="Catalyst" /> Years later, a older Gerrera would take in the child as his ward<ref name="Rebel Rising" /> following losing her parents to the Empire and would come to view her as his daughter.<ref name="R1Novel" /> He mentored and trained her in how to defend herself and insurgent tactics but was paternally protective of Jyn and sought to protect her from even his own ranks. At the age of sixteen, Jyn believed she was abandoned by Gerrera and learned years later, upon reuniting with him, that he did so to protected her against Partisans whom would leverage her life to draw out Galen Erso, believed to be a Imperial scientist willingly working for the Empire and expressed he thought of Jyn frequently and missed her profoundly.<ref name="Rebel Rising" /> Despite his estranged relationship with Jyn, Gerrera was still able to inspire her to find the weakness in the Empire's superweapon in order to save the rebellion.<ref name="Rogue One" /> As he saw her stare in sadness at the holoprojector that had displayed her birth father, Gerrera felt shame and ire for a moment, pondering if she had grown soft, before kicking the thought from his mind. In his final moments with her, he decided Erso was still his best soldier and only remaining family.<ref name="R1Novel" />  

=====Lux Bonteri=====
While initially the pair fought alongside one another to free their home planet, Onderon, Gerrera often argued with Bonteri and accused him of being more politician than a soldier and/or a fighter and was disapproving of the affections his sister gave him, whom mediated the pair often. Their relationship improved, forming a more positive perception of him as they worked together to free Onderon.<ref name="A War on Two Fronts" />  

=====Partisans=====
Gerrera had a trusted bond with both [https://starwars.fandom.com/wiki/Benthic Benthic] and [https://starwars.fandom.com/wiki/Edrio Edrio], both whom served the Partisans.<ref name="Edrio Two Tubes">{{Databank|edrio-two-tubes|Edrio Two Tubes}}</ref><ref name="Benthic Two Tubes">{{Databank|benthic-two-tubes|Benthic Two Tubes}}</ref> Sharing no reservation for his methods, the duo are among Gerrera's most trusted operatives, sharing operational information with them both in part due to their pain tolerance making them resistant to interrogation. While Edrio leads his [https://starwars.fandom.com/wiki/Cavern_Angels Cavern Angels], Benthic operates as his informal rebel lieutenant and second-in-command.<ref name="Rogue One Visual Guide" /> Gerrera held great respect for [https://starwars.fandom.com/wiki/Cal_Kestis Cal Kestis], having offered him a place in his rebel cell and left the invitation open when he rejected it, in which Kestis helped on multiple occasion.<ref name="Jedi: Survivor2">''[[Star Wars Jedi: Survivor]]''</ref>   

Saw also held great care with [https://starwars.fandom.com/wiki/Megyn_Soone Megyn Soone] and [https://starwars.fandom.com/wiki/Idryssa_Barruck Idyrssa Barruck], both women compared to Steela and having ascended through the ranks (the former his Lieutenant).<ref name="Crossing the Line" /><ref name="Rebel Rising" /> While Idyrssa would disagree with his tactics, opted to side with the [https://starwars.fandom.com/wiki/Alliance_to_Restore_the_Republic Rebel Alliance], and the pair argued over ethics and strategy in fighting the Empire as a unified front, they maintained a mutual understanding and care. This care was profound enough for Jyn to observe arguing with her frustrated him to an extent and for him to perform missions on behalf of the [https://starwars.fandom.com/wiki/Alliance_to_Restore_the_Republic alliance] because she asked.<ref name="Rebel Rising" /> With Megyn, despite convincing others his philosophy of rebelling against the Empire ("the mission") coming first at the expense of his own Partisans' lives and himself, he is unwilling to enact it against her, with Captain Engels observing his care for her.<ref name="Crossing the Line" /> 

=====Others=====
Saw was a longtime friend of Galen and Lyn Erso.<ref name="TSWB">''[[The Star Wars Book]]''</ref> Gerrera also held had a amicable relationship with spymaster [https://starwars.fandom.com/wiki/Luthen_Rael Luthen Rael] although the latter's willingness to sacrifice allies caused him concern.<ref name="Daughter of Ferrix" /> Saw harbored great respect for the [https://starwars.fandom.com/wiki/Jedi_Order Jedi Order],<ref name="The Soft War">{{TCW|The Soft War}}</ref> persisting into his later years even as he held their tactics and reverence in the Force in doubt.<ref name="Rebel Rising" /><ref name="Ghosts of Geonosis" />

====Other relationships====
=====Bail Organa=====
Gerrera had a complicated relationship with Organa, whom he first met during the latter's [https://starwars.fandom.com/wiki/Investigation_into_the_framing_of_the_Jedi secret investigation into the Jedi coup conspiracy] and interrogated him until both realized neither supported the Empire. Their relation with one another was chilly, with Organa critical of his methods and claiming he "fumbled" in military tactics against the Separatist and Empire and questioned his ethics, both notions that annoyed Gerrera.
